articles.title: What school absences really tell us
articles.subtitle: 缺课背后的家庭困境
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Nationally, one in six children miss 15 or more days of school in a year.
sentences.zh: 在全国范围内，每六名儿童中就有一名一年缺课至少 15 天。

sentences.en: Education officials have deplored all this missed instruction.
sentences.zh: 教育官员对学生错过如此多的课堂教学深感遗憾。

sentences.en: These chronically absent students suffer academically because of all the classroom instruction they miss out on.
sentences.zh: 这些长期缺课的学生，因为错过大量课堂教学，学业表现受到影响。

sentences.en: In 2015, the U. S. secretary of education responded to this crisis, urging communities to support every student to attend every day and be successful in school.
sentences.zh: 2015 年，美国教育部长就这一危机作出回应，呼吁各社区支持每一名学生每天到校，并帮助他们在学业上取得成功。

sentences.en: His open letter stated that missing 10% of school days in a year for any reason—excused or unexcused—is a primary cause of low academic achievement.
sentences.zh: 他在公开信中指出：一年中不论因何种原因缺课，不管是获准请假还是无故缺席，只要达到上课天数的 10%，就是学业成绩不佳的一个主要原因。

sentences.en: Worrying about whether children attend school makes sense.
sentences.zh: 关心儿童是否到校上课，是有道理的。

sentences.en: After all, if students don't show up, teachers can't teach them.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，学生不来上课，教师就无从教起。

sentences.en: But what if America's attendance crisis is about much more than students missing class?
sentences.zh: 可是，倘若美国的出勤危机所反映的问题，远不止学生错过课堂教学这么简单呢？

sentences.en: What if, instead, it is a reflection of family and community crises these students face such as being ejected from the family apartment, fearing for their safety in their neighborhood or suffering an illness?
sentences.zh: 倘若它实际上反映的是这些学生面对的家庭和社区危机呢？例如，他们被赶出居住的公寓、担心自己在社区中的安全，或正遭受疾病困扰。

sentences.en: As social scientists we investigated how excused and unexcused absences relate to children's academic achievement.
sentences.zh: 作为社会科学家，我们研究了获准请假的缺课与无故缺课，分别与儿童的学业成绩有何关系。

sentences.en: We find that absences excused by a parent do little to harm children's learning.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，经家长认可的请假缺课，对儿童学习的影响很小。

sentences.en: In fact, children with no unexcused absences—but 15 to 18 excused-absences—have test scores equal to their peers who have no absences.
sentences.zh: 事实上，从未无故缺课、但有 15 至 18 天请假缺课的儿童，考试成绩与全勤的同龄人相当。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, the average child with even just one unexcused absence does much worse academically than peers with none.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，平均来看，即使只有一次无故缺课的儿童，学业表现也比从未无故缺课的同龄人差得多。

sentences.en: We believe unexcused absence is a strong signal of the many challenges children and families face, including economic and medical hardships.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，无故缺课是一个强烈信号，反映出儿童及其家庭正在面对诸多挑战，包括经济困难和医疗困境。

sentences.en: Unexcused absences can be a powerful signal of how those out-of-school challenges affect children's academic progress.
sentences.zh: 无故缺课可以有力地表明，这些校外困境正在怎样影响儿童的学业进展。

sentences.en: Our evidence suggests unexcused absences are problematic, but for a different reason than people often think.
sentences.zh: 我们的证据表明，无故缺课确实值得关注，但其背后的原因与人们通常的理解不同。

sentences.en: Absence from school, and especially unexcused absence, matters mainly as a signal of many crises children and their families may be facing.
sentences.zh: 缺课，尤其是无故缺课，之所以重要，主要是因为它反映出儿童及其家庭可能面临的种种危机。
sentences.note: 作者区分 signal（反映其他问题的信号）与 cause（原因）；excused absence 指家长或学校认可的请假缺课。

sentences.en: It matters less as a cause of lower student achievement due to missed instruction.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，把缺课视为由于错过课堂教学而导致成绩下降的原因，并不是最关键之处。

sentences.en: How we choose to think of school absences matters for educational policy.
sentences.zh: 我们选择如何理解学生缺课，会影响教育政策。

sentences.en: School attendance policies typically hold schools and families accountable for the days children miss, regardless of whether they were excused or unexcused absences.
sentences.zh: 学校的出勤政策通常要求学校和家庭为儿童缺课的天数负责，无论那些缺课是否经过请假许可。

sentences.en: These policies assume that missing school for any reason harms children academically because they are missing classroom instruction.
sentences.zh: 这些政策假定，学生不论因为什么原因缺课，都会因为错过课堂教学而影响学业。

sentences.en: They also assume that schools will be able to effectively intervene by reducing student absences.
sentences.zh: 这些政策还假定，学校能够通过减少学生缺课来进行有效干预。

sentences.en: We find neither to be the case.
sentences.zh: 我们发现，这两种假设都不成立。

sentences.en: As a result, these attendance policies end up disproportionately punishing families dealing with out-of-school crises in their lives and pressuring schools who serve them to get students to school more often.
sentences.zh: 结果，这些出勤政策对正在应对校外生活危机的家庭施加了不成比例的惩罚，同时也给服务这些家庭的学校施压，要求它们让学生更经常地到校。

sentences.en: We instead suggest using unexcused absence from school as a signal to channel resources to the children and families who need them most.
sentences.zh: 相反，我们建议把无故缺课视为一种信号，据此把资源提供给最需要帮助的儿童及其家庭。
sentences.note: 作者区分 signal（反映其他问题的信号）与 cause（原因）；excused absence 指家长或学校认可的请假缺课。

articles.title: The hidden costs of following your passion
articles.subtitle: 追随热情也需要现实条件
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: After earning a bachelor's degree, I was determined to do what I love.
sentences.zh: 获得学士学位后，我下定决心要做自己热爱的事。

sentences.en: I headed straight to graduate school to investigate the social problems that fascinated me.
sentences.zh: 我直接进入研究生院，研究令我着迷的社会问题。

sentences.en: For almost a decade, I told everyone I encountered that they should do the same.
sentences.zh: 近十年来，我告诉我遇到的每个人他们也应该这样做。

sentences.en: “Follow your passion,” I counseled.
sentences.zh: “追随你的激情，”我建议道。

sentences.en: “You can figure out the employment stuff later."
sentences.zh: “就业的事情你以后再想吧。”

sentences.en: It wasn’t until I began to research this widely accepted career advice.that I understood how problematic it really was.
sentences.zh: 直到我开始研究这个被广泛接受的职业建议，我才明白它到底有多大问题。

sentences.en: As a sociologist, I interviewed college students and professional workers to learn what it really meant to pursue their dreams, which I will refer to here as the passion principle.
sentences.zh: 作为一名社会学家，我采访了大学生和职业工作者，以了解追求梦想的真正含义，我在这里将其称为激情原则。

sentences.en: I was stunned by what I found out about this principle in the research for my new book.
sentences.zh: 在我的新书研究中发现的这一原理让我感到震惊。

sentences.en: Surveys show the American public has long held the passion principle in high regard as a career decision-making priority.
sentences.zh: 调查显示，美国公众长期以来一直高度重视激情原则，并将其作为职业决策的优先事项。

sentences.en: And its popularity is even stronger among those facing job instability.
sentences.zh: 在那些面临工作不稳定的人中，它的受欢迎程度甚至更高。

sentences.en: Advocates of the passion principle found it compelling because they believed that following one's passion can provide workers with both the motivation necessary to work hard and a place to find fulfillment.
sentences.zh: 激情原则的倡导者发现它很引人注目，因为他们相信追随自己的激情可以为员工提供努力工作所需的动力和找到成就感的地方。

sentences.en: Yet, what I found is that following one's passion does not necessarily lead to fulfillment, but is one of the most powerful cultural forces perpetuating overwork.
sentences.zh: 然而，我发现追随自己的热情并不一定会带来成就感，但却是导致过度劳累的最强大的文化力量之一。

sentences.en: I also found that promoting the pursuit of one's passion helps perpetuate social inequalities due to the fact that not everyone has the same economic resources to allow them to pursue their passion with ease.
sentences.zh: 我还发现，促进对个人激情的追求有助于延续社会不平等，因为并不是每个人都拥有相同的经济资源来让他们轻松地追求自己的激情。

sentences.en: While the passion principle is broadly popular, not everyone has the necessary resources to turn their passion into a stable, good-paying job.
sentences.zh: 虽然激情原则广泛流行，但并不是每个人都有必要的资源将他们的激情转化为稳定、高薪的工作。

sentences.en: Passion-seekers from wealthy families are better able to wait until a job they are passionate about comes along without worrying about student loans in the meantime.
sentences.zh: 来自富裕家庭的追求激情的人能够更好地等待他们热爱的工作出现，而不必担心学生贷款。

sentences.en: They are also better situated to take unpaid internships.to get their foot in the door while their parents pay their rent.
sentences.zh: 他们也更有条件通过无薪实习获得入行机会，而房租由父母承担。
sentences.note: get one's foot in the door 指获得进入某个行业或机构的初步机会。level the playing field 指创造公平竞争条件。

sentences.en: And they often have access to parents’ social networks to help them find jobs.
sentences.zh: 而且他们经常可以访问父母的社交网络来帮助他们找工作。

sentences.en: Surveys revealed that working-class and first-generation college graduates, regardless of their career field, are more likely than their wealthier peers to end up in low-paying unskilled jobs when they pursue their passion.
sentences.zh: 调查显示，工人阶级和第一代大学毕业生，无论其职业领域如何，在追求自己的激情时，都比富裕同龄人更有可能从事低薪非技术工作。

sentences.en: Colleges, workplaces and career counselors who promote the “follow your passion"path for everyone, without leveling the playing field, help perpetuate socioeconomic inequalities among career aspirants.
sentences.zh: 大学、工作单位和职业顾问，如果没有先创造公平的竞争条件，就向所有人推崇“追随热情”这条道路，实际上会延续求职者之间的社会经济不平等。

sentences.en: It's not just well-off passion-seekers who benefit from the passion principle.
sentences.zh: 受益于激情原则的不仅仅是富裕的激情追求者。

sentences.en: Employers of passionate workers do, too.
sentences.zh: 拥有热情员工的雇主也这样做。

sentences.en: Potential employers showed greater interest in passionate applicants in part because they believed the applicants would work hard at their jobs without expecting an increase in pay.
sentences.zh: 潜在雇主对充满热情的申请人表现出更大的兴趣，部分原因是他们相信申请人会在工作中努力工作，而不期望加薪。

sentences.en: They even sacrifice a good salary, job stability and leisure time to work in a job they love.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至牺牲良好的薪水、工作稳定性和休闲时间来从事自己喜欢的工作。

articles.title: Turning simulation into real-world learning
articles.subtitle: 从模拟训练走向实际行动
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Simulators are most often utilized within industries such as nuclear power, aviation and surgery where failure results in disastrous consequences.
sentences.zh: 模拟器最常用于核电、航空和外科手术等领域，因为在这些领域，一旦操作失败，就可能造成灾难性后果。
sentences.note: 阅读时关注模拟中的经验如何迁移到实际行动；forge a link 指建立联系。

sentences.en: To maximize the value from a simulation learning experience, participants should immediately and directly. apply their learning ‘to a specific intervention within their organization.
sentences.zh: 为了最大化模拟学习体验的价值，参与者应该立即、直接。将他们的学习应用到组织内的特定干预中。

sentences.en: Most organizations aspire to deploy significant change programs, only to find them·nearly impossible to implement.
sentences.zh: 大多数组织都渴望部署重大变革计划，却发现它们几乎不可能实施。

sentences.en: That is largely because successful change requires more than.avision; it requires a workforce that not only doesn't resist change, but embraces it.
sentences.zh: 这主要是因为成功的变革需要的不仅仅是愿景；它需要一支不仅不抵制变革而且拥抱变革的员工队伍。

sentences.en: To achieve success,"an organization must build a transformation program that will allow change to be rapidly pulled across its departments and throughout its layers.
sentences.zh: 为了取得成功，“组织必须制定一个转型计划，使变革能够在其各个部门和各个层级中快速推进。

sentences.en: Regardless of the level of senior management commitment, unless key thought leaders at all levels embrace the change, the initiative will wither and die.
sentences.zh: 无论高级管理层的承诺水平如何，除非各级关键思想领袖接受变革，否则该举措将会枯萎和消亡。

sentences.en: To create this kind. of widespread passion, learning leaders must expose the workforce to what could be, which will enable them to rethink their mental models, enable them to break free from their deep-rooted paradigms and embrace the opportunity to learn.
sentences.zh: 创建这种。带着广泛的热情，学习型领导者必须让员工了解可能发生的事情，这将使他们能够重新思考自己的思维模式，使他们能够摆脱根深蒂固的范式并拥抱学习的机会。

sentences.en: Allowing participants to.enter a simulated environment provides them with the opportunity to experience alternative realities which can prompt them to rethink their current beliefs.
sentences.zh: 允许参与者进入模拟环境为他们提供了体验替代现实的机会，这可以促使他们重新思考他们当前的信念。

sentences.en: Behavioral change is not easy for most adults.
sentences.zh: 对于大多数成年人来说，行为改变并不容易。

sentences.en: Lectures, training programs and workshops can explain the intellectual elements of transformation, but they are seldom effective at getting to the behavioral aspects that lie.at the heart of a significant change initiative.
sentences.zh: 讲座、培训计划和研讨会可以解释转型的智力要素，但它们很少能有效地了解作为重大变革举措核心的行为方面。

sentences.en: Further, under normal working conditions, managers rarely see the full effect of their employee development efforts.
sentences.zh: 此外，在正常工作条件下，管理者很少看到员工发展努力的全部效果。

sentences.en: As such, an intervention like a simulation can provide the stimulus for change.
sentences.zh: 因此，像模拟这样的干预可以提供变革的刺激。

sentences.en: An effective simulation can be better than experience as a learning tool because it accelerates time, compresses space, and unlike reality, is specifically designed to maximize participant learning.
sentences.zh: 作为一种学习工具，有效的模拟可能比经验更好，因为它加速了时间，压缩了空间，并且与现实不同，它是专门为最大化参与者学习而设计的。

sentences.en: Simulations provide an immersive learning experience where skills, processes and knowledge all can be highlighted in a way reality cannot.
sentences.zh: 模拟提供了一种身临其境的学习体验，其中技能、流程和知识都可以以现实无法做到的方式突出显示。

sentences.en: The ability to explore, experiment and repeatedly apply new knowledge in unlimited, risk-free models is what makes simulation one of the most productive forms of learning.
sentences.zh: 在无限、无风险的模型中探索、实验和重复应用新知识的能力使模拟成为最高效的学习形式之一。

sentences.en: Well-designed simulations can enable individuals and groups to develop a deep level of understanding about how their' decisions and intuitive responses to business stimuli affect their fellow participants and the organization as a whole.
sentences.zh: 精心设计的模拟可以使个人和团体深入了解他们的决策和对业务刺激的直观反应如何影响其他参与者和整个组织。

sentences.en: To reap the benefits, however, simulations must feel like reality.
sentences.zh: 然而，为了获得好处，模拟必须感觉像现实。

sentences.en: At the end of the successful simulation, participants must declare “this is us."
sentences.zh: 在成功模拟结束时，参与者必须声明“这就是我们”。

sentences.en: If they don't, they will view the experience as a game, which can be difficult to apply on the job, or worse, irrelevant to everyday work tasks.
sentences.zh: 如果不这样做，他们会将体验视为游戏，这可能很难应用于工作，或者更糟的是，与日常工作任务无关。

sentences.en: To maximize benefits from simulation, participants should immediately apply the learning from the experience to forge a smooth link between learning and doing.
sentences.zh: 要最大限度地发挥模拟训练的作用，参与者应立即运用从这段经历中学到的东西，使学习与实践顺畅衔接。

articles.title: Putting wellbeing at the heart of policy
articles.subtitle: 政府该追求增长还是幸福
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: GDP growth is not a good indicator of how well a country is performing, and should not be the primary goal of governments.
sentences.zh: GDP 增长并不是衡量一个国家表现如何的良好指标，也不应该成为政府的首要目标。

sentences.en: Unlimited growth is not sustainable, and economic thinking is moving toward the idea that we should aim for sustainability in our economic models.
sentences.zh: 无限增长是不可持续的，经济思维正在转向我们应该以经济模型的可持续性为目标的想法。

sentences.en: But while a sustainable economy is vital to our future, it is a means to an end, not an end in itself.
sentences.zh: 不过，尽管可持续的经济对我们的未来至关重要，它仍然是实现目标的手段，而不是目标本身。

sentences.en: The idea that governments should focus on happiness has its critics.
sentences.zh: 政府应该关注幸福的想法受到了批评。

sentences.en: There are concerns about how happiness can be measured.
sentences.zh: 人们担心如何衡量幸福。

sentences.en: Is happiness not a fleeting and subjective psychological state?
sentences.zh: 幸福难道不是一种转瞬即逝的主观心理状态吗？

sentences.en: Don't different people experience different levels of happiness?
sentences.zh: 不同的人体验到的幸福程度不都是不同的吗？

sentences.en: Even on the broadest interpretation of ‘happiness’as prosperity or‘life satisfaction',people want different things: Of course, governments cannot impose life satisfaction on citizens.
sentences.zh: 即使将“幸福”最广泛地解释为繁荣或“生活满意度”，人们想要的东西也不同：当然，政府不能将生活满意度强加给公民。

sentences.en: But our happiness relies on collaborative efforts as a society.
sentences.zh: 但我们的幸福依赖于整个社会的协作努力。

sentences.en: A government's obligation lies in creating conditions that promote prosperity.
sentences.zh: 政府的义务在于创造促进繁荣的条件。

sentences.en: And there is good reason to suppose that such conditions exist, are globally applicable, and are discoverable through research.
sentences.zh: 并且有充分的理由假设这些条件存在，在全球范围内适用，并且可以通过研究发现。

sentences.en: In a recently published article, philosopher Julian Baggini suggests we should focus on‘real wealth’for citizens, which does not depend on GDP growth.
sentences.zh: 在最近发表的一篇文章中，哲学家 Julian Baggini 建议我们应该关注公民的“实际财富”，这不依赖于 GDP 增长。

sentences.en: Access is key: people do not need to own, but rather access things that enable them to live well.
sentences.zh: 获取是关键：人们不需要拥有，而是需要获取使他们能够过上美好生活的东西。

sentences.en: Technological advances and changes in social behavior enable us to make more efficient use of the assets that we already have.
sentences.zh: 技术进步和社会行为的变化使我们能够更有效地利用我们已有的资产。

sentences.en: And focusing on access to the resources people need to live better lives could help reduce inequality.
sentences.zh: 关注人们获得更好生活所需的资源可能有助于减少不平等。

sentences.en: As far as it goes, this has much in common with proposals tabled by‘happiness’advocates.
sentences.zh: 就目前而言，这与“幸福”倡导者提出的建议有很多共同点。

sentences.en: But it sets the bar far too low for what governments can and should be doing for their citizens.
sentences.zh: 但它对于政府能够并且应该为公民做的事情设定的标准太低。

sentences.en: For example, it's not clear how a ‘real wealth’economy would remedy the epidemic of mental ill-health that plagues our society.
sentences.zh: 例如，目前尚不清楚“真正的财富”经济将如何纠正困扰我们社会的精神疾病流行病。

sentences.en: In Western countries, at least — poor mental health is more detrimental to wellbeing than poverty.
sentences.zh: 至少在西方国家——心理健康状况不佳比贫困对福祉的危害更大。

sentences.en: Over and above a vastly improved provision of therapeutic mental healthcare, there are preventative measures for improving mental health that governments could and should adopt.
sentences.zh: 除了大大改善治疗性心理保健的提供之外，政府可以而且应该采取改善心理健康的预防措施。

sentences.en: The WHO recommends establishing institutions that facilitate community participation —— educational programs and interventions that provide skills for promoting mental wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 世界卫生组织建议建立促进社区参与的机构——提供促进心理健康技能的教育计划和干预措施。

sentences.en: It says a lot, however, that the WHO feels the need to appeal tothe economic benefits of improving mental health to persuade governments that the cost of taking proposed measures is justified.
sentences.zh: 然而，这说明了很多，世界卫生组织认为有必要利用改善心理健康的经济效益来说服政府，采取拟议措施的成本是合理的。

sentences.en: As long as the economy is their priority, governments need go no further than ensuring citizens’continued productivity.
sentences.zh: 只要经济是他们的首要任务，政府就只需确保公民的持续生产力即可。

sentences.en: To demand that governments set the‘happiness’of citizens as their highest priority is to demand that they view citizens as ends in themselves.
sentences.zh: 要求政府把公民的“幸福”置于首位，就是要求政府把公民本身视为目的。
sentences.note: ends in themselves 指本身就是目的；末句要求把公民的福祉当作政策的最终目标，而非仅把人看成生产工具。

articles.title: Careers, status and the need for respect
articles.subtitle: 职业焦虑背后的势利眼光
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Why are we so worried about our careers?
sentences.zh: 为什么我们如此担心我们的职业生涯？

sentences.en: Partly it's to do with money, but there's a psychological aspect to our fears as well.
sentences.zh: 部分原因与金钱有关，但我们的恐惧也有心理方面的原因。

sentences.en: We worry because we suspect —not wrongly — that the world is full of a frightening sort of person ready to judge us ruthlessly and swiftly: a person we can call a snob.
sentences.zh: 我们担心，因为我们怀疑——这不是错误的——世界上充满了一种可怕的人，准备无情地、迅速地评判我们：我们可以称之为势利小人的人。

sentences.en: A snob is anyone who takes a relatively small part of us and uses it to come to a rigid conclusion about how much of their attention we deserve.
sentences.zh: 势利小人是指那些占据我们相对较小部分的人，并用它来得出关于我们应该得到多少他们的关注的严格结论。

sentences.en: In the past, that might be your ancestry and royal connections.
sentences.zh: 在过去，那可能是你的血统和皇室​​关系。

sentences.en: Nowadays, the snob cares about one thing only: what you do for a living.
sentences.zh: 如今，势利小人只关心一件事：你以什么为生。

sentences.en: This explains why the first question we will be asked in any new social context is‘What do you do? ’and according to how we answer, snobs will either welcome us with broad smiles, or leave us in the cold.
sentences.zh: 这就解释了为什么每到一个新的社交场合，我们最先被问到的总是“你是做什么工作的？”而势利者会根据我们的回答，决定是满脸笑容地欢迎我们，还是把我们冷落在一旁。
sentences.note: leave somebody in the cold 指冷落某人；snob 是以地位、财富等外在标准轻视他人的势利者。

sentences.en: And that is why we are fired up by such a desperate urge to achieve and impress.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么我们如此迫切地渴望取得成就并给人留下深刻印象。

sentences.en: Sometimes our behaviour is mistaken for greed and vanity, but it is more than this.
sentences.zh: 有时我们的行为会被误认为是贪婪和虚荣，但又不止于此。

sentences.en: A lot of our interest in fancy cars, jobs and houses has nothing to do with materialism.
sentences.zh: 我们对豪华汽车、工作和房屋的很多兴趣与物质主义无关。

sentences.en: It has to do with a hunger for the respect and esteem that is only available in our societies through the acquisition of material goods.
sentences.zh: 它与对尊重和尊重的渴望有关，而这种渴望在我们的社会中只能通过获取物质财富才能获得。

sentences.en: It isn't the goods themselves we seek, it is the love we stand to gain through our possession of them.
sentences.zh: 我们追求的不是物品本身，而是我们通过拥有它们而获得的爱。

sentences.en: The next time we see someone driving a Ferrari, we shouldn't condemn them for their greed, we should pity them for the intensity of their need for love from the world.
sentences.zh: 下次看到有人开法拉利时，我们不该指责他们贪婪，而该对他们如此强烈地渴望得到世人的喜爱抱以同情。

sentences.en: At the root of snobbery is a lack of imagination and confidence about how to decide who in the world is valuable.
sentences.zh: 势利的根源在于对如何决定世界上谁是有价值的缺乏想象力和信心。

sentences.en: The snobs are brutally misguided and slavish in their beliefs about how the superior individuals can be identified.
sentences.zh: 势利小人在如何识别优秀个体的信念上被残酷地误导和奴役。

sentences.en: For snobs, it is the already acclaimed and already successful who are the only ones worthy of respect.
sentences.zh: 对于势利小人来说，只有那些已经受人赞誉、已经成功的人才值得尊重。

sentences.en: There is no room in their timid regimented minds to imagine that someone might be clever, kind or good—and yet somehow have been overlooked entirely by society, their qualities lying hidden beneath an unfamiliar veil, and having as yet discovered no obvious outlet.
sentences.zh: 在他们胆怯、受管制的头脑中，没有空间去想象一个人可能聪明、善良或善良，但不知何故却被社会完全忽视了，他们的品质隐藏在陌生的面纱下，至今还没有发现明显的出路。

sentences.en: The true answer to snobbery is not to say that there is no such thing as a better or worse person, but to insist that better or worse exist in constantly unexpected places and carry none of the outward signs of distinction.
sentences.zh: 对势利的真正回答不是说不存在更好或更坏的人，而是坚持认为更好或更坏的人总是存在于意想不到的地方，并且没有任何外在的区别标志。

sentences.en: And because we are such poor judges of the worth of others, our ultimate duty remains to be kind, good, curious and imaginative about pretty much everyone who ever crosses our path.
sentences.zh: 因为我们对他人的价值判断能力很差，所以我们的最终责任仍然是对几乎所有遇到我们的人表现出友善、善良、好奇和富有想象力。

articles.title: Family leave and the gender pay gap
articles.subtitle: 性别薪酬差距与母职惩罚
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Women have historically been paid less.
sentences.zh: 历史上女性的工资较低。

sentences.en: But in the US in the 1980s, they began to catch up fast.
sentences.zh: 但在 20 世纪 80 年代的美国，他们开始快速追赶。

sentences.en: During that decade, the gender pay gap closed by about one percentage point a year.
sentences.zh: 在那十年中，性别工资差距每年缩小约一个百分点。

sentences.en: Had that trend continued, the gender wage gap would have been closed by 2017.
sentences.zh: 如果这种趋势持续下去，性别工资差距将在 2017 年缩小。

sentences.en: But the trend didn't continue, and the gap remains yawning.
sentences.zh: 但这一趋势没有持续下去，薪酬差距依然巨大。

sentences.en: According to a new study from academics at Harvard, the stagnation can be put down, perhaps counterintuitively, to the introduction of state and federal family leave policies.
sentences.zh: 根据哈佛大学学者的一项新研究，这种停滞可以归因于州和联邦家庭休假政策的引入，这或许与直觉相反。

sentences.en: The academics argue that during the 1990s, as governments began to introduce leave policies, it was mainly women who took advantage of them.
sentences.zh: 学者们认为，在 20 世纪 90 年代，随着政府开始引入休假政策，主要是女性利用了这些政策。

sentences.en: Though the leave policies might have helped those women to stay in the workplace——instead of dropping out to have families——those who returned saw their wages had increased at lower rates than the men.
sentences.zh: 尽管休假政策可能会帮助这些女性留在工作场所——而不是为了家庭而辍学，但那些回来的女性发现她们的工资增幅低于男性。

sentences.en: After family leave was introduced in the US, in fact, the rate of gender wage convergence fell to just 0.03 percentage points per year, and has remained there ever since.
sentences.zh: 事实上，在美国实行家事假后，性别工资趋同率每年仅下降0.03个百分点，并一直保持在这一水平。

sentences.en: Those monitoring the process towards salary equity at work have long watched as progress slowed in many countries around the world.
sentences.zh: 那些监控工作中薪资公平进程的人们长期以来一直关注着世界上许多国家的进展放缓。

sentences.en: In fact, that progress began to reverse during the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这一进展在大流行期间开始出现逆转。

sentences.en: The gender pay gap is one of the most outstanding examples of that lack of parity, and still exists just about everywhere.
sentences.zh: 性别薪酬差距是缺乏平等的最突出的例子之一，而且几乎在任何地方仍然存在。

sentences.en: The motherhood penalty has become a shorthand for describing why: In many places, especially rich countries, women earn the same as men until they reach their childbearing years.
sentences.zh: 母性惩罚已成为描述原因的简写：在许多地方，尤其是富裕国家，女性在达到育龄之前的收入与男性相同。
sentences.note: motherhood penalty 指女性因生育和照护责任在薪酬、晋升等方面承受的不利影响；文章中的研究解释不能直接当成普遍因果结论。

sentences.en: Women who have children begin to see their salaries slip behind their male counterparts.
sentences.zh: 有孩子的女性开始发现她们的工资落后于男性。

sentences.en: Part of this is because women take on more of the unpaid labor at home, which can eat into time available for work and energy for career advancement.
sentences.zh: 部分原因在于，女性承担了更多无偿家务劳动，这会挤占她们可用于工作和职业发展的时间与精力。

sentences.en: But it's also because mothers are passed over for raises and promotion, and because time out of the workplace sets women back, even if that time is taken voluntarily, and supported by company or government policy.
sentences.zh: 但另一个原因是，母亲们在加薪和晋升时容易被忽略；而且，离开职场一段时间本身也会让女性落后，即便这段离职是自愿的，并受到公司或政府政策支持。

sentences.en: What would have happened if leave policies hadn't been introduced?
sentences.zh: 如果没有休假政策会怎样？

sentences.en: The study doesn't go into that question, other than to say that if the 1980s trend continued, we would have been at parity by now.
sentences.zh: 这项研究没有讨论这个问题，只是说如果 20 世纪 80 年代的趋势继续下去，我们现在已经处于平等地位了。

sentences.en: It's possible, however, that the journey towards wage parity would have stalled either way.
sentences.zh: 然而，无论哪种方式，实现工资平等的进程都有可能陷入停滞。

sentences.en: If women's gains in the 1980s were made through the erasure of things like bias, once those less uncontrollable problems had been addressed, there would still have been an issue with women——who are the ones to bear children and take care of them in the early weeks because of biological factors like the ability to breastfeed, forcing them to take breaks, whether or not those breaks were mandated.
sentences.zh: 如果说 20 世纪 80 年代女性的进步是通过消除偏见之类的东西来取得的，那么一旦那些不太不可控的问题得到解决，女性仍然会面临一个问题——她们是生孩子的人，并在出生后几周照顾孩子，因为诸如母乳喂养的能力等生物学因素，迫使她们休息，无论这些休息是否是强制性的。

articles.title: Why people seek out horror
articles.subtitle: 我们为何主动观看恐怖片
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Imagine you're an alien sent to Earth to document the behaviour of the mammals inhabiting the planet.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，您是一名外星人，被派到地球来记录居住在地球上的哺乳动物的行为。

sentences.en: You stumble into a movie theatre that's showing the latest Hollywood horror film.
sentences.zh: 你无意中走进一家正在放映最新好莱坞恐怖电影的电影院。

sentences.en: Several dozen humans are gathered together in a dark, undecorated room.
sentences.zh: 几十个人聚集在一个黑暗、未装修的房间里。

sentences.en: They're all staring at a rectangular area on which patterns of light change rapidly.
sentences.zh: 他们都盯着一个矩形区域，上面的光图案快速变化。

sentences.en: They are clearly in a state of high arousal.
sentences.zh: 他们显然处于高度兴奋的状态。

sentences.en: Their heart rate is elevated, they occasionally glance around nervously, and they sometimes jump collectively in their seats, and emit high-pitched warning calls.
sentences.zh: 他们的心率加快，时不时紧张地环顾四周，时而在座位上集体跳动，并发出高亢的警告声。

sentences.en: Eventually, the lights come up and the rectangular screen goes black.
sentences.zh: 最终，灯亮起，矩形屏幕变黑。

sentences.en: The humans stand up and leave the room, chatting and laughing, and showing signs of pleasure.
sentences.zh: 人类起身离开房间，有说有笑，神情愉悦。

sentences.en: Why do these humans voluntarily expose themselves to what appears to be a deeply unpleasant experience?
sentences.zh: 为什么这些人会自愿将自己暴露在看似非常不愉快的经历中？

sentences.en: And why do they react so strongly to those patterns of light on a screen?
sentences.zh: 为什么他们对屏幕上的光图案反应如此强烈？

sentences.en: I am fascinated with the paradox of horror-the strange fact that many people seek out scary entertainment.
sentences.zh: 我对恐怖的悖论着迷——许多人寻求恐怖娱乐的奇怪事实。

sentences.en: I think the answer to the puzzle lies in human nature.
sentences.zh: 我认为这个难题的答案在于人性。

sentences.en: My research suggests that we humans evolved to find pleasure in situations that allow us to experience negative emotions in a safe context.
sentences.zh: 我的研究表明，我们人类进化到在安全的环境中体验负面情绪的情况下寻找快乐。

sentences.en: You can see these elements of horror in children's games.
sentences.zh: 你可以在儿童游戏中看到这些恐怖元素。

sentences.en: Take hide-and-seek for example, which is a simulation of a predator-prey interaction.
sentences.zh: 以捉迷藏为例，这是对捕食者与被捕食者相互作用的模拟。

sentences.en: The kid hides and the adult pretends to be a predator, searching for the child while howling like a dangerous beast.
sentences.zh: 孩子躲起来，大人假装成掠食者，像危险的野兽一样嚎叫着寻找孩子。

sentences.en: This simulation gives the child crucial information about how to avoid becoming prey, and children tend to find that kind of activity deeply satisfying, presumably because it gives them a safe experience of a potentially catastrophic scenario.
sentences.zh: 这种模拟为孩子提供了如何避免成为猎物的重要信息，孩子们往往会发现这种活动非常令人满意，大概是因为它给了他们对潜在灾难性场景的安全体验。

sentences.en: They find it pleasurable, and pleasure is evolution's way of motivating us toward adaptive behaviour.
sentences.zh: 他们觉得这是令人愉快的，而愉悦是进化激励我们采取适应性行为的方式。

sentences.en: Horror is pleasurable to many people because it lets us play with negative emotions and develop coping strategies.
sentences.zh: 恐怖对很多人来说都是令人愉悦的，因为它让我们能够应对负面情绪并制定应对策略。

sentences.en: We learn what it feels like to be truly afraid, and we learn how to handle negative emotion.
sentences.zh: 我们学习真正害怕的感觉，并且学习如何处理负面情绪。

sentences.en: How, then, does horror work?
sentences.zh: 那么，恐怖是如何发挥作用的呢？

sentences.en: My research suggests that horror works by exploiting an ancient set of biological defence mechanisms-an evolved fear system, which we share with other animals.
sentences.zh: 我的研究表明，恐怖是通过利用一套古老的生物防御机制来发挥作用的——一种进化的恐惧系统，我们与其他动物共享这一系统。

sentences.en: But humans are uniquely imaginative, and we use our evolved imagination to travel into virtual worlds that are full of danger.
sentences.zh: 但人类具有独特的想象力，我们利用进化后的想象力进入充满危险的虚拟世界。

sentences.en: There are good reasons for watching a horror film, even if you're not a loyal horror fan.
sentences.zh: 即使您不是忠实的恐怖片粉丝，观看恐怖电影也是有充分理由的。

sentences.en: If you make it through the film in one piece, you'll probably experience a strong sense of mastery, a sense that you were able to make it through an appalling experience.
sentences.zh: 如果你完整地看完了这部电影，你可能会体验到一种强烈的掌控感，一种你能够度过一段可怕经历的感觉。

sentences.en: Anyway, watching a horror film makes you better at handling your own fear, and who knows when that will become critically relevant?
sentences.zh: 无论如何，观看恐怖电影可以让你更好地处理自己的恐惧，谁知道什么时候这会变得至关重要？
sentences.note: handle 指应对、处理。文中讨论安全情境下体验恐惧可能带来的情绪练习。

articles.title: Beauty ideals in the age of social media
articles.subtitle: 社交媒体与不可能的美貌标准
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: An awakening has been taking place in the physical world against the beauty model that has been dictated to us for years.
sentences.zh: 在现实世界中，人们正逐渐觉醒，开始反思多年来被强加给我们的美貌标准。

sentences.en: But in the digital arena, social media determines what is considered beautiful.
sentences.zh: 但在数字领域，社交媒体决定了什么被认为是美丽的。

sentences.en: The two opposing struggles are taking place in parallel.
sentences.zh: 两种对立的斗争正在同时进行。

sentences.en: In the physical world, the struggle goes against the underlying pressure exerted on women to conform to an unrealistic beauty ideal.
sentences.zh: 在物质世界中，这种斗争与女性承受的潜在压力背道而驰，以符合不切实际的美丽理想。
sentences.note: ideal 此处为理想标准。文章把现实中的审美反思，与社交媒体强化的外貌压力联系起来。

sentences.en: As part of the struggle, various media outlets have presented women whose bodies don't correspond to the so-called ideal.
sentences.zh: 作为斗争的一部分，各种媒体都呈现了身体不符合所谓理想的女性。

sentences.en: All those women who had previously been excluded from the covers of magazines, television series and the public agenda, have become "legitimate".
sentences.zh: 所有那些以前被排除在杂志封面、电视剧和公共议程之外的女性，都变得“合法”了。

sentences.en: At the same time, a group of influencers have begun to upload to social media photos of themselves without makeup, and even photos in which they highlight supposed flaws.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，一群有影响力的人开始在社交媒体上上传自己的素颜照片，甚至是强调所谓缺陷的照片。

sentences.en: Technology has reshaped our beauty ideal and is doing a great job communicating that message to the masses.
sentences.zh: 技术重塑了我们的美丽理想，并且在向大众传达这一信息方面做得非常出色。
sentences.note: ideal 此处为理想标准。文章把现实中的审美反思，与社交媒体强化的外貌压力联系起来。

sentences.en: One of the bizarre legacies of the past decade is the popularity of the "cyborg look", which illustrates what Americans will look like in 2050.
sentences.zh: 过去十年的奇异遗产之一是“赛博格造型”的流行，它展示了 2050 年美国人的样子。

sentences.en: The cyborg look spread rapidly.
sentences.zh: 半机械人造型迅速传播。

sentences.en: Today, however, the Instagram face has become the new beauty ideal.
sentences.zh: 然而如今，Instagram 面孔已成为新的美丽理想。
sentences.note: ideal 此处为理想标准。文章把现实中的审美反思，与社交媒体强化的外貌压力联系起来。

sentences.en: The internalization of accepted beauty norms is much more effective when there is active involvement in the learning process.
sentences.zh: 当积极参与学习过程时，公认的美丽规范的内化会更加有效。

sentences.en: The active involvement of users is reflected in the gam i fied interaction offered by the social media platforms-the ability to like, write a comment, compare, share.
sentences.zh: 用户的积极参与体现在社交媒体平台提供的游戏化互动中——点赞、评论、比较、分享的能力。

sentences.en: Once the desired beauty ideal has been internalized, users are given tools or features to change their appearance to suit the accepted beauty ideal such as editing the image, choosing the ideal filter, the right background.
sentences.zh: 一旦所需的美丽理想被内化，用户就会获得工具或功能来改变自己的外观以适应公认的美丽理想，例如编辑图像、选择理想的滤镜、正确的背景。
sentences.note: ideal 此处为理想标准。文章把现实中的审美反思，与社交媒体强化的外貌压力联系起来。

sentences.en: A survey conducted in the United States revealed that more than 50% filter the images before posting them.
sentences.zh: 在美国进行的一项调查显示，超过 50% 的人在发布图片之前会对其进行过滤。

sentences.en: And you will not be surprised to hear that the majority of them are women.
sentences.zh: 听到他们大多数是女性，你不会感到惊讶。

sentences.en: One of the significant consequences of obsessive filtering is the emerging tendency to treat oneself as an object to be observed and valued, in the same way another person observes and judges from the side.
sentences.zh: 强迫性过滤的一个重要后果是，人们开始倾向于将自己视为一个被观察和评价的对象，就像另一个人从侧面观察和判断一样。

sentences.en: The effect of the filters is already far beyond amiable amusement.
sentences.zh: 滤镜的效果已经远远超出了友善的娱乐。

sentences.en: The filters and the entire game played on the networks affect the mental health of the users.
sentences.zh: 网络上的过滤器和整个游戏影响用户的心理健康。

sentences.en: According to a study, apps like Instagram, Snap chat and Face Tune allow users to achieve a level of perfection that was previously only observed in beauty magazines.
sentences.zh: 根据一项研究，Instagram、Snap chat 和 Face Tune 等应用程序可以让用户达到以前只能在美容杂志中观察到的完美水平。

sentences.en: Even though humanity has always cherished beauty, in the last decade our obsession with looks has reached an unprecedented peak.
sentences.zh: 尽管人类历来珍视美丽，但近十年来，我们对外表的痴迷达到了前所未有的顶峰。

sentences.en: The time spent on social media creates an urge to achieve an impossible beauty ideal so powerful that the only thing that can fix it is not cosmetic intervention, but mental health care.
sentences.zh: 花在社交媒体上的时间产生了一种实现不可能的美丽理想的冲动，这种冲动如此强烈，以至于唯一可以解决它的不是美容干预，而是心理健康护理。
sentences.note: ideal 此处为理想标准。文章把现实中的审美反思，与社交媒体强化的外貌压力联系起来。

articles.title: The uncertain future of the countryside
articles.subtitle: 城市之外，乡村走向何方
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: With population increases and global urbanisation ever accelerating, much attention is focused on the sustainability of our cities and scarce attention is paid to the countryside.
sentences.zh: 随着人口的增长和全球城市化进程的不断加快，人们越来越关注城市的可持续性，而很少关注农村。
sentences.note: scarce 表示少、稀缺。全文将对城市的高度关注与对乡村的忽视进行对照。

sentences.en: Rural life is associated with closely-knit communities, sense of belonging, and a simple, tranquil life.
sentences.zh: 乡村生活具有紧密的社区、归属感和简单、宁静的生活。

sentences.en: Yet whilst some or all of these elements exist in the countryside, so do conservatism and a lack of employment opportunities.
sentences.zh: 然而，虽然农村存在部分或全部这些因素，但保守主义和缺乏就业机会也同样存在。

sentences.en: And it is mostly due to the latter that rural communities are suffering.
sentences.zh: 农村社区遭受苦难的主要原因是后者。

sentences.en: Attracted by the improved economics of urban areas, country-dwellers across the world are moving out, contributing to the excessive crowdedness of densely populated cities, and leaving the countryside in desolation.
sentences.zh: 受城市经济改善的吸引，世界各地的乡村居民纷纷外迁，导致人口稠密的城市过于拥挤，乡村一片荒凉。

sentences.en: So how can the countryside ensure its survival among these changes; or should it at all?
sentences.zh: 那么乡村如何在这些变化中保证自己的生存？或者根本应该这样做？

sentences.en: Due to both the distance between residences and facilities and often intermittent public transport, those living in the countryside are heavier automobile users.
sentences.zh: 由于住宅和设施之间的距离以及公共交通经常间歇性，居住在农村的人们是汽车的重度使用者。

sentences.en: Rural dwellers also use more energy maintaining their mostly detached buildings.
sentences.zh: 农村居民还使用更多的能源来维护他们大部分独立的建筑物。

sentences.en: We may be piled up like boxes in the city, but this brings energy efficiency that the countryside cannot match.
sentences.zh: 我们可能像城市里的箱子一样堆起来，但这带来的能源效率是农村无法比拟的。

sentences.en: Rural energy requirements result in higher carbon emissions per person than in the city, so it is actually irresponsible to endorse such a lifestyle choice.
sentences.zh: 农村的能源需求导致人均碳排放量高​​于城市，因此认可这样的生活方式选择实际上是不负责任的。

sentences.en: Protecting the countryside is a hot topic.
sentences.zh: 保护乡村是热门话题。

sentences.en: Those who have made their fortunes in the city often buy second homes in the countryside, visiting intermittently for a sample of a supposedly simple life.
sentences.zh: 那些在城市发家致富的人往往会在乡村购买第二套住房，时不时地去体验一下所谓的简单生活。

sentences.en: The side-effect of this is that house prices are pushed up due to increased demand, leaving them unaffordable for local people.
sentences.zh: 这样做的副作用是，房价因需求增加而推高，让当地人买不起。

sentences.en: A solution has yet to be found for this challenge, for market forces are further forcing residents out of the countryside.
sentences.zh: 这一挑战尚未找到解决方案，因为市场力量正在进一步迫使居民离开农村。

sentences.en: For those who believe in rural preservation, this is deplorable.
sentences.zh: 对于那些相信乡村保护的人来说，这是令人遗憾的。

sentences.en: Whilst an idealised view of the countryside is common, the reality is that rural life has continuously evolved.
sentences.zh: 虽然对乡村的理想化看法很普遍，但现实是乡村生活在不断发展。

sentences.en: Industrialisation brought an increase in divisions of labour, changing social links between rural people.
sentences.zh: 工业化带来了劳动分工的增加，改变了农村人口之间的社会联系。

sentences.en: The internet has introduced once foreign cultures into the countryside.
sentences.zh: 互联网将曾经的外来文化引入乡村。

sentences.en: Improved travel connections and affordability have made the world more accessible, creating a "global village".
sentences.zh: 旅行联系的改善和可负担性的改善使世界变得更容易到达，创造了一个“地球村”。

sentences.en: Considering these changes, surely an evolving countryside is inevitable.
sentences.zh: 考虑到这些变化，农村的不断发展无疑是不可避免的。

sentences.en: Perhaps the countryside should also prepare itself for massive population increases in the future.
sentences.zh: 也许农村也应该为未来人口的大量增长做好准备。

sentences.en: With cities across the world growing rapidly, how will the current urban generation respond to the inevitable social changes of mass urbanisation?
sentences.zh: 随着世界各地城市的快速发展，当前的城市一代将如何应对大规模城市化不可避免的社会变化？

sentences.en: Will the longing for a simpler life become stronger, fueling a rural renaissance?
sentences.zh: 对简单生活的向往是否会更加强烈，推动乡村复兴？

sentences.en: As the world continues to urbanise, the voices calling for rural preservation may well grow louder.
sentences.zh: 随着世界不断城市化，呼吁保护乡村的声音可能会越来越大。

sentences.en: But change is inevitable.
sentences.zh: 但改变是不可避免的。

sentences.en: We know that the world is going to see new cities emerging from the dust and current cities growing into megacities, but the future of the countryside is less clear.
sentences.zh: 我们知道，世界将会看到新的城市从尘埃中崛起，现有的城市将成长为特大城市，但农村的未来却不太明朗。

articles.title: Questioning assumptions about beauty
articles.subtitle: 美是否只在观看者眼中
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Statements, like "beauty is in the eye of the beholder ", are rarely questioned.
sentences.zh: 诸如“美取决于观看者”这样的说法，很少受到质疑。
sentences.note: beauty is in the eye of the beholder 常译为“情人眼里出西施”或“美取决于观看者”，强调审美的主观性。

sentences.en: They've become so embedded in our consciousness that people think it's absurd to think otherwise.
sentences.zh: 它们已经深深地融入我们的意识中，以至于人们认为不这样想是荒谬的。

sentences.en: It might be useful, however, to at least push back on this assumption because people evaluate environment, situations, and people aesthetically.
sentences.zh: 然而，至少推翻这个假设可能是有用的，因为人们从审美角度评估环境、情况和人。

sentences.en: We may find that we still believe it is correct, but we may also find that there is a lot more to the situation than you suppose.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会发现我们仍然相信它是正确的，但我们也可能会发现情况比你想象的要复杂得多。

sentences.en: A recent study exploring aesthetic taste was published in Cognition.
sentences.zh: 最近一项探索审美趣味的研究发表在 Cognition 上。

sentences.en: The results from this study show that people agree very much in their aesthetic evaluation of natural objects, but they disagree more about artifacts, or human-made objects.
sentences.zh: 这项研究的结果表明，人们对自然物体的审美评价非常一致，但对人工制品或人造物体的分歧更大。

sentences.en: The study found that shared taste was most common for faces and natural landscapes, but least common among works of architecture and art.
sentences.zh: 研究发现，共同的品味在面孔和自然景观中最常见，但在建筑和艺术作品中最不常见。

sentences.en: The hypothesis is the commonly pleasing features, like proportion or symmetry, are at work.
sentences.zh: 假设是普遍令人愉悦的特征，如比例或对称性，正在发挥作用。

sentences.en: Preferences for natural scenes might be learned through life experiences.
sentences.zh: 对自然场景的偏好可以通过生活经历来学习。

sentences.en: Factors like habitability, safety, and openness might be preferred as people develop.
sentences.zh: 随着人们的发展，宜居性、安全性和开放性等因素可能会受到青睐。

sentences.en: Some of the details of landscapes change, but the basics are more common, e.g., water, open spaces, and signs of care.
sentences.zh: 景观的一些细节发生了变化，但基本要素更加常见，例如水、开放空间和护理标志。

sentences.en: Art and architecture, unlike natural spaces, do not have the same level of exposure.
sentences.zh: 艺术和建筑与自然空间不同，它们的暴露程度不同。

sentences.en: So, people do not have the same level of shared taste.
sentences.zh: 所以，人们没有相同水平的共同品味。

sentences.en: It's possible that the lower amount of agreement in the shared taste of artifacts has to do more with elements of style, rather than "behavioral consequences".
sentences.zh: 人工制品的共同品味的一致性较低可能更多地与风格元素有关，而不是“行为后果”。

sentences.en: All of the consequences seem reasonable (or at least possible), but I think there might be an interesting philosophical conclusion that they did not draw.
sentences.zh: 所有的后果看起来都是合理的（或者至少是可能的），但我认为可能有一个他们没有得出的有趣的哲学结论。

sentences.en: It seems that there is an objective ground to our aesthetic preferences or evaluations.
sentences.zh: 看来我们的审美偏好或评价是有客观依据的。

sentences.en: I am not saying this would mean beauty is completely objective, just that there could possibly be general objective principles at work, i.e., beauty is not simply in the eye of the beholder.
sentences.zh: 我并不是说这意味着美是完全客观的，只是可能存在一般的客观原则在起作用，即美不只是在观看者的眼中。

sentences.en: Nature exhibits some of the universal aesthetic features, such as radiance, in a common way throughout the world.
sentences.zh: 大自然以全世界共同的方式展现出一些普遍的美学特征，例如光辉。

sentences.en: It's not exactly the same everywhere, but it is common.
sentences.zh: 各地并不完全相同，但很常见。

sentences.en: For example, a sunset is similar enough in different places to warrant almost universal appeal.
sentences.zh: 例如，不同地方的日落足够相似，足以保证几乎具有普遍吸引力。

sentences.en: Possible universal principles of beauty—such as proportion, fittingness, radiance, and others—are general categories, which allow for a wide array of embodiments.
sentences.zh: 美的可能的普遍原则——例如比例、合身性、光泽度等——是一般类别，允许有各种各样的实施例。

sentences.en: When people get involved in making artifacts in architecture or art, they apply these very general concepts in unique ways.
sentences.zh: 当人们参与建筑或艺术制品的制作时，他们会以独特的方式应用这些非常普遍的概念。

sentences.en: But the way they applied the principle may not have universal appeal.
sentences.zh: 但他们应用该原则的方式可能并不具有普遍吸引力。

sentences.en: This is why it's important to experience diverse cultures and their artifacts because it opens us up to different ways of approaching or constructing beauty.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么体验不同的文化及其文物很重要，因为它为我们打开了接近或构建美的不同方式。

sentences.en: And it is always good to question our assumptions.
sentences.zh: 质疑我们的假设总是好的。

articles.title: The myth of left-brain and right-brain types
articles.subtitle: 左右脑人格测试可靠吗
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: There are hundreds of personality quizzes online that assert they can ascertain whether the right or left half of your brain is dominant.
sentences.zh: 网上有数百个性格测验，声称它们可以确定您的右半脑或左半脑是否占主导地位。

sentences.en: Left-brained people are supposedly logical and excel at language and math while right-brained people are more imaginative, emotionally intelligent and skilled with spatial reasoning.
sentences.zh: 左脑型的人被认为逻辑性强，擅长语言和数学，而右脑型的人则更具想象力、情商和空间推理能力。

sentences.en: There's just one problem: That's not how brains work.
sentences.zh: 只有一个问题：大脑不是这样工作的。

sentences.en: Popular science enthusiasts sort of took this idea and ran with it, and it's become woven in popular culture now, and it's not going away.
sentences.zh: 科普爱好者接受了这个想法并付诸实践，它现在已经融入流行文化中，而且不会消失。

sentences.en: Despite this enduring belief, there's no such thing as being "right-brained" or "left-brained".
sentences.zh: 尽管有这个持久的信念，但并不存在“右脑”或“左脑”之类的东西。

sentences.en: Whether you're someone who tends more towards creativity or logic has nothing to do with one hemisphere of your brain being dominant over the other.
sentences.zh: 无论你是更倾向于创造力还是更倾向于逻辑，与你大脑的一个半球是否优于另一个半球无关。

sentences.en: But the actual science of how the two halves of our brains work together is sometimes stranger than fiction.
sentences.zh: 但是，关于我们大脑的两半部分如何协同工作的实际科学有时比小说更奇怪。

sentences.en: The human brain is divided into two hemispheres, the left and right.
sentences.zh: 人脑分为左右两个半球。

sentences.en: In all vertebrate animals, the right hemisphere controls the left side of the body and vice versa.
sentences.zh: 在所有脊椎动物中，右半球控制身体的左侧，反之亦然。

sentences.en: And scientists have long known, thanks to the behaviors of patients who suffered brain injuries, that different areas of the brain do different things.
sentences.zh: 科学家们早就知道，由于脑损伤患者的行为，大脑的不同区域会做不同的事情。

sentences.en: But many scientists struggled with this idea, because the very suggestion that the left and right halves of the brain operate differently disrupted the idea that nature tends toward perfect symmetry.
sentences.zh: 但是许多科学家对这个想法感到困惑，因为大脑的左右半部分以不同的方式运作的建议破坏了自然趋于完美对称的想法。

sentences.en: Work by neuroscientists has revealed the importance of different hemispheres of the brain for different activities.
sentences.zh: 神经科学家的工作揭示了大脑不同半球对于不同活动的重要性。

sentences.en: However, their research quickly saw some misinterpretations in the general public: Some presumed creative people must be right-brained and logical people left-brained.
sentences.zh: 然而，他们的研究很快就引起了公众的一些误解：一些假定的富有创造力的人必须是右脑型的，而逻辑型的人必须是左脑型的。

sentences.en: It is proven that not only is personality unrelated to the different halves of the brain, but people aren't really right- or left-brained to begin with.
sentences.zh: 事实证明，人格不仅与大脑的不同半球无关，而且人们一开始就不是真正的右脑或左脑。

sentences.en: The idea that we have left-dominant people and right-dominant people, and that this is related to personality, is categorically false.
sentences.zh: 认为我们有左主导的人和右主导的人，并且这与性格有关的想法是绝对错误的。

sentences.en: That's never been supported in the neuroscience community.
sentences.zh: 这在神经科学界从未得到支持。

sentences.en: Neuroscientists don't believe that and never have.
sentences.zh: 神经科学家不相信这一点，也从未相信过。

sentences.en: What scientists learned is that there are really important differences between the left hemisphere and the right hemisphere.
sentences.zh: 科学家了解到，左半球和右半球之间确实存在重要差异。

sentences.en: It's just that they have nothing to do with personality or whether cognitive strategy is more logical or free spirited or creative.
sentences.zh: 只是它们与个性无关，也与认知策略是否更具逻辑性、自由精神或创造性无关。

sentences.en: While researchers have shown the limitations of how the hemispheres of our brains influence our lives, it's not difficult to understand the appeal of such ideas.
sentences.zh: 虽然研究人员已经证明了大脑半球影响我们生活的局限性，但不难理解这些想法的吸引力。

sentences.en: People are endlessly fascinated by themselves and their friends, and the subtle differences in how people think about the world are really meaningful to them.
sentences.zh: 人们对自己和朋友有着无尽的着迷，人们看待世界的细微差别对他们来说确实很有意义。

sentences.en: When you come up with an online quiz that tells us something about ourselves, we're drawn to that.
sentences.zh: 当你想出一个在线测验来告诉我们一些关于我们自己的事情时，我们就会被它吸引。

sentences.en: It's irresistible.
sentences.zh: 这是不可抗拒的。

sentences.en: But you have to take it with an enormous grain of salt.
sentences.zh: 但你必须对这类说法抱有极大的保留和怀疑。
sentences.note: take something with a grain of salt 意为对其持保留、怀疑态度；enormous 进一步加强这种怀疑。

articles.title: A new model of team teaching
articles.subtitle: 一间大教室里的协作教学
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: One hundred thirty-five students, four teachers, one giant classroom: This is what 9th grade looks like at Westwood High School, in Mesa, Arizona's largest school system.
sentences.zh: 一百三十五名学生，四名教师，一间巨大的教室：这就是韦斯特伍德高中九年级的样子，该高中位于亚利桑那州梅萨最大的学校系统。

sentences.en: There, an innovative teaching model has taken hold, and is spreading to other schools in the district and beyond.
sentences.zh: 在那里，一种创新的教学模式已经形成，并正在推广到该地区及其他地区的其他学校。

sentences.en: Five years ago, faced with high teacher turnover and declining student enrollment, Westwood's leaders decided to try something different.
sentences.zh: 五年前，面对教师流失率高和学生入学率下降的情况，Westwood 的领导者决定尝试不同的做法。

sentences.en: Working with professors at Arizona State University's teachers college, they piloted a classroom model known as team teaching, which allows teachers to dissolve the walls that separate their classes across physical or grade divides.
sentences.zh: 他们与亚利桑那州立大学师范学院的教授合作，试点了一种称为团队教学的课堂模式，该模式允许教师消除物理或年级分隔班级的墙壁。

sentences.en: The teachers share large groups of students-sometimes 100 or more-and rotate between group instruction, one-on-one interventions, small study groups, or whatever the teachers as a team agree is a priority that day.
sentences.zh: 教师们与一大群学生（有时 100 名或更多）一起轮流进行小组教学、一对一干预、小型学习小组或教师团队一致同意的当天优先事项。

sentences.en: What looks at times like chaos is in fact a carefully orchestrated plan: Each morning, the Westwood teams meet to hammer out a personalized program for every student the team will focus on that day.
sentences.zh: 有时看似混乱的事情实际上是一个精心策划的计划：每天早上，Westwood 团队都会开会，为团队当天要关注的每个学生制定个性化计划。

sentences.en: By giving teachers more opportunity to collaborate, Mesa's administrators hoped to fill staffing gaps and boost teacher morale and retention.
sentences.zh: 梅萨的管理人员希望通过为教师提供更多合作机会来填补人员缺口并提高教师士气和保留率。

sentences.en: Initial research suggests the gamble could pay off.
sentences.zh: 初步研究表明，这场赌博可能会得到回报。

sentences.en: "Teachers are doing fantastic things, but it's very rare a teacher walks into another room to see what's happening," said Andi Fourlis, superintendent of Mesa Public Schools.
sentences.zh: 梅萨公立学校的校长安迪·福利斯 (Andi Fourlis) 说：“老师们正在做着很棒的事情，但很少有老师走进另一个房间来看看发生了什么。”

sentences.en: "Our profession is so slow to advance because we are working in isolation."
sentences.zh: “我们的职业发展如此缓慢，因为我们是孤立工作的。”

sentences.en: Of course, overhauling teaching approaches can't fix all the frustrations teachers have, such as low pay, but early results from Mesa show team teaching may be helping to reverse low morale.
sentences.zh: 当然，彻底改革教学方法并不能解决教师所面临的所有挫折，例如工资低，但梅萨的早期结果显示团队教学可能有助于扭转低落的士气。

sentences.en: In a survey of hundreds of the district's teachers, researchers found those who worked on teams reported greater job satisfaction, more frequent collaborations with colleagues, and more positive interactions with students.
sentences.zh: 在对该学区数百名教师的调查中，研究人员发现，那些在团队中工作的教师报告了更高的工作满意度、与同事的更频繁的合作以及与学生的更积极的互动。

sentences.en: Another benefit of teams, teachers say, is that they can help each other improve their instruction.
sentences.zh: 老师们说，团队的另一个好处是他们可以互相帮助改进教学。

sentences.en: During one planning session, English teacher Jeff Hall shared a performance appraisal with a science teacher: Her recent lecture on something she called "the central dogma of biology" had bewildered him and their other teammates.
sentences.zh: 在一次计划会议上，英语老师 Jeff Hall 与一位科学老师分享了一次绩效评估：她最近关于她所谓的“生物学中心教条”的讲座让他和其他队友感到困惑。

sentences.en: "If the science is too confusing for me, can you imagine the frustration you feel as kids?"
sentences.zh: “如果科学对我来说太令人困惑，你能想象你小时候感受到的挫败感吗？”

sentences.en: Hall said.
sentences.zh: 霍尔说。

sentences.en: But the science teacher, he said, wouldn't have known about the confusion on her own.
sentences.zh: 但他说，科学老师自己不会知道这种混乱。

sentences.en: The model is not for everyone.
sentences.zh: 该模型并不适合所有人。

sentences.en: Some teachers approached about volunteering for a team have said they prefer to work alone.
sentences.zh: 一些寻求团队志愿服务的老师表示，他们更喜欢单独工作。

sentences.en: Team teaching can also be a scheduling nightmare, especially at schools like Westwood where only some staff work in teams.
sentences.zh: 团队教学也可能是日程安排的噩梦，尤其是在 Westwood 这样的学校，那里只有一些员工以团队形式工作。

sentences.en: There are also thorny questions like how to evaluate four teachers on the performance of 135 students.
sentences.zh: 还有一些棘手的问题，比如如何评价四位老师对135名学生的表现。

sentences.en: But for the time being, it seems to be working.
sentences.zh: 但目前来看，似乎有效。
sentences.note: for the time being 表示目前、暂时；作者对新模式的成效作出有限度的判断。

articles.title: Safety, competence and intervention
articles.subtitle: 安全工作为何需要监督
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.sourceFile: 2024年6月第1套英语六级真题【推荐使用PDF版】.docx
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: It is irrefutable that employees know the difference between right and wrong.
sentences.zh: 员工知道是非，这是无可辩驳的。

sentences.en: So why don't more employees intervene when they see someone exhibiting at-risk behavior in the workplace?
sentences.zh: 那么，当看到有人在工作场所表现出危险行为时，为什么没有更多的员工进行干预呢？

sentences.en: There are a number of factors that influence whether people intervene.
sentences.zh: 影响人们是否干预的因素有很多。

sentences.en: First, they need to be able to see a risky situation beginning to unfold.
sentences.zh: 首先，他们需要能够看到危险情况开始显现。

sentences.en: Second, the company's culture needs to make them feel safe to speak up.
sentences.zh: 其次，公司文化需要让他们感到可以安全地畅所欲言。

sentences.en: And third, they need to have the communication skills to say something effectively.
sentences.zh: 第三，他们需要具备有效表达能力的沟通技巧。

sentences.en: This is not strictly a workplace problem; it's a growing problem off the job too.
sentences.zh: 这并不是严格意义上的工作场所问题；这在工作之外也是一个日益严重的问题。

sentences.en: Every day people witness things on the street and choose to stand idly by.
sentences.zh: 每天都有人在街上目睹事情，却选择袖手旁观。

sentences.en: This is known as the bystander effect—the more people who witness an event, the less likely anyone in that group is to help the victim.
sentences.zh: 这被称为旁观者效应——目击事件的人越多，该群体中帮助受害者的可能性就越小。

sentences.en: The psychology behind this is called diffusion of responsibility.
sentences.zh: 这背后的心理学称为责任扩散。

sentences.en: Basically, the larger the crowd, the more people assume that someone else will take care of it—meaning no one effectively intervenes or acts in a moment of need.
sentences.zh: 基本上，人群越多，就越多的人认为其他人会处理这件事——这意味着没有人在需要的时候有效干预或采取行动。

sentences.en: This crowd mentality is strong enough for people to evade their known responsibilities.
sentences.zh: 这种从众心态足以让人们逃避自己已知的责任。

sentences.en: But it's not only frontline workers who don't make safety interventions in the workplace.
sentences.zh: 但不只是一线工人不在工作场所进行安全干预。

sentences.en: There are also instances where supervisors do not intervene either.
sentences.zh: 也有主管不干预的情况。

sentences.en: When a group of employees sees unsafe behavior not being addressed at a leadership level it creates the precedent that this is how these situations should be addressed, thus defining the safety culture for everyone.
sentences.zh: 当一群员工发现领导层没有解决不安全行为时，就会开创先例，表明这些情况应该如何解决，从而为每个人定义安全文化。

sentences.en: Despite the fact that workers are encouraged to intervene when they observe unsafe operations, this happens less than half of the time.
sentences.zh: 尽管鼓励工人在观察到不安全操作时进行干预，但这种情况发生的情况还不到一半。

sentences.en: Fear is the ultimate factor in not intervening.
sentences.zh: 恐惧是不干预的最终因素。

sentences.en: There is a fear of penalty, a fear that they'll have to do more work if they intervene.
sentences.zh: 人们担心受到惩罚，担心如果他们干预，他们将不得不做更多的工作。

sentences.en: Unsuccessful attempts in the past are another strong contributing factor to why people don't intervene—they tend to prefer to defer that action to someone else for all future situations.
sentences.zh: 过去不成功的尝试是人们不干预的另一个重要因素——他们倾向于在未来的所有情况下将这一行动推迟给其他人。

sentences.en: On many worksites, competent workers must be appointed.
sentences.zh: 在许多工作场所，必须任命有能力的工人。
sentences.note: competent 在职业安全语境中指具备相应知识、技能和判断力的，不能只理解为工作表现好。

sentences.en: Part of their job is to intervene when workers perform a task without the proper equipment or if the conditions are unsafe.
sentences.zh: 他们的部分工作是在工人在没有适当设备的情况下执行任务或条件不安全时进行干预。

sentences.en: Competent workers are also required to stop work from continuing when there's a danger.
sentences.zh: 当出现危险时，合格的工人也必须停止继续工作。
sentences.note: competent 在职业安全语境中指具备相应知识、技能和判断力的，不能只理解为工作表现好。

sentences.en: Supervisors also play a critical role.
sentences.zh: 主管也发挥着关键作用。

sentences.en: Even if a competent person isn't required, supervisors need a broad set of skills to not only identify and alleviate workplace hazards but also build a safety climate within their team that supports intervening and open communication among them.
sentences.zh: 即使不需要有能力的人员，主管也需要广泛的技能，不仅可以识别和减轻工作场所危险，而且可以在团队内部建立一个安全氛围，支持他们之间的干预和开放沟通。
sentences.note: competent 在职业安全语境中指具备相应知识、技能和判断力的，不能只理解为工作表现好。

sentences.en: Beyond competent workers and supervisors, it's important to educate everyone within the organization that they are obliged to intervene if they witness a possible unsafe act, whether you're a designated competent person, a supervisor or a frontline worker
sentences.zh: 除了有能力的工人和主管之外，重要的是教育组织内的每个人，如果他们目睹了可能的不安全行为，他们有义务进行干预，无论您是指定的有能力的人员、主管还是一线工人
sentences.note: competent 在职业安全语境中指具备相应知识、技能和判断力的，不能只理解为工作表现好。

articles.title: Environmentalism and energy choices
articles.subtitle: 环保主义与能源选择
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.sourceFile: 2024年6月第1套英语六级真题【推荐使用PDF版】.docx
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: The term “environmentalist” can mean different things.
sentences.zh: “环保主义者”一词可以有不同的含义。
sentences.note: 同一个标签可能对应不同的价值取向。比较排放数据时要注意降幅大小，而不是把下降得更慢理解成排放更少。

sentences.en: It used to refer to people trying to protect wildlife and natural ecosystems.
sentences.zh: 过去指人们努力保护野生动物和自然生态系统。

sentences.en: In the 21st century, the term has evolved to capture the need to combat human-made climate change The distinction between these two strands of environmentalism is the cause of a split within the scientific community about nuclear energy On one side are purists who believe nuclear power isn't worth the risk and the exclusive solution to the climate crisis is renewable energy.
sentences.zh: 到了 21 世纪，这个术语已经演变为反映应对人为气候变化的需要。这两种环保主义之间的区别是科学界内部关于核能的分歧的原因。一方面是纯粹主义者，他们认为核电不值得冒险，而解决气候危机的唯一解决方案是可再生能源。

sentences.en: The opposing side agrees that renewables are crucial, but says society needs an amount of power available to meet consumers'basic demands when the sun isn't shining and the wind isn't blowing.
sentences.zh: 反对方同意可再生能源至关重要，但表示社会需要足够的电力来满足消费者在没有阳光和风时的基本需求。

sentences.en: Nuclear energy, being far cleaner than oil, gas and coal, is a natural option, especially where hydroelectric capacity is limited Leon Clarke, who helped author reports for the UN's Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change, isn't an uncritical supporter of nuclear energy, but says it's a valuable option to have if we're serious about reaching carbon neutrality.
sentences.zh: 核能比石油、天然气和煤炭清洁得多，是一种自然的选择，特别是在水力发电能力有限的情况下。帮助撰写联合国政府间气候变化专门委员会报告的莱昂·克拉克并不是核能的不加批判的支持者，但他表示，如果我们认真实现碳中和，那么它是一个有价值的选择。

sentences.en: “Core to all of this is the degree to which you think we can actually meet climate goals with 100% renewables,” he said.
sentences.zh: “这一切的核心是你认为我们能够在多大程度上利用 100% 可再生能源真正实现气候目标，”他说。

sentences.en: “If you don't believe we can do it, and you care about the climate, you are forced to think about something like nuclear.”
sentences.zh: “如果你不相信我们能做到这一点，并且你关心气候，那么你就被迫考虑像核能这样的东西。”

sentences.en: The achievability of universal 100% renewability is similarly contentious.
sentences.zh: 普遍 100% 可再生性的实现同样存在争议。

sentences.en: Cities such as Burlington, Vermont, have been “100% renewable” for years.
sentences.zh: 佛蒙特州伯灵顿等城市多年来一直“100% 可再生”。

sentences.en: But these cities often have small populations, occasionally still rely on fossil fuel energy and have significant renewable resources at their immediate disposal.
sentences.zh: 但这些城市通常人口较少，偶尔仍依赖化石燃料能源，并且拥有大量可立即使用的可再生资源。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, countries that manage to run off renewables typically do so thanks to extraordinary hydroelectric capabilities.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，能够利用可再生能源的国家通常要归功于非凡的水力发电能力。

sentences.en: Germany stands as the best case study for a large, industrialized country pushing into green energy Chancellor Angela Merkel in 2011 announced Energiewende, an energy transition that would phase out nuclear and coal while phasing in renewables.
sentences.zh: 德国是推动绿色能源发展的工业化大国的最佳案例。德国总理安格拉·默克尔 (Angela Merkel) 于 2011 年宣布了能源转型，这是一项能源转型，将逐步淘汰核电和煤炭，同时逐步采用可再生能源。

sentences.en: Wind and solar power generation has increased over 400% since 2010, and renewables provided 46% of the country's electricity in 2019.
sentences.zh: 自2010年以来，风能和太阳能发电量增长了400%以上，2019年可再生能源提供了该国电力的46%。

sentences.en: But progress has halted in recent years.
sentences.zh: 但近年来进展已经停止。

sentences.en: The instability of renewables doesn't just mean energy is often not produced at night, but also that solar and wind can overwhelm the grid during the day, forcing utilities to pay customers to use their electricity.
sentences.zh: 可再生能源的不稳定不仅意味着能源通常不会在夜间产生，而且太阳能和风能可能会在白天压垮电网，迫使公用事业公司向客户付费以使用其电力。

sentences.en: Lagging grid infrastructure struggles to transport this overabundance of green energy from Germany's north to its industrial south, meaning many factories still run on coal and gas.
sentences.zh: 落后的电网基础设施难以将过剩的绿色能源从德国北部输送到工业南部，这意味着许多工厂仍然依靠煤炭和天然气运行。

sentences.en: The political limit has also been reached in some places, with citizens meeting the construction of new wind turbines with loud protests.
sentences.zh: 一些地方也达到了政治极限，民众对新建风力发电机组的建设提出了强烈抗议。

sentences.en: The result is that Germany's greenhouse gas emissions have fallen by around 11.5% since 2010—slower than the EU average of 13.5%.
sentences.zh: 结果是，自 2010 年以来，德国的温室气体排放量下降了约 11.5%，低于欧盟 13.5% 的平均水平。

articles.title: The American Dream and opportunity
articles.subtitle: 美国梦与成功叙事
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.sourceFile: 2024年6月第2套英语六级真题【推荐使用PDF版】.docx
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: The “American Dream” promises that in the Land of Opportunity, any individual can climb the economic ladder and prosper through hard work and ambition alone.
sentences.zh: “美国梦”承诺，在机遇之地，任何个人都可以通过努力工作和雄心壮志攀登经济阶梯并走向繁荣。

sentences.en: And yet, young Americans today are struggling to earn more than their parents did at the same age, and upward mobility in the US actually compares unfavourably to that of other industrialised nations.
sentences.zh: 然而，今天的美国年轻人正在努力挣得比他们的父母在同龄时更多的钱，而且美国的向上流动性实际上与其他工业化国家相比并不理想。

sentences.en: So why does the idea of the American Dream persist?
sentences.zh: 那么，为什么美国梦的理念能够持续存在呢？

sentences.en: A new study in the American Journal of Political Science identifies one factor that has been overlooked: the influence of reality TV.
sentences.zh: 《美国政治学杂志》上的一项新研究发现了一个被忽视的因素：真人秀的影响。

sentences.en: Reality shows have come to dominate US television over the past 20 years, notes Eunji Kim from Vanderbilt University.
sentences.zh: 范德比尔特大学的 Eunji Kim 指出，过去 20 年真人秀节目已在美国电视界占据主导地位。

sentences.en: And the overwhelming majority of these have a “rags-to-riches” storyline: they feature ordinary Americans who work hard to achieve great economic success.
sentences.zh: 其中绝大多数都有一个“白手起家”的故事情节：它们的主角是普通美国人，他们努力工作以取得巨大的经济成功。

sentences.en: And while these programmes are regularly among the most-watched shows, news broadcasts—which paint amore realistic view of the economic hardship faced by millions of Americans—get a much smaller proportion of the viewership Rags-to-riches stories are ubiquitouson TV—but does watching these programmes actually convince people that economic mobility is easily attainable?
sentences.zh: 虽然这些节目通常是收视率最高的节目，但新闻广播（对数百万美国人所面临的经济困难进行了更现实的描述）的收视率却要小得多。白手起家的故事在电视上随处可见，但观看这些节目是否真的能让人们相信经济流动性是容易实现的？

sentences.en: To find out, Kim's team had participants watch a 5-minute clip from a reality show with a rags-to-riches storyline.
sentences.zh: 为了找出答案，Kim 的团队让参与者观看了一段 5 分钟的真人秀片段，其中讲述了白手起家的故事情节。

sentences.en: Control participants watched a clip from a reality show that didn't have a rags-to-riches story.
sentences.zh: 对照组参与者观看了真人秀节目的剪辑，该节目没有白手起家的故事。

sentences.en: After watching the shows, participants rated how much they agreed with four statements relating to the American Dream The results showed that those who'd watched a rags-to-riches clip did indeed have a significantly greater belief in the American Dream.
sentences.zh: 观看节目后，参与者评估了他们对与美国梦有关的四个陈述的同意程度。结果显示，那些看过白手起家剪辑的人确实对美国梦有明显更大的信念。

sentences.en: Interestingly, when participants were separated by party affiliation, this effect was significant among Republicans but not Democrats, suggesting that the kind of messages implicit in these TV shows may play into people's existing socioeconomic beliefs.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，当参与者按党派关系分开时，这种效应在共和党人中显着，但在民主党人中则不然，这表明这些电视节目中隐含的信息可能会影响人们现有的社会经济信仰。

sentences.en: Kim also conducted a survey of 3,000 US residents.
sentences.zh: Kim还对3000名美国居民进行了调查。

sentences.en: They also rated the extent to which they believed success in life is related to various internal factors (such as ambition)and external factors (such as family wealth).
sentences.zh: 他们还评估了他们认为生活中的成功与各种内部因素（例如野心）和外部因素（例如家庭财富）相关的程度。

sentences.en: Finally, they read a list of TV programmes and indicated which they regularly watched.
sentences.zh: 最后，他们阅读了一份电视节目列表并指出了他们经常观看的节目。

sentences.en: Participants who were heavy viewers of rags-to-riches programmes or frequent viewers had a stronger belief in the American Dream than those who never watched such shows.
sentences.zh: 经常观看白手起家节目的参与者比那些从未观看过此类节目的参与者对美国梦有更强烈的信念。

sentences.en: Kim concludes that “rags-to-riches entertainment media are an important cultural force that promotes and perpetuates beliefs in upward mobility”.
sentences.zh: Kim 的结论是，“白手起家的娱乐媒体是促进和延续向上流动信念的重要文化力量”。

sentences.en: And here's the problem: if people mistakenly believe that hard work is all that is needed for individuals to make a better life for themselves, they may be less supportive of policies that could actually combat inequality.
sentences.zh: 问题是：如果人们错误地认为，个人只需要努力工作就能过上更好的生活，他们可能不太支持真正消除不平等的政策。

sentences.en: “In this era of choice, entertainment media are what captures hearts and minds,” Kim writes.
sentences.zh: “在这个选择的时代，娱乐媒体才是俘获人心的东西，”金写道。

sentences.en: “Its political consequences are anything but trivial”.
sentences.zh: “其政治后果绝非微不足道”。
sentences.note: anything but trivial 表示绝非无关紧要。economic ladder 是经济地位逐步上升的比喻。

articles.title: Identity beyond an occupation
articles.subtitle: 你的身份不只是一份工作
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.sourceFile: 2024年6月第2套英语六级真题【推荐使用PDF版】.docx
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: When someone asks us 'what do you do?'we nearly always reply with our occupation.
sentences.zh: 当有人问我们“你是做什么的？”时，我们几乎总是回答我们的职业。

sentences.en: Work, for many of us, is much more than a job.
sentences.zh: 对于我们许多人来说，工作不仅仅是一份工作。

sentences.en: It is the defining aspect of our identity.
sentences.zh: 这是我们身份的定义方面。

sentences.en: For many of us it is through our job that we can define ourselves.
sentences.zh: 对于我们许多人来说，我们可以通过工作来定义自己。

sentences.en: “Without my job I don't know who I am,” is a sentence that has been uttered on more than a handful of occasions from my office chair.
sentences.zh: “没有工作，我不知道我是谁”，这句话在我的办公椅上不止一次说过。

sentences.en: Indeed, it can be one of the most challenging aspects I work on with clients who have lost or been forced into changing their jobs.
sentences.zh: 事实上，这可能是我与失去工作或被迫换工作的客户合作的最具挑战性的方面之一。

sentences.en: This loss provokes an identity crisis much greater than the loss of the job itself.
sentences.zh: 这种损失引发的身份危机比失去工作本身还要严重得多。

sentences.en: One of the things I have come to understand, however, is that our identity is much more complex than we recognise at first glance.
sentences.zh: 然而，我逐渐明白的一件事是，我们的身份比我们乍一看要复杂得多。

sentences.en: If we take the time to reflect we might recognise that as well as our work we can also identify as a friend, a spouse, a son or daughter, a parent, a member of a sports team or religious community.
sentences.zh: 如果我们花时间反思，我们可能会认识到，除了工作之外，我们还可以将自己视为朋友、配偶、儿子或女儿、父母、运动队或宗教团体的成员。

sentences.en: We may recognise that we feel and act differently in these roles and relationships than we do at work.
sentences.zh: 我们可能会认识到，我们在这些角色和关系中的感受和行为与工作中的不同。

sentences.en: The passive daughter becomes an assertive leader at work.
sentences.zh: 被动的女儿成为工作中自信的领导者。

sentences.en: Furthermore, our identities at work are not static.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们在工作中的身份并不是一成不变的。

sentences.en: They change over time.
sentences.zh: 它们随着时间的推移而改变。

sentences.en: I myself have been a shop assistant, a waitress, a student, a graduate, and a clinical psychologist.
sentences.zh: 我自己当过店员、服务员、学生、毕业生、临床心理学家。

sentences.en: At each stage my ability to adapt to and develop my career identity has been crucial to my wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 在每个阶段，我适应和发展职业身份的能力对我的幸福至关重要。

sentences.en: Whilst we like to eliminate uncertainty in our lives at some level we have to manage uncertainty, especially in today's volatile and ever-shifting job market.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们希望在某种程度上消除生活中的不确定性，但我们必须管理不确定性，特别是在当今动荡且不断变化的就业市场中。

sentences.en: How we see ourselves is central to the issue of our identity.
sentences.zh: 我们如何看待自己是我们身份问题的核心。

sentences.en: When we tell ourselves “I'm good at starting projects but not so great at seeing them through” it can become part of our belief system.
sentences.zh: 当我们告诉自己“我擅长启动项目，但不太擅长完成项目”时，它可以成为我们信念体系的一部分。

sentences.en: But if you have the unfortunate experience of an enforced job change you will need to examine those beliefs to see how grounded in reality they are.
sentences.zh: 但是，如果您有过被迫换工作的不幸经历，您将需要检查这些信念，看看它们在现实中的基础如何。

sentences.en: You will be required to ask yourself how helpful these beliefs are and consider personal change We can change our beliefs, behaviours and emotional experience at any time through experimentation, practice and conscious self-discipline.
sentences.zh: 你将被要求问自己这些信念有多大帮助，并考虑个人改变。我们可以通过实验、实践和有意识的自律随时改变我们的信念、行为和情感体验。

sentences.en: In an age where career progression may lead us into new sectors it is ever more important to challenge our sense of self and explore whether you can create a new experience of your identity by changing the beliefs you hold about yourself in order to expand your career options.
sentences.zh: 在职业发展可能引导我们进入新领域的时代，挑战自我意识并探索是否可以通过改变对自己的信念来创造新的身份体验以扩大职业选择变得更加重要。

sentences.en: Ultimately it is you who define who you are.
sentences.zh: 最终是你自己决定了你是谁。

sentences.en: You are only your job if you let it be so.
sentences.zh: 只有当你任由工作来定义自己时，你才会等同于自己的那份工作。
sentences.note: if 引导条件从句。末句强调只有任由工作定义自己时，工作才会成为全部身份。

articles.title: Understanding sarcasm
articles.subtitle: 讽刺为何尖刻又难以定义
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.sourceFile: 2024年6月第3套英语六级真题【推荐使用PDF版】.docx
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Sarcasm and jazz have something surprisingly in common: You know them when you hear them.
sentences.zh: 讽刺与爵士乐有个出人意料的共同点：一听到，你就知道它是什么。

sentences.en: Sarcasm is mostly understood through tone of voice, which is used to portray the opposite of the literal words.
sentences.zh: 讽刺主要是通过语气来理解的，用来描绘与字面意思相反的意思。

sentences.en: For example, when someone says,“Well, that's exactly what I need right now,” their tone can tell you it's not what they need at all.
sentences.zh: 例如，当有人说“嗯，这正是我现在需要的”时，他们的语气可以告诉您这根本不是他们需要的。

sentences.en: Most frequently, sarcasm highlights an irritation or is, quite simply, mean If you want to be happier and improve your relationships, cut out sarcasm.
sentences.zh: 最常见的是，讽刺会凸显一种刺激，或者很简单，意味着刻薄。如果您想更快乐并改善人际关系，请停止讽刺。

sentences.en: Why?
sentences.zh: 为什么？

sentences.en: Because sarcasm is actually hostility disguised as humor.
sentences.zh: 因为讽刺实际上是伪装成幽默的敌意。

sentences.en: Despite smiling outwardly, many people who receive sarcastic comments feel put down and often think the sarcastic person is rude, or contemptible.
sentences.zh: 尽管表面上微笑，但许多收到讽刺评论的人会感到沮丧，并常常认为讽刺的人很粗鲁或可鄙。

sentences.en: Indeed, it's not surprising that the origin of the word sarcasm derives from the Greek word “sarkazein” which literally means “to tear or strip the flesh off.”
sentences.zh: 事实上，讽刺这个词的起源源于希腊语“sarkazein”，字面意思是“撕扯或剥掉肉体”，这并不奇怪。

sentences.en: Hence, it's no wonder that sarcasm is often preceded by the word “cutting” and that it hurts.
sentences.zh: 因此，毫不奇怪，讽刺前面经常出现“切割”这个词，而且很伤人。

sentences.en: What's more, since actions strongly determine thoughts and feelings, when a person consistently acts sarcastically it may only serve to heighten their underlying hostility and insecurity.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，由于行为在很大程度上决定了思想和感受，当一个人持续表现出讽刺时，可能只会加剧他们潜在的敌意和不安全感。

sentences.en: After all, when you come right down to it, sarcasm can be used as a subtle form of bullying—and most bullies are angry, insecure, or cowardly.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，归根结底，讽刺可以被用作一种微妙的欺凌形式，而且大多数欺凌者都是愤怒、缺乏安全感或胆怯的。

sentences.en: Alternatively, when a person stops voicing negative comments, especially sarcastic ones, they may soon start to feel happier and more self-confident.
sentences.zh: 或者，当一个人停止发表负面评论，尤其是讽刺性评论时，他们可能很快就会开始感到更快乐、更自信。

sentences.en: Also, other people in their life benefit even more because they no longer have to hear the emotionally hurtful language of sarcasm.
sentences.zh: 此外，生活中的其他人受益更多，因为他们不再需要听到情感上受到伤害的讽刺语言。

sentences.en: Now, I'm not saying all sarcasm is bad.
sentences.zh: 现在，我并不是说所有讽刺都是不好的。

sentences.en: It may just be better used sparingly—like a potent spice in cooking.
sentences.zh: 它可能只是少量使用更好——就像烹饪中的强力香料一样。

sentences.en: Too much of the spice, and the dish will be overwhelmed by it.
sentences.zh: 香料太多，菜品就会被淹没。

sentences.en: Similarly, an occasional dash of sarcastic wit can spice up a chat and add an element of humor to it.
sentences.zh: 同样，偶尔的讽刺可以让聊天变得有趣，并增添幽默元素。

sentences.en: But a big or steady serving of sarcasm will overwhelm the emotional flavor of any conversation and can taste very bitter to its recipient.
sentences.zh: 但是大量或持续的讽刺会压倒任何谈话的情感味道，并且会给接受者带来非常痛苦的感觉。

sentences.en: So, tone down the sarcasm and work on clever wit instead, which is usually without any hostility and thus more appreciated by those you're communicating with.
sentences.zh: 因此，请淡化讽刺，转而使用机智，这通常没有任何敌意，因此更容易受到与您交流的人的赞赏。

sentences.en: In essence, sarcasm is easy while true, harmless wit takes talent.
sentences.zh: 本质上，讽刺很容易，而真实无害的机智需要天赋。

sentences.en: Thus, the main difference between wit and sarcasm is that, as already stated, sarcasm is often hostility disguised as humor.
sentences.zh: 因此，机智和讽刺之间的主要区别在于，如前所述，讽刺往往是伪装成幽默的敌意。

sentences.en: It can be intended to hurt and is often bitter and biting.
sentences.zh: 它可能是故意伤害的，并且通常是苦涩的和刺痛的。

sentences.en: Witty statements are usually in response to someone's unhelpful remarks or behaviors, and the intent is to untangle and clarify the issue by emphasizing its absurdities.
sentences.zh: 诙谐的言论通常是对某人无益的言论或行为的回应，其目的是通过强调问题的荒谬性来理清和澄清问题。

sentences.en: Sarcastic statements are expressed in a cutting manner; witty remarks are delivered with undisguised and harmless humor.
sentences.zh: 讽刺性的话语带着尖刻的挖苦；诙谐的话语则以坦率而无伤大雅的幽默表达出来。
sentences.note: cutting 表示尖刻伤人的。sarcasm 与 wit 的区别在于表达中是否带有伤害、挖苦的意味。

articles.title: Why variability improves learning
articles.subtitle: 多样化练习如何促进学习
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.sourceFile: 2024年6月第3套英语六级真题【推荐使用PDF版】.docx
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Variability is crucially important for learning new skills.
sentences.zh: 练习内容和条件的多样性，对学习新技能至关重要。
sentences.note: variability 在这里指练习材料或条件的变化与多样性；不要简单理解成学习表现不稳定。

sentences.en: Consider learning how to serve in tennis.
sentences.zh: 考虑学习如何打网球发球。

sentences.en: Should you always practise serving from the exactly same location on the court, aiming at the same spot?
sentences.zh: 你是否应该始终在球场上的同一位置练习发球，瞄准同一位置？

sentences.en: Although practising in more variable conditions will be slower at first, it will likely make you a better tennis player in the end.
sentences.zh: 虽然在更多变化的条件下练习一开始会比较慢，但最终可能会让你成为更好的网球运动员。

sentences.en: This is because variability leads to better generalisation of what is learned.
sentences.zh: 这是因为可变性可以更好地概括所学内容。
sentences.note: variability 在这里指练习材料或条件的变化与多样性；不要简单理解成学习表现不稳定。

sentences.en: This principle is found in many domains, including speech perception and learning categories.
sentences.zh: 这一原则存在于许多领域，包括语音感知和学习类别。

sentences.en: For instance, infants will struggle to learn the category “dog” if they are only exposed to Chihuahuas, instead of many different kinds of dogs “There are over ten different names for this basic principle,” says Limor Raviv, the senior investigator of a recent study.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果婴儿只接触吉娃娃狗，而不是许多不同种类的狗，他们将很难学习“狗”这一类别。“这一基本原则有十多个不同的名称，”最近一项研究的高级研究员 Limor Raviv 说。

sentences.en: “Learning from less variable input is often fast, but may fail to generalise to new stimuli.”
sentences.zh: “从变量较少的输入中学习通常很快，但可能无法推广到新的刺激。”

sentences.en: To identify key patterns and understand the underlying principles of variability effects, Raviv and her colleagues reviewed over 150 studies on variability and generalisation across fields, including computer science, linguistics, categorisation, visual perception and formal education.
sentences.zh: 为了识别关键模式并了解变异性影响的基本原理，Raviv 和她的同事回顾了 150 多项跨领域的变异性和泛化研究，包括计算机科学、语言学、分类、视觉感知和正规教育。
sentences.note: variability 在这里指练习材料或条件的变化与多样性；不要简单理解成学习表现不稳定。

sentences.en: The researchers discovered that, across studies, the term variability can refer to at least four different kinds of variability, such as set size and scheduling.
sentences.zh: 研究人员发现，在研究中，术语可变性可以指至少四种不同类型的可变性，例如集合大小和调度。
sentences.note: variability 在这里指练习材料或条件的变化与多样性；不要简单理解成学习表现不稳定。
