sentences.en: “These four kinds of variability have never been directly compared—which means that we currently don't know which is most effective for learning,” says Raviv.
sentences.zh: “这四种变异性从未被直接比较过——这意味着我们目前不知道哪种对学习最有效，”拉维夫说。
sentences.note: variability 在这里指练习材料或条件的变化与多样性；不要简单理解成学习表现不稳定。

sentences.en: The impact of variability depends on whether it is relevant to the task or not.
sentences.zh: 变异性的影响取决于它是否与任务相关。
sentences.note: variability 在这里指练习材料或条件的变化与多样性；不要简单理解成学习表现不稳定。

sentences.en: But according to the ‘Mr. Miyagi principle',practising seemingly unrelated skills may actually benefit learning of other skills.
sentences.zh: 但根据‘先生’宫城原理”，练习看似无关的技能实际上可能有益于其他技能的学习。

sentences.en: But why does variability impact learning and generalisation?
sentences.zh: 但是为什么变异性会影响学习和泛化呢？
sentences.note: variability 在这里指练习材料或条件的变化与多样性；不要简单理解成学习表现不稳定。

sentences.en: One theory is that more variable input can highlight which aspects of a task are relevant and which are not.
sentences.zh: 一种理论是，更多的可变输入可以突出任务的哪些方面相关，哪些方面不相关。

sentences.en: Another theory is that greater variability leads to broader generalisations.
sentences.zh: 另一种理论是，更大的可变性导致更广泛的概括。
sentences.note: variability 在这里指练习材料或条件的变化与多样性；不要简单理解成学习表现不稳定。

sentences.en: This is because variability will represent the real world better, including atypicalexamples A third reason has to do with the way memory works: when training is variable, learners are forced to actively reconstruct their memories “Understanding the impact of variability is important for literally every aspect of our daily life.
sentences.zh: 这是因为可变性将更好地代表现实世界，包括非典型例子第三个原因与记忆的工作方式有关：当训练可变时，学习者被迫主动重建他们的记忆“理解可变性的影响对于我们日常生活的各个方面都很重要。
sentences.note: variability 在这里指练习材料或条件的变化与多样性；不要简单理解成学习表现不稳定。

sentences.en: Beyond affecting the way we learn language, motor skills, and categories, it even has an impact on our social lives,” explains Raviv.
sentences.zh: 除了影响我们学习语言、运动技能和类别的方式之外，它甚至还影响我们的社交生活，”拉维夫解释道。

sentences.en: “For example, face recognition is affected by whether people grew up in a small community or in a larger community.
sentences.zh: “例如，人脸识别会受到人们是在小社区还是在大社区长大的影响。

sentences.en: Exposure to fewer faces during childhood is associated with diminished face memory.”
sentences.zh: 童年时期接触较少的面孔与面孔记忆的减弱有关。”

sentences.en: “We hope this work will spark people's curiosity and generate more work on the topic,” concludes Raviv.
sentences.zh: “我们希望这项工作能够激发人们的好奇心并产生更多关于该主题的工作，”拉维夫总结道。

sentences.en: “Our paper raises a lot of open questions.
sentences.zh: “我们的论文提出了很多悬而未决的问题。

sentences.en: Can we find similar effects of variability beyond the brain, for instance, in the immune system?”
sentences.zh: 我们能否在大脑之外（例如免疫系统）中找到类似的变异效应？”
sentences.note: variability 在这里指练习材料或条件的变化与多样性；不要简单理解成学习表现不稳定。

articles.title: Tax cuts, wages and economic growth
articles.subtitle: 减税与工资增长的经济叙事
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: One of the great successes of the Republican Party in recent decades is the relentless propagation of a simple formula for economic growth: tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 共和党近几十年来的伟大成功之一就是不懈地传播一个简单的经济增长公式：减税。

sentences.en: The formula doesn't work, but that has not affected its popularity.
sentences.zh: 公式不起作用，但这并不影响它的受欢迎程度。

sentences.en: And while the cult of tax cuts has attracted many critics, it lacks for obvious rivals.
sentences.zh: 虽然减税崇拜招致了许多批评，但它缺乏明显的竞争对手。

sentences.en: Democratic politicians have tended to campaign on helping people left behind by economic growth.
sentences.zh: 民主党政客倾向于帮助那些因经济增长而落在后面的人们。

sentences.en: When Democrats do talk about encouraging economic growth, they often sound like Republicans.
sentences.zh: 当民主党人确实谈论鼓励经济增长时，他们听起来常常像共和党人。

sentences.en: This is not just a political problem for Democrats; it is an economic problem for the United States.
sentences.zh: 这不仅仅是民主党的政治问题；也是民主党的政治问题。这对美国来说是一个经济问题。

sentences.en: The nation needs a better story about the drivers of economic growth.
sentences.zh: 国家需要更好的关于经济增长驱动因素的故事。

sentences.en: The painful lessons of recent decades point to a promising candidate: higher wages.
sentences.zh: 近几十年来的惨痛教训指出了一个有前途的候选人：更高的工资。

sentences.en: Raising the wages of American workers ought to be the priority of economic policymakers.
sentences.zh: 提高美国工人的工资应该是经济政策制定者的首要任务。

sentences.en: We'd all be better off paying less attention to quarterly updates on the growth of the nation's gross domestic product(GDP) and focusing instead on the growth of workers’paychecks.
sentences.zh: 我们最好少关注国家国内生产总值 (GDP) 增长的季度更新，而关注工人工资的增长。

sentences.en: Set aside, for the moment, the familiar argument for higher wages: fairness.
sentences.zh: 暂时搁置常见的关于提高工资的论点：公平。

sentences.en: The argument here is that higher wages can fuel the engine of economic growth.
sentences.zh: 这里的论点是，更高的工资可以推动经济增长的引擎。

sentences.en: Perhaps the most famous illustration of the benefits is the story of Henry Ford's decision in 1914 to pay $5 a day to workers on his Model T assembly lines.
sentences.zh: 也许最著名的好处例证是亨利·福特 (Henry Ford) 在 1914 年决定向 T 型车装配线上的工人每天支付 5 美元的故事。

sentences.en: He did it to increase production—-he was paying a premium to maintain a reliable workforce.
sentences.zh: 他这样做是为了增加产量——他支付额外费用来维持可靠的劳动力。

sentences.en: The unexpected benefit was that Ford’s factory workers became Ford customers, too.
sentences.zh: 意想不到的好处是，福特工厂的工人也成为了福特的客户。

sentences.en: The same logic still holds: Consumption drives the American economy, and workers who are paid more can spend more.
sentences.zh: 同样的逻辑仍然成立：消费驱动美国经济，工资高的工人可以花更多的钱。

sentences.en: Mainstream economists insist that it is impossible to order upa sustainable increase in wages because compensation levels reflect the unerring judgment of market forces.
sentences.zh: 主流经济学家坚持认为，不可能要求工资持续增长，因为薪酬水平反映了市场力量的准确判断。

sentences.en: The conventional wisdom held that productivity growth was the only route to higher wages.
sentences.zh: 传统观点认为，生产率增长是提高工资的唯一途径。

sentences.en: Through that lens, efforts to negotiate higher wages were counterproductive.
sentences.zh: 从这个角度来看，谈判提高工资的努力适得其反。

sentences.en: Minimum-wage laws would raise unemployment because there was only so much money in the wage pool, and if some people got more, others would get none.
sentences.zh: 最低工资法会提高失业率，因为工资池里的钱只有这么多，如果有些人得到更多，其他人就什么也得不到。

sentences.en: It was in the context of this worldview that it became popular to argue that tax cuts would drive prosperity.
sentences.zh: 正是在这种世界观的背景下，减税将推动繁荣的观点开始流行。

sentences.en: Rich people would invest, productivity would increase, wages would rise.
sentences.zh: 富人会投资，生产力会提高，工资会上涨。

sentences.en: In the real world, things are more complicated.
sentences.zh: 在现实世界中，事情更加复杂。

sentences.en: Wages are influenced by a tug of war between employers and workers, and employers have been winning.
sentences.zh: 工资受到雇主和工人之间拉锯战的影响，雇主一直获胜。

sentences.en: One clear piece of evidence is the widening gap between productivity growth and wage growth since roughly 1970.
sentences.zh: 一个明显的证据是，自 1970 年左右以来，生产率增长与工资增长之间的差距不断扩大。

sentences.en: Productivity has more than doubled; wages have lagged far behind.
sentences.zh: 生产率提高了一倍多；工资已经远远落后了。

sentences.en: A focus on wage growth would provide an antidoteto the attractive simplicity of the belief in the magical power of tax cuts.
sentences.zh: 把注意力转向工资增长，可以纠正那种简单而诱人的观念：减税具有神奇的力量。
sentences.note: antidote 本义为解毒剂，此处比喻纠正某种有吸引力却过度简化的观念的方法。

articles.title: Who decides what research gets published
articles.subtitle: 学术期刊编辑与代表性
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Journal editors decide what gets published and what doesn't, affecting the careers of other academics and influencing the direction that a field takes.
sentences.zh: 期刊编辑决定发表哪些内容，不发表哪些内容，从而影响其他学者的职业生涯并影响一个领域的发展方向。

sentences.en: You'd hope, then, that journals would do everything they can to establish a diverse editorial board, reflecting a variety of voices, experiences, and identities.
sentences.zh: 那么，你会希望期刊尽其所能建立一个多元化的编辑委员会，反映不同的声音、经验和身份。

sentences.en: Unfortunately a new study in Nature Neuroscience makes for disheartening reading.
sentences.zh: 不幸的是，《自然神经科学》杂志上的一项新研究读起来令人沮丧。

sentences.en: The team finds that the majority of editors in top psychology and neuroscience journals are male and based in the United States: a situation that may be amplifying existing gender inequalities in the field and influencing the kind of research that gets published.
sentences.zh: 研究小组发现，顶级心理学和神经科学期刊的大多数编辑都是男性，且居住在美国：这种情况可能会加剧该领域现有的性别不平等，并影响发表的研究类型。

sentences.en: Men were found to account for 60% of the editors of psychology journals.
sentences.zh: 心理学期刊编辑中男性占60%。

sentences.en: There were significantly more male than female editors at each level of seniority, and men made up the majority of editors in over three quarters of the journals.
sentences.zh: 各个级别的男性编辑明显多于女性编辑，超过四分之三的期刊中男性编辑占大多数。

sentences.en: Crucially, the proportion of female editors was significantly lower than the overall proportion of women psychology researchers.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是，女性编辑的比例明显低于女性心理学研究人员的总体比例。

sentences.en: The differences were even starker in the neuroscience journals:70% of editors were male, and men held the majority of editorial positions in 88% of journals.
sentences.zh: 神经科学期刊中的差异更为明显：70% 的编辑是男性，男性在 88% 的期刊中占据了大部分编辑职位。

sentences.en: In this case, the proportion of female editors was not significantly lower than the proportion of female researchers working in neuroscience-a finding that reveals enduring gender disparities in the field more broadly.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，女性编辑的比例并不显着低于从事神经科学工作的女性研究人员的比例——这一发现更广泛地揭示了该领域持久的性别差异。

sentences.en: Based on their results, the team concludes that “the ideas, values and decision-making biases of men are over represented in the editorial positions of the most recognized academic journals in psychology and neuroscience."
sentences.zh: 根据他们的研究结果，研究小组得出结论：“在心理学和神经科学领域最受认可的学术期刊的编辑职位中，男性的想法、价值观和决策偏见过多。”

sentences.en: Gender inequality in science is often attributed to the fact that senior academics are more likely to be male, because historically science was male-dominated: it's argued that as time goes on and more women rise to senior roles, the field will become more equal.
sentences.zh: 科学领域的性别不平等通常归因于这样一个事实：高级学者更有可能是男性，因为历史上科学是男性主导的：有人认为，随着时间的推移，越来越多的女性晋升到高级职位，该领域将变得更加平等。

sentences.en: Yet this study showed that even the junior roles in psychology journals tended to beheld disproportionately by men, despite the fact that there are actually more female than male junior psychology faculty.
sentences.zh: 然而，这项研究表明，即使是心理学期刊中的初级职位，男性也往往比例过高，尽管实际上初级心理学教师中的女性人数多于男性。

sentences.en: This implies that a lack of female academics is not the problem.
sentences.zh: 这意味着缺乏女性学者并不是问题所在。

sentences.en: Instead, there are structural reasons that women are disadvantaged in science.
sentences.zh: 相反，女性在科学领域处于不利地位是有结构性原因的。

sentences.en: Women receive lower salaries and face greater childcare demands, for instance, which can result in fewer publications and grants—the kinds of things that journals look for when deciding who to appoint.
sentences.zh: 例如，女性的工资较低，面临更大的育儿需求，这可能会导致出版物和拨款减少——而这些正是期刊在决定任命谁时所寻求的东西。

sentences.en: Rather than simply blaming the inequality of editorial boards on tradition, we should be actively breaking down these existing barriers.
sentences.zh: 我们不应该简单地将编委会的不平等归咎于传统，而应该积极打破这些现有的障碍。

sentences.en: A lack of diversity among journal editors also likely contributes to psychology's WEIRD problem.
sentences.zh: 期刊编辑之间缺乏多样性也可能导致心理学的怪异问题。

sentences.en: If journal editors are largely men from the United States, then they will probably place higher value on papers that are relevant to Western, male populations, whether consciously or not.
sentences.zh: 如果期刊编辑主要是来自美国的男性，那么无论有意识还是无意识，他们可能会对与西方男性群体相关的论文给予更高的重视。
sentences.note: whether consciously or not 表示无论有意还是无意。作者关注编辑群体构成如何影响研究取舍。

articles.title: Switching off and being left offline
articles.subtitle: 断网生活与数字排斥
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Could you get by without using the internet for four and a half years?
sentences.zh: 四年半不上网你还能过得去吗？

sentences.en: That's exactly what singer and actress Selena Gomez has done in abid to improve her mental health.
sentences.zh: 这正是歌手兼演员赛琳娜·戈麦斯为改善心理健康所做的努力。

sentences.en: She has spoken extensively about the relationship between her social media usage and her mental wellbeing, recalling feeling like “an addict” when she became Instagram's most followed user in 2016.
sentences.zh: 她广泛谈论了她的社交媒体使用与心理健康之间的关系，回忆起 2016 年她成为 Instagram 上最受关注的用户时的感觉，就像“瘾君子”一样。

sentences.en: “Taking a break from social media was the best decision that I've ever made for my mental health", says she.
sentences.zh: “远离社交媒体是我为心理健康做出的最佳决定”，她说。

sentences.en: “The unnecessary hate and comparisons went away once I put my phone down."
sentences.zh: “一旦我放下手机，不必要的仇恨和比较就消失了。”

sentences.en: Ditching the web at large, however, is afar more subtle and complicated prospect.
sentences.zh: 然而，彻底放弃网络是一个更加微妙和复杂的前景。

sentences.en: The increasing digitisation of our society means that everything from paying agas bill to plotting a route to a friend's house and even making a phone callis at the mercy of your internet connection.
sentences.zh: 我们社会的数字化程度不断提高，这意味着从支付燃气账单到规划去朋友家的路线，甚至打电话，一切都取决于您的互联网连接。

sentences.en: Actively opting out of using the internet becomes a matter of privilege.
sentences.zh: 主动选择不使用互联网成为特权问题。

sentences.en: Ms Gomez's multi-millionaire status has allowed her to take the “social” out of social media, so she can continue to leverage her enormous fame while keeping the trollsat bay.
sentences.zh: 戈麦斯女士的百万富翁身份使她能够将社交媒体中的“社交”功能去掉，这样她就可以继续利用自己巨大的名气，同时阻止巨魔卫星的攻击。

sentences.en: The fact that she's still the second most-followed woman on Instagram suggests it's entirely possible to maintain a significant web profile to promote various projects-byway ofa dedicated team—without being exposed to the cruel comments, hate mail and rape or death threats.
sentences.zh: 她仍然是 Instagram 上关注度第二高的女性，这一事实表明，完全有可能通过专门的团队维持重要的网络个人资料来推广各种项目，而不会受到残酷评论、仇恨邮件以及强奸或死亡威胁。

sentences.en: It goes without saying that this is fundamentally different from how the rest of us without beauty deals and films to publicise use the likes of Instagram, TikTok and Twitter, but even the concept of a digital detox requires having a device and connectivity to choose to disconnect from.
sentences.zh: 不言而喻，这与我们其他人在没有美容交易和电影宣传的情况下使用 Instagram、TikTok 和 Twitter 等工具的方式有根本的不同，但即使是数字排毒的概念也需要有一个设备和连接来选择断开连接。

sentences.en: The UK's digital divide has worsened over the past two years, leaving poorer families without broadband connections in their homes.
sentences.zh: 英国的数字鸿沟在过去两年中进一步恶化，导致较贫困的家庭在家中没有宽带连接。

sentences.en: Digital exclusion is a major threat to wider societal equality in the UK, so witnessing companies like Face book championing the met averseas the next great frontier when schoolchildren are struggling to complete their homework feels particularly irritating.
sentences.zh: 数字排斥是对英国更广泛的社会平等的主要威胁，因此，当学童努力完成作业时，看到像 Facebook 这样的公司在下一个伟大前沿领域倡导大都会，感觉特别令人恼火。
sentences.note: digital exclusion 指因条件限制无法充分使用数字服务的处境；区别于自主选择暂时断网。

sentences.en: Consequently, it's worth bearing in mind that while deleting all social media accounts will undoubtedly make some feel infinitely better, many other people benefit from the strong sense of community that sharing platforms can breed.
sentences.zh: 因此，值得记住的是，虽然删除所有社交媒体帐户无疑会让一些人感觉无限好，但许多其他人受益于共享平台可以培育的强烈社区意识。

sentences.en: Internet access will continue to grow in importance as we edge further towards web3.0,and greater resources and initiatives are needed to provide the underprivileged with the connectivity they desperately need to learn, work and live.
sentences.zh: 随着我们进一步迈向 web3.0，互联网接入的重要性将继续增长，需要更多的资源和举措来为弱势群体提供他们迫切需要的学习、工作和生活的连接。

sentences.en: It's crucial that people who feel that social media is having a detrimental effect on their mental health are allowed to switch off and for those living in digital exclusion to be able to switch on in the first place.
sentences.zh: 至关重要的是：觉得社交媒体损害了自己心理健康的人，应当能够选择断开连接；而被排除在数字生活之外的人，首先应当有机会接入网络。
sentences.note: digital exclusion 指因条件限制无法充分使用数字服务的处境；区别于自主选择暂时断网。

articles.title: Competition, cooperation and culture
articles.subtitle: 竞争是天性还是文化产物
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Psychologists have long been in disagreement as to whether competition is a learned or a genetic component of human behavior.
sentences.zh: 对于竞争是人类行为的后天习得成分还是遗传成分，心理学家长期以来一直存在分歧。

sentences.en: Whatever it is, you cannot but recognize the effect competition is exerting in academics and many other areas of contemporary life.
sentences.zh: 无论是什么，你都不能不认识到竞争在学术和当代生活的许多其他领域所产生的影响。

sentences.en: Psychologically speaking, competition has been seen as an inevitable consequence of human drives.
sentences.zh: 从心理学上来说，竞争被视为人类驱动力的必然结果。

sentences.en: According to Sigmund Freud, humans are born screaming for attention and full of organic drives for fulfillment in various areas.
sentences.zh: 根据西格蒙德·弗洛伊德的说法，人类生来就尖叫着寻求关注，并且充满了在各个领域实现成就的有机驱动力。

sentences.en: Initially, we compete for the attention of our parents.
sentences.zh: 最初，我们争夺父母的注意力。

sentences.en: Thereafter, we are at the mercy of a battle between our base impulses for self-fulfillment and social and cultural norms which prohibit pure indulgence.
sentences.zh: 此后，我们就会受到自我实现的基本冲动与禁止纯粹放纵的社会和文化规范之间的斗争的摆布。

sentences.en: Current work in anthropologyhas suggested, however, that this view of the role of competition in human behavior may be incorrect.
sentences.zh: 然而，人类学当前的工作表明，这种关于竞争在人类行为中的作用的观点可能是不正确的。

sentences.en: Thomas Hobbes, one of the great philosophers of the seventeenth century, is perhaps best remembered for his characterization of the “natural world,” that is, the world before the imposition of the will of humanity, as being “nasty, brutish, and short.”
sentences.zh: 托马斯·霍布斯是十七世纪最伟大的哲学家之一，他最为人所铭记的也许是他对“自然世界”的描述，即强加人类意志之前的世界，是“肮脏、野蛮和短暂的”。

sentences.en: This image of the pre-rational world is still widely held, reinforced by Charles Darwin’s highly influential work, The Origin of Species, which established the doctrine of natural selection.
sentences.zh: 这种前理性世界的形象仍然被广泛持有，查尔斯·达尔文极具影响力的著作《物种起源》进一步强化了这一形象，该著作确立了自然选择的学说。

sentences.en: This doctrine, which takes for granted that those species best able to adapt to and master the natural environment in which they live will survive, has suggested that the struggle for survival is an inherent human trait which determines a person’s success.
sentences.zh: 这一学说理所当然地认为那些最能适应和掌握其所生活的自然环境的物种将会生存，它表明生存斗争是人类固有的特征，决定了一个人的成功。

sentences.en: Darwin's theory has even been summarized as “"survival of the fittest"—a phrase Darwin himself never used—further highlighting competition's role in success.
sentences.zh: 达尔文的理论甚至被概括为“适者生存”——达尔文本人从未使用过这个词——进一步强调了竞争在成功中的作用。
sentences.note: survival of the fittest 译为适者生存；fittest 指最适应环境，不能简单等同于最强壮或最擅长竞争。

sentences.en: As it has often been pointed out, however, there is nothing in the concept of natural selection that suggests that competition is the most successful strategy for “survival of the fittest.
sentences.zh: 然而，正如人们经常指出的那样，自然选择的概念中没有任何内容表明竞争是“适者生存”的最成功策略。
sentences.note: survival of the fittest 译为适者生存；fittest 指最适应环境，不能简单等同于最强壮或最擅长竞争。

sentences.en: "Darwin asserted in The Origin of Species that the struggles he was describing should be viewed as metaphors and could easily include dependence and cooperation.
sentences.zh: “达尔文在《物种起源》中断言，他所描述的斗争应该被视为隐喻，并且很容易包括依赖和合作。

sentences.en: Many studies have been conducted to test the importance placed on competition as opposed to other values, such as cooperation—by various cultures, and generally conclude that Americans uniquely praise competition as natural, inevitable, and desirable.
sentences.zh: 已经进行了许多研究来测试各种文化对竞争相对于其他价值观（例如合作）的重视程度，并普遍得出结论，美国人独特地称赞竞争是自然的、不可避免的和可取的。

sentences.en: In 1937,the world-renowned anthropologist Margaret Mead published Cooperation and Competition among Primitive Peoples, based on her studies of several societies that did not prize competition, and, in fact, seemed at times to place a negative value on it.
sentences.zh: 1937 年，世界著名人类学家玛格丽特·米德 (Margaret Mead) 出版了《原始民族之间的合作与竞争》一书，该书基于她对几个不重视竞争、事实上有时似乎对竞争给予负面评价的社会的研究。

sentences.en: One such society was the Zuni Indians of Arizona, and they, Mead found, valued cooperation far more than competition.
sentences.zh: 亚利桑那州的祖尼印第安人就是这样一个社会，米德发现，他们重视合作远甚于竞争。

sentences.en: After studying dozens of such cultures, Mead's final conclusion was that competitiveness is a culturally created aspect of human behavior, and that its prevalence in a particular society is relative to how that society values it.
sentences.zh: 在研究了数十种此类文化后，米德的最终结论是，竞争力是人类行为的文化创造的一个方面，它在特定社会中的流行程度与该社会如何评价它有关。

articles.title: Sharing research beyond academia
articles.subtitle: 让研究走出学术围墙
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Research is meant to benefit society by raising public awareness and creating products and innovations that enhance development.
sentences.zh: 研究旨在通过提高公众意识并创造促进发展的产品和创新来造福社会。
sentences.note: cannot be overstated 表示再怎么强调也不为过。tenure 指终身教职，open access 指开放获取。

sentences.en: For research to serve its full purpose, the results must leave the confines of research laboratories and academic journals.
sentences.zh: 为了使研究充分发挥其作用，结果必须脱离研究实验室和学术期刊的范围。

sentences.en: Findings effectively communicated can go a long way to serve the interests of the public.
sentences.zh: 有效传达调查结果对于服务公众利益大有裨益。

sentences.en: They can help address social injustices or improve treatments offered to patients.
sentences.zh: 它们可以帮助解决社会不公正问题或改善为患者提供的治疗。

sentences.en: Many researchers seem to be content with sharing the results of their studies in academic journals or at conferences.
sentences.zh: 许多研究人员似乎满足于在学术期刊或会议上分享他们的研究结果。

sentences.en: But few journals allow everybody to read the findings.
sentences.zh: 但很少有期刊允许每个人都阅读研究结果。

sentences.en: Even articles freely available are usually written in academic language incomprehensible to the average reader.
sentences.zh: 即使免费提供的文章通常也是用普通读者难以理解的学术语言编写的。

sentences.en: For researchers in the tenure-track system, their main goal is winning tenure, which in part can be achieved by getting a number of papers published in prominent journals.
sentences.zh: 对于终身教职制的研究人员来说，他们的主要目标是赢得终身教职，这在一定程度上可以通过在著名期刊上发表大量论文来实现。

sentences.en: Pressures like this mean community-level outreach is not prioritised.
sentences.zh: 像这样的压力意味着社区层面的外展活动没有被优先考虑。

sentences.en: Many researchers lack the writing skills to describe their results to a general audience.
sentences.zh: 许多研究人员缺乏向普通受众描述他们的结果的写作技巧。

sentences.en: They may also worry about whether the public will understand their findings, or about findings being used to influence controversial policies.
sentences.zh: 他们还可能担心公众是否会理解他们的研究结果，或者担心研究结果被用来影响有争议的政策。

sentences.en: These concerns cause some researchers to shy away from communicating their findings outside the academic community.
sentences.zh: 这些担忧导致一些研究人员回避在学术界之外交流他们的发现。

sentences.en: Propagating research findings beyond academic publications is particularly crucial for addressing certain social discrepancies.
sentences.zh: 在学术出版物之外传播研究成果对于解决某些社会差异尤为重要。

sentences.en: It can help families, communities, healthcare providers, policymakers, government agencies and other stakeholders to understand and respond to crises that plague society.
sentences.zh: 它可以帮助家庭、社区、医疗保健提供者、政策制定者、政府机构和其他利益相关者了解和应对困扰社会的危机。

sentences.en: The benefits of sharing findings flow both ways.
sentences.zh: 分享发现的好处是双向的。

sentences.en: Engaging with other researchers and the public can lead to unexpected new connections and new ideas that could suggest fruitful new directions for research.
sentences.zh: 与其他研究人员和公众接触可以带来意想不到的新联系和新想法，从而为研究提出富有成效的新方向。

sentences.en: To benefit both researchers and the communities, the need to find innovative, accessible ways to share the work can not be overstated.
sentences.zh: 为了使研究人员和社区都受益，需要找到创新的、易于理解的方式来分享工作，这一点怎么强调都不为过。

sentences.en: Institutions and funding organisations should support more researchers to publish in open access journals so that the public doesn’t have to pay to read them.
sentences.zh: 机构和资助组织应支持更多研究人员在开放获取期刊上发表文章，以便公众无需付费即可阅读。

sentences.en: Institutions and researchers should invest in partnerships that expand capacity for sharing results more broadly.
sentences.zh: 机构和研究人员应投资于伙伴关系，以扩大更广泛地共享成果的能力。

sentences.en: Furthermore, ethics committees should make it mandatory for researchers to share their results with the public.
sentences.zh: 此外，伦理委员会应强制研究人员与公众分享他们的结果。

sentences.en: Every research participant should opt in or out of receiving results, as part of the process of giving informed consent.
sentences.zh: 每个研究参与者都应选择接受或不接收结果，作为知情同意过程的一部分。

sentences.en: There could be misunderstanding of the findings presented by the researcher because of technical terms.
sentences.zh: 由于技术术语的原因，研究人员提出的研究结果可能会被误解。

sentences.en: But this can be resolved by researchers engaging the services of professional writers or communication officers to help with translating their study into more accessible language and share it widely with media outlets and the public.
sentences.zh: 但这可以通过研究人员聘请专业作家或传播官员的服务来解决，以帮助将他们的研究翻译成更容易理解的语言，并与媒体和公众广泛分享。

sentences.en: Sharing results with the people who are most affected by them makes us better researchers and ensures that our work can be used to improve people's lives.
sentences.zh: 与受其影响最严重的人分享结果使我们成为更好的研究人员，并确保我们的工作可用于改善人们的生活。

sentences.en: Institutions and collaborators must recognise the value of doing so.
sentences.zh: 机构和合作者必须认识到这样做的价值。

articles.title: The remarkable world of spiders
articles.subtitle: 重新认识秋日的蜘蛛
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Spiders make their presence felt in late August and through early autumn.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛在八月下旬和初秋时分出现。
sentences.note: make one's presence felt 指使人明显感受到其存在；此处描写蜘蛛在季节变化中变得显眼。

sentences.en: This is the mating season of some of the most common varieties, when male house spiders come out of hidden corners to look for females, and garden spiders reach adult size and spin their most dazzling webs.
sentences.zh: 这是一些最常见品种的交配季节，雄性家蜘蛛会从隐蔽的角落出来寻找雌性，而花园蜘蛛则达到成年体型并结出最耀眼的网。

sentences.en: Yet while the spider is a familiar fixture of nursery poems or songs and Halloween decorations, its relationship with humans is complicated.
sentences.zh: 然而，虽然蜘蛛是童谣、歌曲和万圣节装饰品中常见的元素，但它与人类的关系却很复杂。

sentences.en: Fear of spiders is common and has serious impacts on the lives of sufferers.
sentences.zh: 对蜘蛛的恐惧很常见，并且对患者的生活造成严重影响。

sentences.en: Its prevalence appears unrelated to any rational assessment of risk.
sentences.zh: 其流行率似乎与任何合理的风险评估无关。

sentences.en: Spiders in the UK are almost all harmless.
sentences.zh: 英国的蜘蛛几乎都是无害的。

sentences.en: Farmland species perform valuable ecosystem services, by preying on insects that are our competitors for crops.
sentences.zh: 农田物种通过捕食农作物竞争对手的昆虫来提供宝贵的生态系统服务。

sentences.en: But they are a constant source of human anxieties—with a cultural association with witches and wickedness dating back to the middle ages.
sentences.zh: 但它们是人类焦虑的持续根源——与女巫和邪恶的文化联系可以追溯到中世纪。

sentences.en: Does this perhaps explain, in part, the lack of data about how spiders are faring in our age of ecological crisis?
sentences.zh: 这是否可能部分解释了在我们这个生态危机时代，缺乏关于蜘蛛如何生存的数据？

sentences.en: British butterflies are the most studied group of insects in the world, due to the long tradition of collecting and observing them.
sentences.zh: 由于收集和观察英国蝴蝶的悠久传统，英国蝴蝶是世界上研究最多的昆虫类群。

sentences.en: But spider conservationists point out that it was only in the1980s that the classification of house spiders was properly sorted out.
sentences.zh: 但蜘蛛保护主义者指出，直到20世纪80年代，家蜘蛛的分类才得到妥善整理。

sentences.en: And while information about insect populations is gathered by experiments that measure the numbers hitting windscreens or traps, there have been few attempts to count spiders.
sentences.zh: 虽然有关昆虫种群的信息是通过测量撞击挡风玻璃或陷阱的数量的实验来收集的，但很少有人尝试对蜘蛛进行计数。

sentences.en: The huge reductions in the numbers of flying insects can only mean a reduction in spiders’food supply.
sentences.zh: 飞虫数量的大幅减少只能意味着蜘蛛食物供应的减少。

sentences.en: A recent landmark study identified a75% fall in insect populations between1989 and 2016,with pesticide use thought to be to blame along with the destruction of wild areas for development.
sentences.zh: 最近的一项具有里程碑意义的研究发现，1989 年至 2016 年间，昆虫数量下降了 75%，农药的使用以及开发对野生地区的破坏被认为是罪魁祸首。

sentences.en: This means the overall picture for spiders is worrying, as it is for most creatures.
sentences.zh: 这意味着蜘蛛的整体情况令人担忧，就像大多数生物一样。

sentences.en: But conservationists are most concerned about those varieties that are threatened due to habitat loss and fragmentation, which makes it impossible for them to migrate.
sentences.zh: 但自然资源保护主义者最关心的是那些由于栖息地丧失和破碎而受到威胁的品种，这使得它们无法迁徙。

sentences.en: Of around 650 spider species regularly recorded in the UK, the majority thrive in marshes and wasteland.
sentences.zh: 在英国经常记录的大约 650 种蜘蛛中，大多数在沼泽和荒地中繁衍生息。

sentences.en: Conservation efforts, often led by determined individuals, have helped some species to recover by reintroducing them to new areas.
sentences.zh: 保护工作通常由坚定的个人领导，通过将某些物种重新引入新的地区，帮助它们恢复。

sentences.en: With rewilding now firmly on the environmental policy agenda, the hope is that in future, spiders will be enabled to migrate by themselves, adapting to climate change by moving along wildlife corridors.
sentences.zh: 随着野化现在已被牢牢提上环境政策议程，希望未来蜘蛛能够自行迁徙，通过沿着野生动物走廊移动来适应气候变化。

sentences.en: It seems unlikely that spiders will ever attract the same level of human enthusiasm as bees, birds or butterflies, in spite of their unique status as nature's spinners.
sentences.zh: 蜘蛛似乎不太可能像蜜蜂、鸟类或蝴蝶那样吸引人类的热情，尽管它们作为大自然的旋转者具有独特的地位。

sentences.en: But as they reveal themselves in all their splendour this autumn, it would be a good thing if more animal lovers recognised the ways in which spiders are simply terrific.
sentences.zh: 但是，当它们在今年秋天展现出自己的辉煌时，如果有更多的动物爱好者认识到蜘蛛的奇妙之处，那将是一件好事。

articles.title: Technology shapes human behaviour
articles.subtitle: 技术从来不是中性的
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Technology is never a neutral tool for achieving human ends.
sentences.zh: 技术从来都不是实现人类目标的中立工具。
sentences.note: neutral 表示中立的。文章讨论技术会改变人类行为与需求，而不只是被动满足既定目标。

sentences.en: Technological innovations reshape people as they use these innovations to control their environment.
sentences.zh: 技术创新重塑了人们，因为他们利用这些创新来控制他们的环境。

sentences.en: Artificial intelligence, for example, is altering humanity.
sentences.zh: 例如，人工智能正在改变人类。

sentences.en: While the term A I conjures up anxieties about killer robots or catastrophic levels of unemployment, there are other, deeper implications.
sentences.zh: 虽然“A I”一词让人想起对杀手机器人或灾难性失业水平的焦虑，但还有其他更深层次的含义。

sentences.en: As A I increasingly shapes the human experience, how does this change what it means to be human?
sentences.zh: 随着人工智能越来越多地塑造人类体验，这将如何改变人类的意义？

sentences.en: Central to the problem is a person's capacity to make choices, particularly judgments that have moral implications.
sentences.zh: 问题的核心是一个人做出选择的能力，特别是做出具有道德含义的判断的能力。

sentences.en: Aristotle argued that the capacity for making practical judgments depends on regularly making them on habit and practice.
sentences.zh: 亚里士多德认为，做出实际判断的能力取决于定期根据习惯和实践做出判断。

sentences.en: We see the emergence of machines as substitute judges in a variety of everyday contexts as a potential threat to people learning how to effectively exercise judgment themselves.
sentences.zh: 我们认为机器在各种日常环境中作为替代法官的出现对人们学习如何有效地运用自己的判断构成了潜在威胁。

sentences.en: In the workplace, managers routinely make decisions about who to hire or fire and which loan to approve, to name a few.
sentences.zh: 在工作场所，经理通常会决定雇用或解雇谁以及批准哪些贷款等等。

sentences.en: These are areas where algorithmicprescription is replacing human judgment, and so people who might have had the chance to develop practical judgment in these areas no longer will.
sentences.zh: 在这些领域，算法处方正在取代人类判断，因此原本有机会在这些领域培养实际判断力的人将不再有机会。

sentences.en: Recommendation engines, which are increasingly prevalent intermediaries in people's consumption of culture, may serve to constrain choice and minimize luck.
sentences.zh: 推荐引擎作为人们文化消费中越来越普遍的中介，可能会限制选择并减少运气。

sentences.en: By presenting consumers with algorithmically selected choices of what to watch, read, stream and visit next, companies are replacing human taste with machine taste.
sentences.zh: 通过向消费者提供由算法选择的下一步观看、阅读、流媒体和访问内容的选择，公司正在用机器品味取代人类品味。

sentences.en: In one sense, this is helpful.
sentences.zh: 从某种意义上说，这是有帮助的。

sentences.en: After all, machines can survey a wider range of choices than any individual is likely to have the time or energy to do on their own.
sentences.zh: 毕竟，机器可以调查比任何个人可能有时间或精力自己做的更广泛的选择。

sentences.en: At the same time, though, this selection is optimizing for what people are likely to prefer based on what they've preferred in the past.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，此选择正在根据人们过去的偏好来优化他们可能喜欢的内容。

sentences.en: We think there is some risk that people's options will be constrained by their past in a new and unanticipated way.
sentences.zh: 我们认为，人们的选择可能会以一种新的、意想不到的方式受到过去的限制。

sentences.en: As machine learning algorithms improve and as they train on more extensive data sets, larger parts of everyday life are likely to become utterly predictable.
sentences.zh: 随着机器学习算法的改进以及它们在更广泛的数据集上进行训练，日常生活的大部分内容可能会变得完全可预测。

sentences.en: The predictions are going to get better and better, and they will ultimately make common experiences more efficient and pleasant.
sentences.zh: 预测将会变得越来越好，最终将使共同的体验变得更加高效和愉快。

sentences.en: Algorithms could soon—if they don't already—have a better idea about which show you'd like to watch next and which job candidate you should hire than you do.
sentences.zh: 算法很快就会（如果还没有的话）比你更好地了解你接下来想看哪个节目以及你应该雇用哪位求职者。

sentences.en: One day, humans may even find a way for machines to make these decisions without some of the biases that humans typically display.
sentences.zh: 有一天，人类甚至可能找到一种方法让机器做出这些决定，而不会出现人类通常表现出的一些偏见。

sentences.en: But to the extent that unpredictability is part of how people understand themselves and part of what people like about themselves, humanity is in the process of losing something significant.
sentences.zh: 但就不可预测性而言，不可预测性是人们如何理解自己的一部分，也是人们喜欢自己的一部分，人类正在失去一些重要的东西。

sentences.en: As they become more and more predictable, the creatures inhabiting the increasingly A I-mediated world will become less and less like us.
sentences.zh: 随着它们变得越来越可预测，居住在日益人工智能介导的世界中的生物将变得越来越不像我们。

articles.title: How children learn to read
articles.subtitle: 儿童阅读与自然拼读教学
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Phonics, which involves sounding out words syllableby syllable, is the best way to teach children to read.
sentences.zh: 自然拼读法让儿童逐个音节地拼读单词，是教儿童阅读的最佳方法。
sentences.note: phonics 译为自然拼读法；balanced literacy 为均衡读写教学法；whole language 为全语言教学法。三者是不同的教学理念。

sentences.en: But in many classrooms, this can be a dirty word.
sentences.zh: 但在许多教室里，这可能是一个肮脏的词。

sentences.en: So much so that some teachers have had to sneak phonics teaching materials into the classroom.
sentences.zh: 以至于一些老师不得不将自然拼读教材偷偷带进课堂。
sentences.note: phonics 译为自然拼读法；balanced literacy 为均衡读写教学法；whole language 为全语言教学法。三者是不同的教学理念。

sentences.en: Most American children are taught to read in a way that study after study has found to be wrong.
sentences.zh: 大多数美国孩子被教导阅读的方式经过多次研究后发现是错误的。

sentences.en: The consequences of this are striking.
sentences.zh: 其后果是惊人的。

sentences.en: Less than half of all American adults were proficient readers in 2017.
sentences.zh: 2017 年，不到一半的美国成年人精通阅读。

sentences.en: American fourth graders rank 15th on the Progress in International Literacy Study, an international exam.
sentences.zh: 美国四年级学生在国际读写能力研究进展国际考试中排名第 15 位。

sentences.en: America is stuck in a debate about teaching children to read that has been going on for decades.
sentences.zh: 美国陷入了一场持续了数十年的关于教孩子阅读的争论。

sentences.en: Some advocate teaching symbol-sound relationships （the sound k can be spelled as c, k, ck, or ch)，known as phonics.
sentences.zh: 有些主张教授符号与声音的关系（声音k可以拼写为c、k、ck或ch），称为自然拼读法。
sentences.note: phonics 译为自然拼读法；balanced literacy 为均衡读写教学法；whole language 为全语言教学法。三者是不同的教学理念。

sentences.en: Others support an immersive approach(using pictures of a cat to learn the word cat），known as “whole language”.
sentences.zh: 其他人支持沉浸式方法（使用猫的图片来学习猫这个词），称为“整体语言”。

sentences.en: Most teachers today, almost three out of four according to a survey by the EdWeek Research Centre in 2019，use a mix called “balanced literacy”.
sentences.zh: 根据 EdWeek 研究中心 2019 年的一项调查，当今大多数教师（几乎四分之三）都使用一种称为“均衡读写能力”的组合。

sentences.en: This combination of methods is ineffective.
sentences.zh: 这种方法的组合是无效的。

sentences.en: “You can’t sprinkle in a little phonics,” says Tenette Smith, executive director of elementary education and reading at Mississippi's education department.
sentences.zh: “你不能撒一点自然拼读法，”密西西比州教育部门基础教育和阅读执行主任特内特·史密斯 (Tenette Smith) 说。
sentences.note: phonics 译为自然拼读法；balanced literacy 为均衡读写教学法；whole language 为全语言教学法。三者是不同的教学理念。

sentences.en: “It has to be systematic and explicitly taught."
sentences.zh: “必须系统且明确地教授。”

sentences.en: Mississippi, often behind in social policy, has set an example here.
sentences.zh: 密西西比州在社会政策方面经常落后，在这里树立了榜样。

sentences.en: In a state once notorious for its low reading scores, the Mississippi state legislature passed new literacy standards in 2013.
sentences.zh: 密西西比州曾经因阅读成绩低而臭名昭著，该州立法机构于 2013 年通过了新的识字标准。

sentences.en: Since then Mississippi has seen remarkable gains.
sentences.zh: 从那时起，密西西比州取得了显着的进展。

sentences.en: Its fourth graders have moved from 49th（outof50 states）to 29th on the National Assessment of Educational Progress, a nationwide exam.
sentences.zh: 在全国教育进步评估（一项全国性考试）中，其四年级学生的排名从第 49 位（在 50 个州中）上升到第 29 位。

sentences.en: In 2019 it was the only state to improve its scores.
sentences.zh: 2019 年，它是唯一得分提高的州。

sentences.en: For the first time since measurement began, Mississippi’s pupils are now average readers, a remarkable achievement in such a poor state.
sentences.zh: 自测量开始以来，密西西比州的学生第一次成为普通读者，在如此贫穷的州，这是一项了不起的成就。

sentences.en: Mississippi's success is attributed to implementing reading methods supported by a body of research known as the science of reading.
sentences.zh: 密西西比州的成功归功于实施由阅读科学研究机构支持的阅读方法。

sentences.en: In 1997 Congress requested the National Institute of Child Health and Human Development and the Department of Education to convene a National Reading Panel to end the “reading wars” and synthesize the evidence.
sentences.zh: 1997年，国会要求国家儿童健康和人类发展研究所和教育部召集全国阅读小组，以结束“阅读大战”并综合证据。

sentences.en: The panel found that phonics, along with explicit instruction in phonemicawareness, fluency and comprehension, worked best.
sentences.zh: 小组发现，自然拼读法以及音素意识、流利度和理解力方面的明确指导效果最好。
sentences.note: phonics 译为自然拼读法；balanced literacy 为均衡读写教学法；whole language 为全语言教学法。三者是不同的教学理念。

sentences.en: Yet over two decades on,“balanced literacy” is still being taught in classrooms.
sentences.zh: 然而二十多年过去了，“均衡读写教学”仍在课堂上教授。

sentences.en: But advances in statistics and brain imaging have disproved the whole-language method.
sentences.zh: 但是统计学和脑成像的进步已经反驳了全语言方法。

sentences.en: To the teacher who is a proficient reader, literacy seems like a natural process that requires educated guessing, rather than the deliberate process emphasized by phonics.
sentences.zh: 对于精通阅读的老师来说，识字似乎是一个自然的过程，需要有根据的猜测，而不是拼读法强调的刻意过程。
sentences.note: phonics 译为自然拼读法；balanced literacy 为均衡读写教学法；whole language 为全语言教学法。三者是不同的教学理念。

sentences.en: Teachers can imagine that they learned to read through osmosiswhen they were children.
sentences.zh: 老师们可以想象，他们小时候是通过潜移默化学会阅读的。

sentences.en: Without proper training, they bring this to classrooms.
sentences.zh: 没有经过适当的培训，他们就把这个带到了教室。

articles.title: Advertising to children
articles.subtitle: 儿童广告与消费影响
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: How on earth did we come to this?
sentences.zh: 我们到底是怎么走到这一步的？

sentences.en: We protect our children obsessively from every harm; we scrutinize every carer, teacher or doctor with whom they come into contact.
sentences.zh: 我们竭力保护我们的孩子免受一切伤害；我们会仔细检查与他们接触的每一位护理人员、老师或医生。

sentences.en: Yet despite all this, one group, which in no way has their best interests at heart, has almost unconstrained access.
sentences.zh: 然而，尽管如此，一个绝不把自己的最大利益放在心上的群体却拥有几乎不受限制的访问权限。

sentences.en: We seem to take it for granted that advertisers and marketers are allowed to condition even the youngest children.
sentences.zh: 我们似乎理所当然地认为广告商和营销商甚至可以对最小的孩子进行调节。

sentences.en: Before children have even developed a proper sense of their own identity, or learned to handle money, they're encouraged to associate status and self-worth with stuff, and to look to external things such as fame and wealth for validation.
sentences.zh: 在孩子们对自己的身份形成正确的认识或学会处理金钱之前，他们就被鼓励将地位和自我价值与事物联系起来，并寻求外部事物（例如名誉和财富）的认可。

sentences.en: We're turning out little consumers rather than young citizens who will value themselves for what they contribute to the society in which they live.
sentences.zh: 我们培养的是小消费者，而不是年轻公民，他们会因为自己对所生活的社会所做的贡献而重视自己。

sentences.en: We've reached this point so gradually that many of us have never questioned it.
sentences.zh: 我们逐渐达到了这一点，以至于我们中的许多人从未质疑过它。

sentences.en: It's crept up on us in the 60 years since advertisers started to target the young and found that they could recruit them to a commercial assault on their parents.
sentences.zh: 自从广告商开始瞄准年轻人并发现他们可以招募他们对他们的父母进行商业攻击以来，这种现象在 60 年来悄然出现在我们身边。

sentences.en: We've come to know it as “pester power” or the ability of children to pressure parents to make certain purchases.
sentences.zh: 我们逐渐将其称为“纠缠力”或孩子迫使父母进行某些购买的能力。

sentences.en: Many psychologists, child development experts and educators point to research suggesting that this emerging cradle-to-grave consumerism is contributing to growing rates of low self-esteem, depression and other forms of mental illness.
sentences.zh: 许多心理学家、儿童发展专家和教育工作者指出，研究表明，这种从摇篮到坟墓的消费主义正在导致自卑、抑郁和其他形式的精神疾病的发病率不断上升。

sentences.en: Not all psychologists agree.
sentences.zh: 并非所有心理学家都同意。

sentences.en: There're plenty working hand in glove with a £12bn-a-year industry that has turned the manipulation of adult emotions and desires into an art form often literally.
sentences.zh: 这个每年产值达 120 亿英镑的行业与许多人密切合作，将成人情感和欲望的操纵变成了一种艺术形式（通常是字面上的艺术形式）。
sentences.note: hand in glove with 指与……密切合作，常带有批评意味；under-11s 指 11 岁以下儿童。

sentences.en: It's also one that's forever developing new ways to persuade our children to desire material possessions, and because of advertisements'viral effect they only need to infect a few to reach the many.
sentences.zh: 这也是一种不断开发新方法来说服我们的孩子渴望物质财富的方法，并且由于广告的病毒效应，他们只需要感染少数人就可以到达大多数人。

sentences.en: Advertising and marketing can serve a useful·purpose for children.
sentences.zh: 广告和营销可以为儿童提供有用的目的。

sentences.en: Marketing may help socialize children as consumers, inform them about products, and help them carve out unique identities as they reach adulthood.
sentences.zh: 营销可以帮助儿童作为消费者进行社交，向他们介绍产品，并帮助他们在成年后形成独特的身份。

sentences.en: Then, should we ban all advertising aimed at young children?
sentences.zh: 那么，我们是否应该禁止所有针对幼儿的广告呢？

sentences.en: I say yes.
sentences.zh: 我说是的。

sentences.en: Of course there'll be plenty of objections to an outright ban on advertising to the under-11s.
sentences.zh: 当然，对于彻底禁止向 11 岁以下儿童投放广告，会有很多人反对。

sentences.en: There'll be those who argue that would be a breach of freedom of speech and infringe the rights of corporations to brainwash little children into demanding their products.
sentences.zh: 会有人认为这违反了言论自由，侵犯了企业对小孩子进行洗脑以要求其产品的权利。

sentences.en: Most parents hate what advertising does to their children, but we do have the power to end it and let our children grow up free from many of the pressures of consumerism until they're old enough to make their own decisions.
sentences.zh: 大多数父母讨厌广告对他们的孩子造成的影响，但我们确实有能力结束广告，让我们的孩子在成长过程中摆脱消费主义的许多压力，直到他们长大到可以自己做决定。

sentences.en: And though advertising is only part of an all-pervasivemarketing culture we need to make a start somewhere.
sentences.zh: 虽然广告只是无处不在的营销文化的一部分，但我们需要从某个地方开始。

sentences.en: Let's ban all advertising targeting children of primary school age and younger now.
sentences.zh: 现在就应禁止所有面向小学年龄及更年幼儿童的广告。

articles.title: Surveillance in the workplace
articles.subtitle: 工作场所监控的利与弊
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Many oppose workplace surveillance, because of the inherent dehumanizing effect it has and the relentless pressure it brings.
sentences.zh: 许多人反对工作场所监视，因为它具有固有的非人性效应以及它带来的无情压力。

sentences.en: But it's on the rise around the world as firms look to become more efficient by squeezing more productivity from their workers.
sentences.zh: 但随着企业希望通过提高员工的生产力来提高效率，这种现象在世界范围内呈上升趋势。

sentences.en: More than half of companies with over$750m in annual revenue used “non-traditional"monitoring techniques on staff last year.
sentences.zh: 去年，超过一半年收入超过 7.5 亿美元的公司对员工使用了“非传统”监控技术。

sentences.en: Monitoring employee performance gives firms the ability to assess how their staff are performing and interacting, which can be good for both the firm and employees themselves.
sentences.zh: 监控员工绩效使公司能够评估员工的绩效和互动方式，这对公司和员工本身都有好处。

sentences.en: A growing number of analytics companies offer this service.
sentences.zh: 越来越多的分析公司提供此服务。

sentences.en: They gather “data exhaust” left by employees'email and instant messaging apps, and use name badges equipped with radio-frequency identification devices and microphones.
sentences.zh: 他们收集员工电子邮件和即时通讯应用程序留下的“数据废气”，并使用配备射频识别设备和麦克风的名牌。

sentences.en: These can check how much time you spend talking, your volume and tone of voice, even if you do not dominate conversations.
sentences.zh: 这些可以检查您说话的时间、音量和语气，即使您不主导对话。

sentences.en: While this may sound intrusive, exponents argue that it can also protect employees against bullying and sexual harassment.
sentences.zh: 虽然这听起来可能有侵犯性，但支持者认为，它还可以保护员工免受欺凌和性骚扰。

sentences.en: Some of this data analysis can produce unexpected results.
sentences.zh: 某些数据分析可能会产生意想不到的结果。

sentences.en: For example, it was found that people who sat at 12-person lunch tables tended to interact, share ideas more and outperform those who regularly sat at four person tables, a fact that would probably have gone undetected without such data analysis.
sentences.zh: 例如，我们发现，坐在 12 人餐桌旁的人倾向于互动、更多地分享想法，并且表现优于经常坐在 4 人餐桌旁的人，如果没有此类数据分析，这一事实可能不会被发现。

sentences.en: Over the last few years a Stockholm co-working space called Epicenter has gone much further and holds popular “chipping parties”,where people can have microchips implanted in their hands.
sentences.zh: 在过去的几年里，斯德哥尔摩一个名为 Epicenter 的联合办公空间走得更远，举办了流行的“芯片派对”，人们可以在手中植入微芯片。

sentences.en: They can use the implants to access electronically-controlled doors, or monitor how typing speed correlates with heart rate.
sentences.zh: 他们可以使用植入物进入电子控制门，或监测打字速度与心率的关系。

sentences.en: Implanted chips may seem extreme, but it is a relatively small step from ID cards and biometrics to such devices.
sentences.zh: 植入芯片可能看起来很极端，但从身份证和生物识别技术到此类设备，这只是相对较小的一步。

sentences.en: As long as such schemes are voluntary, there will probably be a growing number of convenience-oriented uses so that a substantial number of workers would opt to have a chip inserted.
sentences.zh: 只要此类计划是自愿的，就可能会有越来越多的以便利为导向的用途，以便大量工人会选择插入芯片。

sentences.en: But if implanted chips are used to reduce slack time or rest breaks, that could prove to be detrimental.
sentences.zh: 但如果使用植入芯片来减少松弛时间或休息时间，这可能会被证明是有害的。

sentences.en: And if surveillance tools take away autonomy, that's when they prove most unpopular.
sentences.zh: 如果监控工具剥夺了自主权，那就是它们最不受欢迎的时候。

sentences.en: A lot depends on how such monitoring initiatives are communicated and this could prevent possible revolts being staged.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上取决于如何传达此类监控举措，这可以防止可能发生的叛乱。

sentences.en: If bosses don't communicate effectively, employees assume the worst.
sentences.zh: 如果老板不能有效沟通，员工就会做最坏的打算。

sentences.en: But if they're open about the information they're collecting and what they're doing with it, research suggests 46% of employees are generally okay with it.
sentences.zh: 但如果他们对所收集的信息以及他们正在用这些信息做什么持开放态度，研究表明 46% 的员工通常对此表示同意。

sentences.en: Although many such monitoring schemes use anonymised data and participation is voluntary, many staffers remain sceptical and fear an erosion of their civil liberties.
sentences.zh: 尽管许多此类监测计划使用匿名数据并且参与是自愿的，但许多工作人员仍然持怀疑态度，并担心他们的公民自由受到侵蚀。

sentences.en: So workplace surveillance could be empowering for staff and useful for companies looking to become more efficient and profitable.
sentences.zh: 因此，工作场所监控可以增强员工的能力，并对希望提高效率和盈利能力的公司有用。

sentences.en: But implemented in the wrong way, it could also become an unpopular tool of oppression that proves counterproductive.
sentences.zh: 但如果以错误的方式实施，它也可能成为一种不受欢迎的压迫工具，从而适得其反。
sentences.note: counterproductive 意为适得其反；文章区分监控的实施方式与其可能带来的不同效果。

articles.title: The pull of ultra-processed food
articles.subtitle: 垃圾食品为何让人停不下来
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: If you're someone who has turned to snacking on junk food more in the pandemic, you're not alone.
sentences.zh: 如果你在疫情期间也更多地吃起了垃圾食品零食，那么有这种情况的并非只有你。

sentences.en: Investigative reporter Michael Moss says processed food is engineered to hook you, not unlike alcohol, cigarettes, or other harmful substances.
sentences.zh: 调查记者迈克尔·莫斯 (Michael Moss) 表示，加工食品的设计就是为了吸引你，就像酒精、香烟或其他有害物质一样。

sentences.en: His 2013 book, Salt Sugar Fat, explored food companies’aggressive marketing of those products and their impact on our health.
sentences.zh: 他 2013 年出版的书《盐糖脂肪》探讨了食品公司对这些产品的积极营销及其对我们健康的影响。

sentences.en: In his new book, Hooked, Moss updates the food giants' efforts to keep us eating what they serve, and how they're responding to complaints from consumers and health advocates.
sentences.zh: 莫斯在他的新书《Hooked》中更新了食品巨头为让我们吃他们所提供的东西所做的努力，以及他们如何回应消费者和健康倡导者的投诉。

sentences.en: Processed food is inexpensive, it's legal, and it's everywhere.
sentences.zh: 加工食品价格低廉、合法，而且随处可见。

sentences.en: Companies’advertising is cueing us to remember those products and we want those products constantly.
sentences.zh: 公司的广告正在提示我们记住这些产品，并且我们不断地想要这些产品。

sentences.en: So the food environment is one of those key things that makes food even more problematic for so many people.
sentences.zh: 因此，食品环境是导致许多人的食品问题更加严重的关键因素之一。

sentences.en: Memory, nostalgiain particular, plays a big role in the foods we crave.
sentences.zh: 记忆，尤其是怀旧，在我们渴望的食物中发挥着重要作用。

sentences.en: Soda companies discovered that if they put a soda in the hands of a child when they're at a ballgame with their parents, that soda will forever be associated with that joyous moment.
sentences.zh: 汽水公司发现，如果他们在孩子与父母一起看球赛时将汽水放在孩子手中，那么汽水将永远与那个欢乐的时刻联系在一起。

sentences.en: Later in life, when that child wants to experience a joyous moment, they're going to think of soda.
sentences.zh: 在以后的生活中，当孩子想要体验快乐的时刻时，他们会想到苏打水。

sentences.en: Many people seek comfort in the snacks they remember from childhood.
sentences.zh: 许多人从童年记忆中的零食中寻求安慰。

sentences.en: Moss examines the way companies capitalize on our memories, cravings and brain chemistry to keep us snacking.
sentences.zh: 莫斯研究了公司如何利用我们的记忆、渴望和大脑化学物质来让我们吃零食。

sentences.en: One of the reasons I came to think that some of these food products are even more powerful, more troublesome than drugs can be is memory.
sentences.zh: 我开始认为这些食品比药物更强大、更麻烦的原因之一是记忆。

sentences.en: What we eat is all about memory.
sentences.zh: 我们吃的东西都是关于记忆的。

sentences.en: And we begin forming memories for food at a really early age.
sentences.zh: 我们很小的时候就开始形成对食物的记忆。

sentences.en: And we keep those memories for a lifetime.
sentences.zh: 我们会终生保留这些记忆。

sentences.en: Knowing this, the food industry spends lots of time trying to shape the memories that we have for their products.
sentences.zh: 食品行业知道这一点，因此花费了大量时间试图塑造我们对其产品的记忆。

sentences.en: One of the features of addiction that scientists studying drug addiction discovered back in the1990s was that the faster a substance hits the brain, the more apt we are as a result to act impulsively.
sentences.zh: 上世纪九十年代研究毒瘾的科学家发现的成瘾特征之一是，物质到达大脑的速度越快，我们就越容易做出冲动的行为。
sentences.note: addiction 指成瘾。文章同时谈消费者对食物的依赖，以及企业对既有盈利模式的依赖。

sentences.en: There's nothing faster than food in its ability to hit the brain.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比食物更快地冲击大脑了。

sentences.en: For Moss, this puts the notion of “fastfood” in an entirely new light as this isn't limited to fast food chains—almost 90% of food products in grocery stores are processed foods.
sentences.zh: 对于 Moss 来说，这让“快餐”的概念焕然一新，因为这不仅限于快餐连锁店——杂货店里几乎 90% 的食品都是加工食品。

sentences.en: Everything in the industry is about speed, from manufacturing to packaging.
sentences.zh: 行业中的一切都与速度有关，从制造到包装。

sentences.en: Overall, Moss outlines the industry's dependence on making their products inexpensive, super delicious， and incredibly convenient for consumers.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，莫斯概述了该行业对让其产品价格低廉、超级美味且为消费者带来难以置信的便利的依赖。

sentences.en: Now that more and more people care about what they put in their bodies and are wanting to eat healthier, these companies are finding it really difficult to meet that new demand because of their own addiction to making these convenience foods.
sentences.zh: 现在越来越多的人关心自己吃的东西，并希望吃得更健康，这些公司发现很难满足这种新的需求，因为他们自己对制作这些方便食品上瘾。
sentences.note: addiction 指成瘾。文章同时谈消费者对食物的依赖，以及企业对既有盈利模式的依赖。

articles.title: What chimpanzees teach us about people
articles.subtitle: 黑猩猩与人类的合作差异
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Chimpanzees, human beings'closest animal relatives, share up to 98% of our genes.
sentences.zh: 黑猩猩是人类最亲近的动物亲戚，与我们有高达 98% 的基因相同。
sentences.note: up to 表示最高达到。基因高度相似不代表行为与社会组织方式完全相同。

sentences.en: Yet humans and chimpanzees lead very different lives.
sentences.zh: 然而，人类和黑猩猩的生活却截然不同。

sentences.en: Fewer than 300,000 wild chimpanzees live in a few forested corners of Africa today, while humans have colonized every corner of the globe.
sentences.zh: 如今，不到 300,000 只野生黑猩猩生活在非洲的几个森林角落，而人类已经殖民了全球每个角落。

sentences.en: At more than 7 billion, human population dwarfs that of nearly all other mammals-despite our physical weaknesses.
sentences.zh: 人类人口超过 70 亿，使几乎所有其他哺乳动物相形见绌——尽管我们的体质较弱。

sentences.en: What could account for our species’incredible evolutionary successes?
sentences.zh: 什么可以解释我们物种令人难以置信的进化成功？

sentences.en: One obvious answer is our big brains.
sentences.zh: 一个明显的答案是我们的大脑。

sentences.en: It could be that our raw intelligence gave us an unprecedented ability to think outside the box, innovating solutions to thorny problems as people migrated across the globe.
sentences.zh: 我们的原始智慧可能赋予我们前所未有的跳出框框思考的能力，为人们在全球范围内移民时遇到的棘手问题提供创新的解决方案。

sentences.en: But a growing number of cognitive scientists and anthropologistsare rejecting that explanation.
sentences.zh: 但越来越多的认知科学家和人类学家拒绝这种解释。

sentences.en: They think that, rather than making our living as innovators, we survive and thrive precisely because we don't think for ourselves.
sentences.zh: 他们认为，我们之所以生存和繁荣，不是因为我们以创新者的身份谋生，而是因为我们不独立思考。

sentences.en: Instead, people cope with challenging climates and ecological contexts by carefully copying others.
sentences.zh: 相反，人们通过仔细模仿他人来应对具有挑战性的气候和生态环境。

sentences.en: In a famous study, psychologists Victoria Horner and Andrew Whiten showed two groups of test subjects children and chimpanzees-a mechanical box with a treat inside.
sentences.zh: 在一项著名的研究中，心理学家维多利亚·霍纳（Victoria Horner）和安德鲁·怀特恩（Andrew Whiten）向两组测试对象展示了儿童和黑猩猩——一个里面有零食的机械盒子。

sentences.en: In one condition, the box was opaque, while in the other it was transparent.
sentences.zh: 在一种情况下，盒子是不透明的，而在另一种情况下，盒子是透明的。

sentences.en: The experimenters demonstrated how to open the box to retrieve the treat, but they also included the irrelevant step of tapping on the box with a stick.
sentences.zh: 实验者演示了如何打开盒子来取出零食，但他们也包括了用棍子敲击盒子的不相关步骤。

sentences.en: Oddly, the children carefully copied all the steps to open the box, even when they could see that the stick had no practical effect.
sentences.zh: 奇怪的是，孩子们还是小心翼翼地复制了所有打开盒子的步骤，尽管他们可以看到棍子没有任何实际作用。

sentences.en: That is, they copied irrationally: Instead of doing only what was necessary to get their reward, children slavishly imitated every action they'd witnessed.
sentences.zh: 也就是说，他们非理性地模仿：孩子们不是只做获得奖励所必需的事情，而是盲目地模仿他们所目睹的每一个动作。

sentences.en: Of course, that study only included three-and four-year-olds.
sentences.zh: 当然，那项研究只包括三岁和四岁的孩子。

sentences.en: But additional research has shown that older children and adults are even more likely to mindlessly copy others’actions, and infants are less likely to over imitate—that is, to precisely copy even impractical actions.
sentences.zh: 但其他研究表明，年龄较大的儿童和成人更有可能无意识地模仿他人的行为，而婴儿则不太可能过度模仿，即精确地模仿甚至不切实际的行为。

sentences.en: By contrast, chimpanzees in the study only over-imitated in the opaque condition.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，研究中的黑猩猩只是在不透明的条件下过度模仿。

sentences.en: In the transparent condition-where they saw that the stick was mechanically useless-they ignored that step entirely.
sentences.zh: 在透明条件下——他们看到棍子在机械上毫无用处——他们完全忽略了这一步。

sentences.en: Other research has since supported these findings.
sentences.zh: 此后其他研究也支持了这些发现。

sentences.en: When it comes to copying, chimpanzees are more rational than human children or adults.
sentences.zh: 在模仿方面，黑猩猩比人类儿童或成人更理性。

sentences.en: Where does the seemingly irrational human preference for over-imitation come from?
sentences.zh: 人类看似非理性的过度模仿偏好从何而来？

sentences.en: Anthropologist Joseph Henrich points out that people around the world rely on technologies that are often so complex that no one can learn them rationally.
sentences.zh: 人类学家 Joseph Henrich 指出，世界各地的人们所依赖的技术往往非常复杂，以至于没有人能够理性地学习它们。

sentences.en: Instead, people must learn them step by step, trusting in the wisdom of more experienced elders and peers.
sentences.zh: 相反，人们必须一步一步地学习它们，相信更有经验的长辈和同龄人的智慧。

sentences.en: So the next time you hear someone arguing passionately that everyone should embrace nonconformity and avoid imitating others, you might laugh a little bit.
sentences.zh: 所以下次当你听到有人热情地争论每个人都应该拥抱不墨守成规，避免模仿别人时，你可能会笑一下。

sentences.en: We're not chimpanzees, after all.
sentences.zh: 毕竟我们不是黑猩猩。

articles.title: Work, self-worth and motivation
articles.subtitle: 工作、自尊与内在动力
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Many people associate their self-worth with their work.
sentences.zh: 许多人将自我价值与工作联系起来。
sentences.note: self-worth 指自我价值感；内在动力与为了维护自尊而工作，是文中需要区分的动机。

sentences.en: The more successful their career, the better they feel about themselves.
sentences.zh: 他们的事业越成功，他们对自己的感觉就越好。

sentences.en: Work-related self-esteem is therefore a worthy ideal to pursue with vigor, right?
sentences.zh: 因此，与工作相关的自尊是一个值得大力追求的理想，对吧？

sentences.en: Well, not always.
sentences.zh: 嗯，并非总是如此。

sentences.en: According to recent research, in which psychologists interviewed 370 full-time workers over a period of three weeks, the reality is a little more complicated.
sentences.zh: 根据最近的研究，心理学家在三周内采访了 370 名全职工人，现实情况要复杂一些。

sentences.en: And it involves negative as well as positive consequences.
sentences.zh: 它涉及消极和积极的后果。

sentences.en: It's natural to be drawn towards pleasure and to step away from pain.
sentences.zh: 趋向快乐并远离痛苦是很自然的。

sentences.en: In the workplace, if that pleasure comes from a triumph which swells our self-respect, people will try to repeat the accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 在工作场所，如果这种快乐来自于增强自尊的胜利，人们就会试图重复这种成就。

sentences.en: But repeating that accomplishment is often not realistic, which can lead to severe negative emotional consequences when it doesn't reoccur.
sentences.zh: 但重复这一成就通常是不现实的，当它不再发生时，可能会导致严重的负面情绪后果。

sentences.en: This form of motivation is widely regarded as a negative type of motivation.
sentences.zh: 这种形式的动机被广泛认为是消极类型的动机。

sentences.en: It can hinder other more positive motivation types, such as completing a task purely because it's fulfilling or enjoyable.
sentences.zh: 它可能会阻碍其他更积极的动机类型，例如纯粹因为任务有成就感或令人愉快而完成任务。

sentences.en: What consumes the employee instead is a pressing need to feel mighty and sure of themselves.
sentences.zh: 消耗员工的是对自己强大和自信的迫切需要。

sentences.en: They then take on only tasks and objectives which serve that ego-driven need.
sentences.zh: 然后，他们只承担满足自我驱动需求的任务和目标。

sentences.en: As a result, to avoid feelings of shame and worthlessness associated with failure, they extend themselves to such a degree that there's a subsequent adverse effect on their well-being.
sentences.zh: 因此，为了避免与失败相关的羞耻感和无价值感，他们将自己延伸到对他们的福祉产生不利影响的程度。

sentences.en: This internal pressure to succeed at all costs demands a lot of effort.
sentences.zh: 这种不惜一切代价取得成功的内部压力需要付出巨大的努力。

sentences.en: It depletes their energy, culminating in disproportionate levels of damaging sentiment.
sentences.zh: 它耗尽了他们的能量，最终导致了不成比例的破坏性情绪。

sentences.en: Those negative emotions mount into heightened anxiety, impacting their ability to make the most of their personal life.
sentences.zh: 这些负面情绪会加剧焦虑，影响他们充分利用个人生活的能力。

sentences.en: Their desire to avoid feeling inferior ends up making them feel inferior when it comes to their diminished capacity for friendship and leisure.
sentences.zh: 他们避免感到自卑的愿望最终使他们在友谊和休闲能力下降时感到自卑。

sentences.en: They end up dissatisfied both at work and outside of it.
sentences.zh: 他们最终对工作和工作之外都不满意。

sentences.en: But thankfully, for those people compelled almost entirely by this specific form of motivation, the news isn't all bad, or bad at all.
sentences.zh: 但值得庆幸的是，对于那些几乎完全被这种特定形式的动机所驱使的人来说，这个消息并不全是坏事，或者根本就不是坏事。

sentences.en: The study also discovered several positive outcomes that can actually outweigh the harmful ones.
sentences.zh: 该研究还发现了一些实际上可以超过有害结果的积极结果。

sentences.en: Though these types of employees are motivated by the desire to avoid negative consequences, they are also motivated by the excitement of pursuing emotional rewards.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些类型的员工的动机是避免负面后果，但他们也受到追求情感奖励的兴奋的动机。

sentences.en: This excitement makes pursuing goals enjoyable and stimulates pleasure and pride that would result from success.
sentences.zh: 这种兴奋使追求目标变得愉快，并激发成功带来的快乐和自豪感。

sentences.en: An effect of the positive motivation is that it neutralizes the existence of negative motivation.
sentences.zh: 积极动机的作用在于它抵消了消极动机的存在。

sentences.en: Sure, it affects people's personal lives to what could be deemed an unhealthy extent, because leisure activities are often seen as a part of life that must be sacrificed to manage work and family demands.
sentences.zh: 当然，它会影响人们的个人生活，达到可以被视为不健康的程度，因为休闲活动通常被视为生活的一部分，必须牺牲来满足工作和家庭需求。

sentences.en: However, the way people feel about their work has less to do with whether they're motivated by the preservation of self-esteem but more with the fact that they're simply motivated.
sentences.zh: 不过，人们对工作的感受，与他们是否为了维护自尊而受到激励关系较小，更多取决于他们本身有没有工作动力。

articles.title: Development within environmental limits
articles.subtitle: 发展不能透支地球
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Degradation of the world's natural resources by humans is rapidly outpacing the planet's ability to absorb the damage, a recent UN environmental study has found.
sentences.zh: 联合国最近一项环境研究发现，人类破坏全球自然资源的速度，正迅速超过地球承受这些损害的能力。
sentences.note: outpace 表示速度超过；句子比较人类破坏资源的速度与地球承受、修复损害的能力。

sentences.en: The study concludes that without radical action the level of prosperity that mill ions of people in the developed world count on will be impossible to maintain or extend to poorer countries.
sentences.zh: 该研究得出的结论是，如果不采取激进行动，发达国家数百万人民所依赖的繁荣水平将无法维持或扩展到较贫穷国家。

sentences.en: Water scarcity is the curse of some of the poorest regions on Earth, leaving developing countries increasingly unable to feed themselves, and causing hardship for millions of people.
sentences.zh: 水资源短缺是地球上一些最贫困地区的祸根，导致发展中国家越来越无法养活自己，并给数百万人带来困难。

sentences.en: There appears little prospect of this desperate situation being remedied without radical action being taken.
sentences.zh: 如果不采取激进的行动，这种绝望的局面似乎很难得到补救。

sentences.en: Water resources are under increasing threat from population growth, climate change, rapid urbanization, rising levels of consumption, and the degradation of lands that previously provided a natural replenishmentof water resources.
sentences.zh: 水资源正受到人口增长、气候变化、快速城市化、消费水平上升以及以前提供水资源自然补充的土地退化等日益严重的威胁。

sentences.en: The rate of damage to the natural environment was found to increase globally, despite concerted efforts to persuade government to take measures to improve the condition.
sentences.zh: 尽管共同努力说服政府采取措施改善状况，但全球自然环境的破坏率仍在增加。

sentences.en: “If current trends continue, and the world fails to improve patterns of production and consumption, then the state of the world’s environment will continue to decline,” warned UN executive director Achim Steiner.
sentences.zh: “如果目前的趋势持续下去，而世界未能改善生产和消费模式，那么世界环境状况将继续恶化，”联合国执行主任阿奇姆·施泰纳警告说。

sentences.en: He said the tools for improving the environment for millions of people existed in developed countries, but were in danger of not being used.
sentences.zh: 他说，发达国家已有改善数百万人环境的工具，但面临不被使用的危险。

sentences.en: The study found that basic measures to tackle some of the key causes of environmental damage were still not being taken.
sentences.zh: 研究发现，针对一些造成环境破坏的主要原因，仍未采取基本措施。

sentences.en: These included measures to reduce air pollution; to control the damage to marine ecosystems, which can have a huge effect on fish stocks on which hundreds of millions of people depend; and to curb the degradation of land where modem agricultural methods were pursued without regard to the longer-term consequences.
sentences.zh: 其中包括减少空气污染的措施；控制对海洋生态系统的破坏，这可能对数亿人赖以生存的鱼类种群产生巨大影响；并在不考虑长期后果的情况下推行现代农业方法来遏制土地退化。

sentences.en: Despite the recent global agreement on cutting greenhouse gas emissions, global carbon output continues to rise.
sentences.zh: 尽管最近就减少温室气体排放达成了全球协议，但全球碳排放量仍在持续上升。

sentences.en: This will put a long-term strain on the ability of developing economies to feed their own people.
sentences.zh: 这将对发展中经济体养活本国人民的能力造成长期压力。

sentences.en: Climate change is aggravated by the emissions of greenhouse gases from chemical and natural fertilisers used in agriculture which increased by more than a quarter between2000 and2010.
sentences.zh: 农业中使用的化学肥料和天然肥料产生的温室气体排放量在2000年至2010年间增加了四分之一以上，加剧了气候变化。

sentences.en: Other problem areas identified in the report included glaciers, which provide vital water resources for millions of people, but which are shrinking as the climate warms.
sentences.zh: 报告中确定的其他问题领域包括冰川，它为数百万人提供重要的水资源，但随着气候变暖，冰川正在萎缩。

sentences.en: In rich countries, these problems have built up over decades and centuries while economic growth was pursued at the expense of the environment.
sentences.zh: 在富裕国家，这些问题是在数十年和数百年的时间里积累起来的，而经济增长是以牺牲环境为代价的。

sentences.en: Subsequent efforts to remedy the environment have met with partial success.
sentences.zh: 后续的环境整治工作已取得部分成功。

sentences.en: But in developing countries, the path of future development has more potential to change, which has encouraged international institutions to devise more sustainable growth pathways that are supposed both to alleviate poverty and preserve the environment.
sentences.zh: 但在发展中国家，未来发展道路有更大的改变潜力，这鼓励国际机构设计更可持续的增长路径，既能减轻贫困，又能保护环境。

articles.title: Who benefits from student debt relief
articles.subtitle: 免除学生贷款能否帮助穷人
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Some people in the US have asserted that forgiving student loan debt is one way to stimulate the economy and give assistance to those in need.
sentences.zh: 美国一些人声称，免除学生贷款债务是刺激经济、向有需要的人提供援助的一种方式。
sentences.note: forgive debt 指免除债务；不是日常意义上的“原谅”。注意作者对受益群体的分析。

sentences.en: One government proposition is to eliminate $10,000 of debt for^economically distressed’s students.
sentences.zh: 政府的一项提议是消除经济困难的学生 10,000 美元的债务。

sentences.en: Some in US Congress have gone so far as to suggest forgiving up to $50,000 in debt per student borrower, but does forgiving student debt necessarily correlate to helping the economically disadvantaged?
sentences.zh: 美国国会的一些人甚至建议免除每个学生借款人高达 50,000 美元的债务，但免除学生债务是否一定与帮助经济弱势群体相关？

sentences.en: The answer is no.
sentences.zh: 答案是否定的。

sentences.en: This policy is just giving money away to universities and the most affluent students in attendance.
sentences.zh: 这项政策只是给大学和最富裕的在校学生送钱。

sentences.en: Federal Reserve data reveals that the highest-income 40 percent of households owe approximately 60 percent of outstanding student debt, while the lowest 40 percent owe just under 20 percent.
sentences.zh: 美联储数据显示，收入最高的 40% 家庭欠下了大约 60% 的未偿还学生债务，而收入最低的 40% 家庭则欠了不到 20%。

sentences.en: This could be due to a combination of factors: students from high-income households are more likely to go to expensive colleges, less likely to receive financial aid, and more likely to have high incomes post-graduation.
sentences.zh: 这可能是多种因素造成的：来自高收入家庭的学生更有可能进入昂贵的大学，获得经济援助的可能性较小，毕业后更有可能获得高收入。

sentences.en: Plus, the majority of student debt is held by graduate degree earners, who earn approximately percent more than their undergraduate counterparts.
sentences.zh: 另外，大部分学生债务由研究生学位获得者承担，他们的收入比本科生高出大约 %。

sentences.en: Clearly, giving free reign to banks to forgive student debt is a step in the wrong direction.
sentences.zh: 显然，让银行自由地免除学生债务是朝着错误方向迈出的一步。

sentences.en: Other proposals for broader, long-term student loan plans have some fundamental problems.
sentences.zh: 关于更广泛、长期的学生贷款计划的其他提案存在一些根本性问题。

sentences.en: One idea is to cancel student debt only for undergraduate degrees and for students making less than $125,000.
sentences.zh: 一个想法是仅取消本科学位和收入低于 125,000 美元的学生的学生债务。

sentences.en: This attempts to address the fact that Congress? previously mentioned student loan forgiveness plan largely helps out the wealthy, but is an adverse incentive for universities to keep raising tuition and for students to choose to major in low-earning degree programs.
sentences.zh: 这试图解决国会？前面提到的学生贷款减免计划在很大程度上帮助了富人，但对大学继续提高学费和学生选择低收入学位课程来说是一种不利的激励。

sentences.en: Colleges have no reason to make their programs more affordable if they believe students will just take out more debt.
sentences.zh: 如果大学相信学生只会承担更多债务，那么他们就没有理由让他们的课程变得更便宜。

sentences.en: And, students will feel more comfortable making the irresponsible decision to go tens of thousands of dollars in debt to major in impractical or idealistic subjects if they know their loans will be forgiven.
sentences.zh: 而且，如果学生知道自己的贷款会被免除，他们会更放心地做出不负责任的决定，背负数万美元的债务去主修不切实际或理想主义的科目。

sentences.en: This is especially concerning given the pandemichas rendered a college education practically worthless.
sentences.zh: 鉴于大流行使大学教育几乎毫无价值，这一点尤其令人担忧。

sentences.en: Students are paying tens of thousands of dollars per year to live at home and be lectured on the Internet.
sentences.zh: 学生每年支付数万美元住在家里并在互联网上上课。

sentences.en: Do we really want to tell colleges that they can get away with providing below-average service for an outrageous cost?
sentences.zh: 我们真的想告诉大学，他们可以以高得离谱的成本提供低于平均水平的服务吗？

sentences.en: In the case of any of these student debt plans, working-class Americans who chose not to or could not afford togo to college will be subsidizing the education of the professional class.
sentences.zh: 在任何这些学生债务计划的情况下，选择不或无力上大学的美国工薪阶层将补贴专业阶层的教育。

sentences.en: Plumbers and retail workers will be paying for the degrees of doctors and lawyers.
sentences.zh: 水管工和零售工人将支付医生和律师学位的费用。

sentences.en: The US government's effort to help those in debt is commendable but is this really the solution that will help the poor financially recover?
sentences.zh: 美国政府帮助债务人的努力值得称赞，但这真的能帮助穷人恢复经济吗？

articles.title: Children and screen time
articles.subtitle: 儿童使用屏幕的新建议
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: If there’s one rule that most parents cling to in the confusing, fast-changing world of kids and media, it's “No screens before age 2."
sentences.zh: 如果说在这个令人困惑、瞬息万变的儿童和媒体世界中，大多数父母都遵守一条规则的话，那就是“2 岁之前不要看屏幕”。

sentences.en: As of today, that rule has been thrown out the window The American Academy of Pediatrics(AAP),which first issued that recommendation back in 1999,has extensively updated and revised its guidelines for children and adolescents to reflect new research and new habits The new guidelines, especially for very young children, shift the focus from WHAT is on the screen to WHO else is in the room.
sentences.zh: 截至今天，这条规则已被抛到了九霄云外。美国儿科学会 (AAP) 于 1999 年首次发布了该建议，现已广泛更新和修订了针对儿童和青少年的指南，以反映新的研究和新的习惯。新的指南，特别是针对年幼的儿童，将焦点从屏幕上的内容转移到房间里的其他人。

sentences.en: And in doing so, they raise some intriguing points about the future of learning from media.
sentences.zh: 在此过程中，他们提出了一些关于媒体学习的未来的有趣观点。

sentences.en: For babies younger than 18 months, AAP still says no screens at all are the best idea—with one notable exception: Live video chat.
sentences.zh: 对于 18 个月以下的婴儿，AAP 仍然表示最好不要使用屏幕，但有一个明显的例外：实时视频聊天。

sentences.en: Surveys indicate that families already popularly believe that “Face time doesn’t count", or at least that the benefit of virtual visits with grandparents or other relatives outweighs the potential cost of exposing babies to the laptop or smartphone.
sentences.zh: 调查表明，家庭已经普遍认为“面对面的时间不算数”，或者至少认为与祖父母或其他亲戚进行虚拟拜访的好处超过了让婴儿接触笔记本电脑或智能手机的潜在成本。

sentences.en: The AAP doesn’t cite positive evidence that infants actually get something out of this kind of “conversation",the way that they clearly do from live social interaction.
sentences.zh: 美国儿科学会没有引用积极的证据表明婴儿实际上从这种“对话”中得到了一些东西，就像他们从实时社交互动中明显得到的那样。

sentences.en: But there’s some observational research that infants as young as six months old are emotionally engaged by playing live peekaboowith Grandma online.
sentences.zh: 但有一些观察性研究表明，六个月大的婴儿会通过与奶奶在线玩现场躲猫猫来进行情感投入。

sentences.en: For infants and toddlers ,ages 15 months to 2 years old, there's limited evidence from a couple of very small studies that they can learn new words from educational media, if and only if parents are watching alongside them, repeating what the video says and/or drawing attention to what is on the screen.
sentences.zh: 对于 15 个月至 2 岁的婴儿和幼儿，几项小型研究的有限证据表明，当且仅当父母在他们旁边观看、重复视频内容和/或吸引人们注意屏幕上的内容时，他们可以从教育媒体中学习新单词。

sentences.en: In other words, treating a video or an app like a picture book is the best bet.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，把视频或应用程序当作图画书来对待是最好的选择。

sentences.en: The flip side of this is that many studies have actually shown poorer language skills correlated with earlier solo viewing of “educational"videos.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，许多研究实际上表明，较早单独观看“教育”视频的语言能力较差。

sentences.en: There’s also research that shows language delays in children who watch more TV and start watching earlier.
sentences.zh: 还有研究表明，看电视越多、开始看电视的时间越早，孩子的语言能力也会出现延迟。

sentences.en: In both cases, the problem seems tobe media replacing interaction with people.
sentences.zh: 在这两种情况下，问题似乎都是媒体取代了人与人之间的互动。

sentences.en: For this reason, the new AAP guideline has changed from “avoid all screens under age 2"to “avoid solo media use in this age group."" For preschoolers ages 2 to 5, there’s more evidence that they have the ability to transfer knowledge from screens to the real world, including early literacy and math.
sentences.zh: 因此，新的 AAP 指南从“避免 2 岁以下的所有屏幕”改为“避免在该年龄段单独使用媒体”。对于 2 至 5 岁的学龄前儿童，有更多证据表明他们有能力将知识从屏幕转移到现实世界，包括早期识字和数学。

sentences.en: For this age group, AAP recommends no more than an hour a day of screen use.
sentences.zh: 对于这个年龄段，AAP 建议每天使用屏幕的时间不要超过一小时。

sentences.en: And, just as with younger children, they want care-givers to take part in screen time: “Co-view with your children, help children understand what they are seeing, and help them apply what they learn to the world around them."
sentences.zh: 而且，就像年幼的孩子一样，他们希望看护者参与屏幕时间：“与孩子共同观看，帮助孩子理解他们所看到的内容，并帮助他们将学到的知识应用到周围的世界。”
sentences.note: co-view 指家长与孩子一起观看，并帮助孩子理解内容、联系现实，而非单纯限制时长。

articles.title: Cell renewal and healthy ageing
articles.subtitle: 细胞更新与健康老化
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: How can one person enjoy good health, while another person looks old before her time?
sentences.zh: 为什么有人身体健康，另一些人却未老先衰？
sentences.note: before one's time 在这里指过早；cell renewal 是细胞更新，不是单纯的外表年轻。

sentences.en: Humans have been asking this question for thousands of years, and recently, it's becoming clearer and clearer to scientists that the differences between people’s rates of aging lie in the complex interactions among genes, social relationships, environments and lifestyles.
sentences.zh: 人类几千年来一直在问这个问题，最近，科学家们越来越清楚地认识到，人们衰老速度的差异在于基因、社会关系、环境和生活方式之间复杂的相互作用。

sentences.en: Even though you were born with a particular set of genes, the way you live can influence how they express themselves.
sentences.zh: 即使您生来就有一组特定的基因，您的生活方式也会影响它们的表达方式。

sentences.en: Some lifestyle factors may even turn genes on or shut them off.
sentences.zh: 一些生活方式因素甚至可能打开或关闭基因。

sentences.en: Deep within the genetic heart of all our cells are telomeres, or repeating segments of non coding DNA that live at the ends of the chromosomes.
sentences.zh: 端粒位于我们所有细胞的遗传核心深处，即位于染色体末端的非编码 DNA 重复片段。

sentences.en: They form caps at the ends of the chromosomes and keep the genetic material together.
sentences.zh: 它们在染色体末端形成帽子并将遗传物质保持在一起。

sentences.en: Shortening with each cell division, they help determine how fast a cell ages.
sentences.zh: 每次细胞分裂都会缩短，它们有助于确定细胞老化的速度。

sentences.en: When they become too short, the cell stops dividing altogether.
sentences.zh: 当它们变得太短时，细胞完全停止分裂。

sentences.en: This isn't the only reason a cell can age—there are other stresses on cells we don’t yet understand very well—but short telomeres are one of the major reasons human cells grow old.
sentences.zh: 这并不是细胞衰老的唯一原因——我们还不太了解细胞上还有其他压力——但端粒短是人类细胞衰老的主要原因之一。

sentences.en: We've devoted most of our careers to studying telomeres, and one extraordinary discovery from our labs is that telomeres can actually lengthen.
sentences.zh: 我们将大部分职业生涯投入到研究端粒上，我们实验室的一项非凡发现是端粒实际上可以延长。

sentences.en: Scientists have learned that several thought patterns appear to be unhealthy for telomeres, and one of them is cynical hostility.
sentences.zh: 科学家们了解到，有几种思维模式似乎对端粒不健康，其中之一就是愤世嫉俗的敌意。

sentences.en: Cynical hostility is defined by high anger and frequent thoughts that other people cannot be trusted.
sentences.zh: 愤世嫉俗的敌意是指高度愤怒和经常认为其他人不值得信任。

sentences.en: Someone with hostility doesn’t just think, “I hate to stand in long lines"; they think, “Others deliberately sped up and beat me tomy rightful position in the line!"—and then get violently agitated.
sentences.zh: 怀有敌意的人不仅仅会想“我讨厌排长队”；他还会想“我讨厌排长队”。他们想：“其他人故意加快速度，把我抢到了队伍中应有的位置！”——然后变得非常焦躁。

sentences.en: People who score high on measures of cynical hostility tend to get more heart disease, metabolic disease and often die at younger ages.
sentences.zh: 在愤世嫉俗的敌意测量中得分高的人往往会患更多的心脏病、代谢疾病，并且通常会在更年轻​​的时候死亡。

sentences.en: They also have shorter telomeres.
sentences.zh: 它们的端粒也较短。

sentences.en: In a study of British civil servants, men who scored high on measures of cynical hostility had shorter telomeres than men whose hostility scores were low.
sentences.zh: 在一项针对英国公务员的研究中，愤世嫉俗敌意得分高的男性比敌意得分低的男性端粒更短。

sentences.en: The most hostile men were30% more likely to have short telomeres.
sentences.zh: 最具敌意的男性端粒较短的可能性高出 30%。

sentences.en: What this means: aging is a dynamic process that could possibly be accelerated or slowed and, in some aspects, even reversed.
sentences.zh: 这意味着什么：衰老是一个动态过程，可能会加速或减慢，在某些方面甚至可能逆转。

sentences.en: To an extent, it has surprised us and the rest of the scientific community that telomeres do not simply carry out the commands issued by your genetic code.
sentences.zh: 在某种程度上，端粒不仅仅执行遗传密码发出的命令，这让我们和科学界的其他人感到惊讶。

sentences.en: Your telomeres are listening to you.
sentences.zh: 你的端粒在听你说话。

sentences.en: The foods you eat, your response to challenges, the amount of exercise you get, and many other factors appear to influence your telomeres and can prevent premature aging at the cellular level.
sentences.zh: 您吃的食物、您对挑战的反应、您的运动量以及许多其他因素似乎都会影响您的端粒，并可以在细胞水平上防止过早衰老。

sentences.en: One of the keys to enjoying good health is simply doing your part to foster healthy cell renewal.
