sentences.zh: 享受健康的关键之一就是尽自己的一份力量促进健康的细胞更新。

articles.title: An enzyme that breaks down plastic
articles.subtitle: 分解塑料的酶与环境代价
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Scientists have created by accident an enzymethat breaks down plastic drinks bottles.
sentences.zh: 科学家偶然创造了一种可以分解塑料饮料瓶的酶。

sentences.en: The breakthrough could help solve the global plastic pollution crisis by enabling for the first time the full recycling of bottles.
sentences.zh: 这一突破首次实现了瓶子的完全回收，有助于解决全球塑料污染危机。

sentences.en: The new research was spurred by the discovery in 2016 of the first bacterium that had naturally evolved to eat plastic at a waste dump in Japan.
sentences.zh: 这项新研究是由 2016 年在日本垃圾场发现的第一种自然进化来吃塑料的细菌所推动的。

sentences.en: Scientists have now revealed the detailed structure of the crucial enzyme produced by the bug.
sentences.zh: 科学家们现已揭示了该虫子产生的关键酶的详细结构。

sentences.en: An international team then adjusted the enzyme to see how it had evolved, but tests showed they had accidentally made the molecule even better at breaking down the plastic used for drinks bottles.
sentences.zh: 一个国际团队随后调整了这种酶，看看它是如何进化的，但测试表明，他们意外地使该分子能够更好地分解用于饮料瓶的塑料。

sentences.en: “What actually turned out was we improved the enzyme, which was a bit of a shock,” said head researcher Prof. McGeehan, at the University of Portsmouth, UK.
sentences.zh: “实际结果是我们改进了酶，这有点令人震惊，”英国朴茨茅斯大学首席研究员 McGeehan 教授说。

sentences.en: Currently, the enzyme takes a few days to start breaking down the plastic, far faster than the centuries it takes in the oceans, but the researchers are optimistic this can be speeded up even further and become a viable large-scale process.
sentences.zh: 目前，这种酶需要几天的时间才能开始分解塑料，这比在海洋中需要几个世纪的时间要快得多，但研究人员乐观地认为，这可以进一步加快，并成为一个可行的大规模过程。

sentences.en: "What we are hoping to do is use this enzyme to turn this plastic back into its original components, so we can literally recycle it back to plastic,” said McGeehan.
sentences.zh: “我们希望做的是使用这种酶将这种塑料转化回其原始成分，这样我们就可以将其回收回塑料，”McGeehan 说。

sentences.en: “It means we won't need to dig up any more oil and, fundamentally, it should reduce the amount of plastic in the environment."
sentences.zh: “这意味着我们不再需要开采更多的石油，而且从根本上说，它应该减少环境中的塑料量。”

sentences.en: About 1 million plastic bottles are sold each minute around the globe and, with just 14% recycled, many end up in the oceans where they have polluted even the remotest parts, harming marine life and potentially people who eat sea food.
sentences.zh: 全球每分钟售出约 100 万个塑料瓶，其中只有 14% 被回收利用，许多塑料瓶最终流入海洋，甚至污染了最偏远的地区，危害海洋生物，并可能危害食用海鲜的人们。

sentences.en: “Plastic is incredibly resistant to degradation,” said McGeehan.
sentences.zh: “塑料具有令人难以置信的抗降解能力，”McGeehan 说。

sentences.en: “It is one of these wonder materials that has been made a little bit too well."
sentences.zh: “这是一种制作得有点太好的神奇材料。”

sentences.en: Currently those bottles that are recycled can only be turned into opaque fibres for clothing or carpets, while the new enzyme indicates a way to recycle old clear plastic bottles back into new clear plastic bottles.
sentences.zh: 目前那些被回收的瓶子只能变成用于衣服或地毯的不透明纤维，而新的酶表明了一种将旧的透明塑料瓶回收成新的透明塑料瓶的方法。

sentences.en: "You are always up against the fact oil is cheap, so plastic is cheap,” said McGeehan.
sentences.zh: “你总是要面对这样一个事实：石油很便宜，所以塑料也很便宜，”麦吉汉说。

sentences.en: "It is so easy for manufacturers to generate more of that stuff, rather than even try to recycle, but I believe there is a public interest here: perception is changing so much that companies are starting to look at how they can properly recycle these bottles."
sentences.zh: “制造商很容易生产更多这样的东西，而不是尝试回收，但我相信这里有公众利益：观念正在发生巨大变化，以至于公司开始考虑如何正确回收这些瓶子。”

sentences.en: Prof. Adisa Azapagic, at the University of Manchester in the UK, agreed the enzyme could be useful but added:“A full life-cycle assessment would be needed to ensure that the technology does not solve one environmental problem—waste—at the expense of others, including additional greenhouse gas emissions."
sentences.zh: 英国曼彻斯特大学的阿迪萨·阿扎帕吉奇教授同意，这种酶可能有用，但她补充说：“需要进行完整的生命周期评估，确保这项技术在解决废弃物这一环境问题时，不会造成包括额外温室气体排放在内的其他环境代价。”
sentences.note: at the expense of 表示以牺牲……为代价。末句提醒应做完整生命周期评估，防止解决一个问题却制造其他环境问题。

articles.title: Reining in the technology giants
articles.subtitle: 科技巨头与全球反垄断
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: The U. S. and China don't agree on much these days.
sentences.zh: 如今，美国和中国在很多问题上没有达成一致。

sentences.en: Germany and France share a border and a currency but are frequently at odds.
sentences.zh: 德国和法国共享边界和货币，但经常发生争执。

sentences.en: The U. K. and India like to march to their own drum.
sentences.zh: 英国和印度喜欢按自己的鼓点前进。

sentences.en: But there9s one issue on which all these countries see eye to eye: Technology companies are too big, too powerful, and too profitable.
sentences.zh: 但有一个问题是所有这些国家都看法一致的：科技公司太大、太强大、太赚钱。
sentences.note: see eye to eye 表示意见一致；rein in 表示约束、控制；antitrust 指反垄断。

sentences.en: And that power is only likely to intensify, leaving governments with no choice but to confront it head-on by taking the companies to court, passing new competition laws, and perhaps even breaking up the tech giants.
sentences.zh: 这种力量只会增强，让政府别无选择，只能正面对抗，将公司告上法庭，通过新的竞争法，甚至可能拆分科技巨头。

sentences.en: China is the latest to implement an anti-trust crackdown, unveiling anti-monopoly rules last month.
sentences.zh: 中国是最新实施反垄断打击的国家，上个月公布了反垄断规则。

sentences.en: The draft rules followed the surprise suspension of a $ 37 billion stock offering by billionaire Jack Ma's Ant Group Co., making clear that no company can evade the government's regulation.
sentences.zh: 该规则草案是在亿万富翁马云的蚂蚁集团有限公司意外暂停 370 亿美元股票发行之后制定的，明确规定任何公司都不能逃避政府的监管。

sentences.en: The moves in China coincide with accelerating efforts in the U. S. and Europe to rein in Amazon.com, Apple, Facebook, and Google.
sentences.zh: 中国的举措与美国和欧洲加速遏制亚马逊、苹果、Facebook 和谷歌的努力同时发生。

sentences.en: “The big get bigger and bigger but without being better,” says Andreas Schwab, a German member of the European Parliament who championed a 2014 resolution to break up Google, “Growing economic power, growing influence on local markets all over the world, and a growing concern of competitors and consumers altogether have made it happen now.”
sentences.zh: “大公司变得越来越大，但并没有变得更好，”欧洲议会德国议员安德烈亚斯·施瓦布 (Andreas Schwab) 表示，他在 2014 年支持了分拆谷歌的决议，“不断增长的经济实力、对全球本地市场的影响力不断增强，以及对竞争对手和消费者日益增长的担忧，共同促成了这一目标的实现。”

sentences.en: In this new anti-trust era, the old focus on pricing power no longer applies, because several of the biggest tech companies have established trillion-dollar monopolies by charging consumers next to nothing.
sentences.zh: 在这个新的反垄断时代，过去对定价权的关注不再适用，因为几家最大的科技公司通过向消费者几乎不收取任何费用而建立了数万亿美元的垄断地位。

sentences.en: Tech giants are increasingly assuming powerful positions in banking, finance, advertising, retail, and other markets that force smaller businesses to rely on their platforms to reach customers.
sentences.zh: 科技巨头越来越多地在银行、金融、广告、零售和其他市场占据强大地位，迫使小型企业依赖其平台来接触客户。

sentences.en: For years, Europe alone confronted the power of digital giants.
sentences.zh: 多年来，欧洲独自对抗数字巨头的力量。

sentences.en: Governments were alarmed that European companies were failing to match Silicon Valley's innovations or to stop Google and Facebook from vacuuming up personal data and, with that, advertising revenue.
sentences.zh: 各国政府对欧洲公司未能赶上硅谷的创新或阻止谷歌和 Facebook 获取个人数据以及广告收入感到震惊。

sentences.en: Led by Margrethe Vestager, the European Union's competition chief, countries have sought to police the market and encourage fair play.
sentences.zh: 在欧盟竞争主管玛格丽特·维斯塔格 (Margrethe Vestager) 的领导下，各国一直在寻求监管市场并鼓励公平竞争。

sentences.en: In China the crackdown has been driven at least partly by fear that the homegrown tech industry is becoming too powerful.
sentences.zh: 在中国，打击行动至少部分是由于担心本土科技行业变得过于强大而推动的。

sentences.en: The country has long championed Alibaba and Tencent, but their massive accumulation of data on the Chinese citizenry is a growing concern for Beijing.
sentences.zh: 该国长期以来一直支持阿里巴巴和腾讯，但它们积累的有关中国公民的大量数据越来越引起北京的担忧。

sentences.en: In the U. S., a new breed of anti-trust experts argues that consideration should be given to privacy, control over data, workers'rights and the overall impact on smaller companies.
sentences.zh: 在美国，新一代反垄断专家认为，应考虑隐私、数据控制、工人权利以及对小公司的整体影响。

sentences.en: And the public in general have grown increasingly skeptical of social media companies.
sentences.zh: 公众对社交媒体公司越来越持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: More than 60% say the sector has a negative effect on the country, and almost half want more regulation for social media, according to a 2020 Pew Research Center study
sentences.zh: 根据皮尤研究中心 2020 年的一项研究，超过 60% 的人表示该行业对国家有负面影响，近一半的人希望对社交媒体进行更多监管

articles.title: Rethinking international tourism
articles.subtitle: 大众旅游之后如何旅行
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Born from the accessibility of mass air travel, modern international tourism has been popularized as "holiday-making" in regions that offer comparative advantages of sand, sun and sea.
sentences.zh: 现代国际旅游诞生于大众航空旅行的便利性，在拥有沙滩、阳光和海洋比较优势的地区，以“度假”的方式得到普及。

sentences.en: Travel is often portrayed as a tool for personal growth and tourism as an economic motor for destination countries and cities.
sentences.zh: 旅行通常被描述为个人成长的工具，而旅游业则被描述为目的地国家和城市的经济引擎。

sentences.en: There is a tendency to assume that tourism is good fbr everyone involved.
sentences.zh: 有一种倾向认为旅游业对每个参与者都有好处。

sentences.en: Today the big bang of tourism drives over 1.2 billion tourists across international borders annually.
sentences.zh: 如今，旅游业的大爆炸每年带动超过 12 亿游客跨越国界。

sentences.en: Many popular places are literally being loved to death.
sentences.zh: 许多受欢迎的地方简直是被爱得要死。

sentences.en: Recent protests in ports of call like Venice and Barcelona against disturbances created by cruise ships show the unfortunate consequences of emphasizing quantity over quality in tourism.
sentences.zh: 最近在威尼斯和巴塞罗那等停靠港针对游轮造成的骚乱举行的抗议活动表明，旅游业重数量​​轻质量所带来的不幸后果。

sentences.en: Uncontrolled tourism development has become a primary driver of social and environmental disruption.
sentences.zh: 不受控制的旅游业发展已成为社会和环境破坏的主要驱动力。

sentences.en: Tourism studies provide much documentation of the many negative social impacts of tourism and resulting resentment that local populations direct toward visitors.
sentences.zh: 旅游研究提供了大量关于旅游业的许多负面社会影响以及当地居民对游客产生的怨恨的记录。

sentences.en: Antagonism toward tourists typically develops in mature, heavily visited destinations.
sentences.zh: 对游客的敌意通常出现在成熟的、游客较多的目的地。

sentences.en: Protests in heavily visited destinations suggest that traditional tourism has overstayed its welcome.
sentences.zh: 游客密集的目的地发生的抗议活动表明，传统旅游业已经不再受欢迎。

sentences.en: Residents often become frustrated when the benefits of tourism are not felt locally.
sentences.zh: 当当地无法感受到旅游业的好处时，居民常常会感到沮丧。

sentences.en: Although it can generate foreign exchange, income and employment, there's no guarantee that multinational hotel chains will allocate these benefits equitably among local communities.
sentences.zh: 虽然它可以产生外汇、收入和就业，但不能保证跨国连锁酒店会在当地社区之间公平分配这些利益。

sentences.en: On the contrary, when people stay at large resorts or on cruise ships, they make most of their purchases there, leaving local communities little opportunity to benefit from tourist spending.
sentences.zh: 相反，当人们住在大型度假村或游轮上时，他们大部分购物都在那里进行，当地社区几乎没有机会从游客消费中受益。

sentences.en: These forms of tourism widen economic and political gaps between haves and have-nots at local destinations.
sentences.zh: 这些形式的旅游业扩大了当地目的地富人和穷人之间的经济和政治差距。

sentences.en: In recent decades, local residents in destination communities also have found themselves negotiating new cultural boundaries, class dynamics, service industry roles and lifestyle transformations.
sentences.zh: 近几十年来，目的地社区的当地居民也发现自己正在应对新的文化边界、阶级动态、服务业角色和生活方式的转变。

sentences.en: For example, data show that tourism activity corresponds to increased social problems as local residents adopt the behaviors of tourists.
sentences.zh: 例如，数据显示，随着当地居民采取游客的行为，旅游活动对应着增加的社会问题。

sentences.en: What does all this mean for the everyday traveler?
sentences.zh: 这对于日常旅行者来说意味着什么？

sentences.en: First, all tourists should make every effort to honor their hosts and respect local conditions.
sentences.zh: 首先，所有游客都应该尽力尊重主人、尊重当地情况。

sentences.en: This means being prepared to adapt to local customs and norms, rather than expecting local conditions to adapt to travelers.
sentences.zh: 这意味着做好适应当地习俗和规范的准备，而不是期望当地条件适应旅行者。

sentences.en: Second, tourism is a market-based activity and works best when consumers reward better performers.
sentences.zh: 其次，旅游业是一种基于市场的活动，当消费者奖励表现更好的人时效果最佳。

sentences.en: In the information age, there9s little excuse fbr travelers being uninformed about where their vacation money goes and who it enriches.
sentences.zh: 在信息时代，旅行者没有理由不了解他们的假期钱花在哪里以及它使谁致富。

sentences.en: Informed travelers also are better able to distinguish between multinational companies and local entrepreneurs whose businesses provide direct social, environmental, and economic benefits for local residents.
sentences.zh: 知情的旅行者还能够更好地区分跨国公司和当地企业家，后者的业务为当地居民提供直接的社会、环境和经济效益。

sentences.en: Such businesses are in love with the destination and are therefore deserving of market reward.
sentences.zh: 这样的企业热爱目的地，因此值得市场回报。

sentences.en: In the long run, being a responsible traveler means ensuring net positive impacts for local people and environments.
sentences.zh: 从长远来看，成为负责任的旅行者意味着确保对当地人民和环境产生净积极影响。

sentences.en: With the information available at our fingertips, there has never been more opportunity to do so.
sentences.zh: 信息触手可及，我们现在有这样的机会。
sentences.note: at one's fingertips 意为触手可及、随时可得。比较优势 comparative advantage 在此解释旅游目的地的吸引力。

articles.title: Opening the doors of selective colleges
articles.subtitle: 精英大学与教育机会
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Selective colleges and universities in the U. S. are under fire for being too elite and too expensive, and for not training graduates for the world of work.
sentences.zh: 美国的一些精英学院和大学因过于精英、过于昂贵以及没有培养适合职场的毕业生而受到批评。
sentences.note: under fire 是习语，意为受到猛烈批评；selective colleges 指录取有较强选拔性的大学。

sentences.en: Such charges ignore the fact that these institutions continue to prepare students for success in their work, for thoughtful engagement in civic life, for lifelong learning, and for understanding the world and those with whom they live.
sentences.zh: 这些指控忽视了这样一个事实：这些机构继续帮助学生为工作成功、深思熟虑地参与公民生活、终身学习以及了解世界和与他们一起生活的人做好准备。

sentences.en: These colleges and universities must be doing something right.
sentences.zh: 这些学院和大学一定在做正确的事情。

sentences.en: Applications are at record highs, and their financial aid programs make them more accessible than ever.
sentences.zh: 申请数量创历史新高，他们的经济援助计划使申请比以往任何时候都更容易。

sentences.en: This model of education has long played a central role in creating opportunity, driving economic growth, and spurring innovation.
sentences.zh: 这种教育模式长期以来在创造机会、推动经济增长和刺激创新方面发挥着核心作用。

sentences.en: Yet, there is growing skepticism about the value of this model.
sentences.zh: 然而，人们对该模型的价值越来越怀疑。

sentences.en: The recent tax reform bill is a wake-up call that our strongest colleges and universities are under assault by some in government.
sentences.zh: 最近的税收改革法案敲响了警钟：我们最强大的学院和大学正受到政府中一些人的攻击。

sentences.en: The initial proposals would have made education unaffordable for many by taxing tuition waivers for graduate students and ending deductions for student loan interest.
sentences.zh: 最初的提案将对研究生征收学费减免税并终止学生贷款利息的扣除，从而使许多人无力承担教育费用。

sentences.en: Thankfully, these provisions were ultimately stripped from the bill, but lawmakers let stand a new tax on the investment income of some colleges and universities.
sentences.zh: 值得庆幸的是，这些条款最终被从法案中删除，但立法者允许对一些学院和大学的投资收入征收新税。

sentences.en: While these attacks are motivated by misguided ideas, we need to do a better job of explaining why these claims are false and why what we do is valuable.
sentences.zh: 虽然这些攻击是由误导性想法引发的，但我们需要更好地解释为什么这些说法是错误的以及为什么我们所做的事情是有价值的。

sentences.en: We cannot take for granted that any of this is obvious.
sentences.zh: 我们不能想当然地认为这些都是显而易见的。

sentences.en: It is often said that elite colleges and universities do not train students, particularly those who study the liberal arts, for the workforce.
sentences.zh: 人们常说，精英学院和大学并不为劳动力培养学生，特别是那些学习文科的学生。

sentences.en: But this can be refuted by scholarly research.
sentences.zh: 但这可以通过学术研究反驳。

sentences.en: The data are clear: a liberal arts education is great career preparation, both for excellent lifetime earnings and for satisfaction with the work.
sentences.zh: 数据很清楚：文科教育是很好的职业准备，既可以为你带来丰厚的终生收入，也可以让你对工作感到满意。

sentences.en: This education develops the skills of critical thinking, rigorous analysis of data and facts, communication with the written and spoken word, understanding of cultural differences and issues, and the ability to keep learning.
sentences.zh: 这种教育培养批判性思维、对数据和事实进行严格分析、书面和口头交流的技能、对文化差异和问题的理解以及持续学习的能力。

sentences.en: In fact, liberal arts graduates do extremely well in every imaginable field.
sentences.zh: 事实上，文科毕业生在每个可以想象的领域都表现得非常好。

sentences.en: Access to an education at selective colleges and universities is now more available than ever to low-and middle-income families.
sentences.zh: 现在，低收入和中等收入家庭比以往任何时候都更有机会接受选择性学院和大学的教育。

sentences.en: We have built endowments from donations by alumni and parents who understand and appreciate our mission to provide access and opportunity, and a significant portion of the returns from these endowments is used to fund financial aid.
sentences.zh: 我们通过校友和家长的捐赠建立了捐赠基金，他们理解并欣赏我们提供机会和机会的使命，这些捐赠基金的大部分回报用于资助经济援助。

sentences.en: Ironically, the new tax on endowments drains financial aid funds from the very schools most able to offer opportunity to those who have earned a spot but cannot otherwise afford this education.
sentences.zh: 具有讽刺意味的是，新的捐赠税耗尽了最有能力为那些已获得学位但无法负担教育费用的学生提供机会的学校的经济援助资金。

sentences.en: Beyond the virtue of access to those who have earned a place at these schools, the diversity of economic backgrounds enhances the education and experience of all of our students.
sentences.zh: 让那些凭自身努力赢得入学资格的人有机会进入这些学校，本身就有价值；除此之外，学生经济背景的多样性还能丰富所有学生的教育与校园体验。

articles.title: The limits of common sense
articles.subtitle: 常识是否总是可靠
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: When a group of Australians was asked why they believed climate change was not happening, about 36% said it was “common sense”, according to a report published last year by the Commonwealth Scientific and Industrial Research Organization.
sentences.zh: 根据联邦科学与工业研究组织去年发布的一份报告，当一群澳大利亚人被问及为什么他们认为气候变化没有发生时，大约 36% 的人表示这是“常识”。

sentences.en: This was the most popular reason fbr their opinion, with only 11% saying their belief that climate change was not happening was based on scientific research.
sentences.zh: 这是他们观点中最常见的原因，只有 11% 的人表示他们认为气候变化没有发生的信念是基于科学研究。

sentences.en: But what do we mean by an appeal to common sense?
sentences.zh: 但是我们所说的诉诸常识是什么意思？

sentences.en: Presumably it's an appeal to rationality of some sort that forms the basis of more complex reasoning.
sentences.zh: 大概这是对某种理性的诉求，形成了更复杂推理的基础。

sentences.en: The appeal to common sense, however, is usually nothing more than an appeal to thinking that just feels right, but what feels right to one person may not feel right to another.
sentences.zh: 然而，诉诸常识通常无非是诉诸于感觉正确的想法，但一个人感觉正确的事情可能对另一个人感觉不正确。

sentences.en: Whether it feels right is usually a reflection of the world view and ideologies we have internalised, and that frames how we interact with new ideas.
sentences.zh: 感觉是否正确通常反映了我们内化的世界观和意识形态，并决定了我们如何与新想法互动。

sentences.en: When new ideas are in accord with what we already believe, they are more readily accepted.
sentences.zh: 当新的想法与我们已经相信的一致时，它们更容易被接受。

sentences.en: When they are not, they, and the arguments that lead to them, are more readily rejected.
sentences.zh: 当它们不是时，它们以及导致它们的论点更容易被拒绝。

sentences.en: We often mistake this automatic compatibility testing of new ideas with existing beliefs as an application of common sense, but, in reality, it is more about judging than thinking.
sentences.zh: 我们经常将这种新想法与现有信念的自动兼容性测试误认为是常识的应用，但实际上，它更多的是判断而不是思考。

sentences.en: As Nobelist Daniel Kahneman notes in Thinking, Fast and Slow, when we arrive at conclusions in this way, the outcomes also feel true, regardless of whether they are.
sentences.zh: 正如诺贝尔奖获得者 Daniel Kahneman 在《思考，快与慢》中指出的那样，当我们以这种方式得出结论时，结果也会让人感觉真实，无论它们是否真实。

sentences.en: We are not psychologically well equipped to judge our own thinking.
sentences.zh: 我们在心理上没有足够的能力来判断自己的想法。

sentences.en: We are also highly susceptible to a range of cognitive biases such as giving preference to the first things that come to mind when making decisions or giving weight to evidence.
sentences.zh: 我们也很容易受到一系列认知偏差的影响，例如在做决定时优先考虑首先想到的事情或重视证据。

sentences.en: One way we can check our internal biases and inconsistencies is through the social verification of knowledge, in which we test our ideas in a rigorous and systematic way to see if they make sense not just to us, but to other people.
sentences.zh: 我们检查内部偏见和不一致的一种方法是通过知识的社会验证，在这种方法中，我们以严格和系统的方式测试我们的想法，看看它们是否不仅对我们有意义，对其他人也有意义。

sentences.en: The outstanding example of this socially shared cognition is science.
sentences.zh: 这种社会共享认知的突出例子是科学。

sentences.en: That does not mean that individuals are not capable of excellent thinking, nor does it mean no individual is rational.
sentences.zh: 这并不意味着个体没有出色的思维能力，也不意味着没有个体是理性的。

sentences.en: But the extent to which individuals can do this on their own is a function of how well integrated they are with communities of systematic inquiry in the first place.
sentences.zh: 但是个人能够在多大程度上自己做到这一点首先取决于他们与系统探究社区的融合程度。

sentences.en: You can't learn to think well by yourself.
sentences.zh: 你无法靠自己学会好好思考。

sentences.en: In matters of science at least, those who value their common sense over methodological, collaborative investigation imagine themselves to be more free in their thinking, unbound by involvement with the group, but in reality they are tightly bound by their capabilities and perspectives.
sentences.zh: 至少在科学问题上，那些重视常识胜过方法论、协作研究的人想象自己的思维更加自由，不受团体参与的束缚，但实际上他们受到自己的能力和观点的紧密束缚。

sentences.en: We are smarter together than we are individually, and perhaps that's just common sense.
sentences.zh: 我们在一起比单独行动更聪明，也许这只是常识。
sentences.note: together 与 individually 构成对比。作者质疑个人直觉的可靠性，强调知识协作。

articles.title: AI and the future of music
articles.subtitle: 人工智能如何改变音乐创作
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.sourceFile: 2022年6月英语六级真题 第二套.docx
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Since American idol star Taryn Southern started composing music with AI in 2017, musicians all over the world have begun wondering about the implications of AI and modern technology where music production is concerned.
sentences.zh: 自从2017年美国偶像明星Taryn Southern开始用人工智能创作音乐以来，世界各地的音乐家都开始思考人工智能和现代技术对音乐制作的影响。

sentences.en: Using AI in the creation of music is perceived by some as a helpful tool and by others as almost” the beginning of the end”.
sentences.zh: 在音乐创作中使用人工智能被一些人视为一种有用的工具，而另一些人则认为这几乎是“终结的开始”。

sentences.en: In Taryn's case, AI software enabled her to communicate melodies and chords that she didn't know how to put together herself.
sentences.zh: 就 Taryn 而言，人工智能软件使她能够传达她自己不知道如何组合的旋律和和弦。

sentences.en: The end product was therefore a collaborative effort, rather than a piece entirely produced by technology.
sentences.zh: 因此，最终产品是协作成果，而不是完全由技术生产的作品。

sentences.en: Taryn's story has a distinctly positive feel that highlights the advantages of using AI in music production.
sentences.zh: Taryn 的故事给人一种明显积极的感觉，凸显了在音乐制作中使用人工智能的优势。

sentences.en: It can serve as a source of inspiration, and as an ideal jumping-off point should a musician be hit with writer's b/oc左.
sentences.zh: 它可以作为灵感的源泉，并且作为音乐家被作家的b/oc左击中的理想起点。

sentences.en: Contrary to seeing AI as a tool, some musicians consider it to be hugely detrimental to the music scene.
sentences.zh: 与将人工智能视为一种工具相反，一些音乐家认为它对音乐界非常不利。

sentences.en: At the moment, because such technology is still so young, the music it's producing is not necessarily what we want to hear.
sentences.zh: 目前，由于这种技术还很年轻，它产生的音乐不一定是我们想听的。

sentences.en: In short, it's not of great quality.
sentences.zh: 总之，质量不太好。

sentences.en: Those who have produced their own music, or even fans of authentic, artistic music, will also argue that a computer could never emulate the work (and human touch) of a true musician.
sentences.zh: 那些创作过自己音乐的人，甚至是真正的艺术音乐的粉丝，也会认为计算机永远无法模仿真正音乐家的作品（和人情味）。

sentences.en: Music has been an integral part of the story of humans for ages; in fact, the first known piece of music is believed to be around 3,400 years old.
sentences.zh: 多年来，音乐一直是人类故事中不可或缺的一部分；事实上，第一首已知的音乐作品据信已有 3,400 年左右的历史。

sentences.en: Songs have long been used as a means of communicating messages and folk stories, covering everything from societal ethics to world history.
sentences.zh: 歌曲长期以来被用作传达信息和民间故事的手段，涵盖从社会伦理到世界历史的方方面面。

sentences.en: Since many people see music as such an inherently human expression, it is often considered as too precious to impart to technology.
sentences.zh: 由于许多人将音乐视为人类固有的表达方式，因此通常认为音乐太珍贵而无法传授给技术。

sentences.en: The thought of a computer generating a “random “ piece of music that hasn't been painstakingly created by an artist is almost seen as sacrilegious .
sentences.zh: 计算机生成并非由艺术家精心创作的“随机”音乐片段的想法几乎被视为亵渎。

sentences.en: Regardless of which side of the argument you fall on, it seems likely that the use of AI in music production will only become more frequent.
sentences.zh: 无论您站在争论的哪一边，人工智能在音乐制作中的使用似乎只会变得更加频繁。

sentences.en: Our modem world is preoccupied with technological advancements.
sentences.zh: 我们的现代世界专注于技术进步。

sentences.en: Instead of shying away from the idea of this bleak future, the best approach to take is one of optimism and curiosity.
sentences.zh: 最好的方法是保持乐观和好奇心，而不是回避这个黯淡的未来。

sentences.en: While there are always bound to be stubborn old-school musicians who refuse to use tech, music producers should consider AI as something to be embraced.
sentences.zh: 虽然总会有顽固的老派音乐家拒绝使用科技，但音乐制作人应该将人工智能视为值得拥抱的东西。

sentences.en: AI music software is still very much in its infancy, but with more investors interested in the development and outcomes of such technology, and considering the rapid growth rate of other tech advances in recent years, it's only a matter of time before Ai-produced music is seen as the new norm.
sentences.zh: 人工智能音乐软件仍处于起步阶段，但随着越来越多的投资者对此类技术的发展和成果感兴趣，并考虑到近年来其他技术进步的快速增长，人工智能制作的音乐被视为新规范只是时间问题。
sentences.note: in its infancy 意为处于初期；only a matter of time 表示只是时间问题，不是在陈述精确的时间表。

articles.title: Communicating science to the public
articles.subtitle: 科学传播需要清楚的语言
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.sourceFile: 2022年6月英语六级真题 第二套.docx
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: A few weeks ago, a well-meaning professor tried to explain the physiological process behind viruses and the human body in a tweet and was immediately criticized for a mistake in his information.
sentences.zh: 几周前，一位出于好意的教授试图在推文中解释病毒与人体相互作用背后的生理过程，却因为信息中有一处错误，立刻受到批评。

sentences.en: He then issued an apology and deleted his erroneous tweet.
sentences.zh: 他随后发表道歉并删除了他的错误推文。

sentences.en: Communicating science beyond the academic bubble is necessary to augmenting public understanding of health and environmental issues and helping individuals make well-informed personal decisions.
sentences.zh: 在学术泡沫之外传播科学对于增强公众对健康和环境问题的理解并帮助个人做出明智的个人决定是必要的。

sentences.en: However, scientists who engage in science communication must acknowledge that even in their area, their expertise is deep but narrow.
sentences.zh: 然而，从事科学传播的科学家必须承认，即使在他们的领域，他们的专业知识也很深但很窄。

sentences.en: They need to recognize the constraints in their own knowledge.
sentences.zh: 他们需要认识到自己知识的限制。

sentences.en: That is not to suggest that they only write or present on their own research, but rather, that they consult with an expert if the topic is outside of their discipline.
sentences.zh: 这并不是建议他们只撰写或展示自己的研究，而是建议他们在主题超出其学科范围时咨询专家。

sentences.en: Fact-checking with a scientist who works in the specialty will prevent the unintentional spread of misinformation, and the process of doing so may yield tiny pieces of interesting new information that can be incorporated.
sentences.zh: 与从事该专业工作的科学家进行事实核查将防止错误信息的无意传播，并且这样做的过程可能会产生可以合并的微小有趣的新信息。

sentences.en: Some have argued that the public is not educated enough to understand scientific information, especially for any complex phenomena, but this is absurd.
sentences.zh: 有人认为公众没有受过足够的教育来理解科学信息，尤其是对于任何复杂的现象，但这是荒谬的。

sentences.en: Science instruction can be found at all levels of public education with most secondary schools offering classes on biology, physics, and chemistry.
sentences.zh: 科学教学存在于各级公共教育中，大多数中学都提供生物、物理和化学课程。

sentences.en: If anything, social media has shown that the public craves knowledge based on a solid scientific foundation.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么不同的话，那就是社交媒体表明公众渴望基于坚实科学基础的知识。

sentences.en: Even the public discourse that follows most scientific articles shows that online readers can understand even the most baffling of scientific principles.
sentences.zh: 即使是大多数科学文章之后的公共话语也表明，在线读者甚至可以理解最令人困惑的科学原理。

sentences.en: It is equally imperative to emphasize that being an expert on a topic does not automatically make a scholar qualified to communicate it to a nonscientific audience.
sentences.zh: 同样必须强调的是，成为某个主题的专家并不意味着学者就自动有资格向非科学受众进行交流。

sentences.en: A number of scientists recently have been offering public-aimed explanations of scientific phenomena.
sentences.zh: 许多科学家最近一直在对科学现象提供面向公众的解释。

sentences.en: Even though they have appropriate credentials, they often do very little in the way of explaining.
sentences.zh: 尽管他们拥有适当的资历，但他们通常很少进行解释。

sentences.en: One biologist shared an intricate analogy involving a library, books, paper, a recipe, ingredients, and a cake to explain the process behind vaccines.
sentences.zh: 一位生物学家分享了一个复杂的类比，涉及图书馆、书籍、纸张、食谱、成分和蛋糕来解释疫苗背后的过程。

sentences.en: Any explanation that requires a written key to keep track of what each item represents is not a clear example for public consumption.
sentences.zh: 任何需要书面密钥来跟踪每个项目代表什么的解释都不是公众消费的明确示例。

sentences.en: Science communication is a science in and of itself.
sentences.zh: 科学传播本身就是一门科学。

sentences.en: It requires rigorous training and instruction.
sentences.zh: 需要严格的培训和指导。

sentences.en: A scientist should take communication courses that can teach a person how to identify and eliminate jargon and how to develop effective analogies to explain complex concepts.
sentences.zh: 科学家应该参加交流课程，这些课程可以教人们如何识别和消除行话，以及如何建立有效的类比来解释复杂的概念。

sentences.en: One cannot assume communication expertise-imagine if someone just decided that they were a physicist and started trying to contribute to the field without the necessary background.
sentences.zh: 一个人不能假设拥有通信专业知识 - 想象一下，如果有人在没有必要背景的情况下就决定自己是一名物理学家并开始尝试为该领域做出贡献。

sentences.en: Doing a poor job communicating science to the public will only create confusion and widen the gap between science and society, a gap that scientists are trying to close.
sentences.zh: 向公众传播科学的工作做得不好只会造成混乱并扩大科学与社会之间的差距，而科学家们正试图弥合这一差距。
sentences.note: widen the gap 表示扩大差距；close the gap 表示弥合差距。此处指科学界与公众之间的理解鸿沟。

articles.title: Genes, education and human potential
articles.subtitle: 基因能否决定人的未来
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Humans are fascinated by the source of their failings and virtues.
sentences.zh: 人类对其缺点和美德的根源着迷。

sentences.en: This preoccupation inevitably leads to an old debate: whether nature or nurture moulds us more.
sentences.zh: 这种关注不可避免地引发了一场古老的争论：到底是先天还是后天更能塑造我们。

sentences.en: A revolution in genetics has posed this as a modern political question about the character of our society: if personalities are hard-wired into our genes, what can governments do to help us?
sentences.zh: 遗传学的一场革命，使这个问题成为一个涉及社会性质的现代政治问题：如果个性已经由基因预先决定，政府还能做些什么来帮助我们？

sentences.en: It feels morally questionable, yet claims of genetic selection by intelligence are making headlines.
sentences.zh: 这在道德上令人怀疑，但智力基因选择的主张却成为头条新闻。

sentences.en: This is down to"hereditarian" science and a recent paper claimed "differences in exam performance between pupils attending selective and non-selective schools mirror the genetic differences between them" .
sentences.zh: 这归因于“遗传”科学，最近的一篇论文声称“选择性学校和非选择性学校学生之间的考试成绩差异反映了他们之间的遗传差异”。

sentences.en: With such an assertion, the work was predictably greeted by a lot of absurd claims about "genetics determining academic success" .
sentences.zh: 有了这样的断言，不出所料，这部作品受到了许多关于“遗传学决定学业成功”的荒谬说法的欢迎。

sentences.en: What the research revealed was the rather less surprising result: the educational benefits of selective schools largely disappear once pupils' inborn ability and socio economic background were taken into account.
sentences.zh: 研究揭示的结果并不令人意外：一旦考虑到学生的先天能力和社会经济背景，精英学校的教育效益就基本上消失了。

sentences.en: It is a glimpse of the blindingly obvious-and there's nothing to back strongly either a hereditary or environmental argument.
sentences.zh: 这是对显而易见的事实的一瞥——而且没有任何东西可以有力地支持遗传或环境论点。

sentences.en: Yet the paper does say children are "unintentionally genetically selected " by the school system.
sentences.zh: 然而，该论文确实表示，儿童是由学校系统“无意中进行基因选择的”。

sentences.en: Central to hereditarian science is a tall claim: that identifiable variations in genetic sequences can predict an individual's aptness to learn, reason and solve problems.
sentences.zh: 遗传决定论的核心有一个大胆的主张：基因序列中可识别的差异，能够预测一个人在学习、推理和解决问题方面的能力。

sentences.en: This is problematic on many levels.
sentences.zh: 这在很多层面上都是有问题的。

sentences.en: A teacher could not seriously tell a parent their child has a low genetic tendency to study when external factors clearly exist.
sentences.zh: 当外部因素明显存在时，老师不能认真地告诉家长他们的孩子学习遗传倾向较低。

sentences.en: Unlike-minded academics say the inheritability of human traits is scientifically unsound.
sentences.zh: 持不同观点的学者表示，人类特征的可遗传性在科学上是不合理的。

sentences.en: At best there is a weak statistical association and not a causal link between DNA and intelligence.
sentences.zh: DNA 与智力之间充其量只有微弱的统计关联，而不是因果联系。
sentences.note: at best 表示“充其量”。association 是统计关联，causal link 是因果关系，两者不能混同。

sentences.en: Yet sophisticated statistics are used to create an intimidatory atmosphere of scientific certainty.
sentences.zh: 然而，复杂的统计数据被用来营造一种科学确定性的恐吓氛围。

sentences.en: While there's an undoubted genetic basis to individual difference, it is wrong to think that socially defined groups can be genetically accounted for.
sentences.zh: 虽然个体差异有无可置疑的遗传基础，但认为社会定义的群体可以通过遗传来解释的想法是错误的。

sentences.en: The fixation on genes as destiny is surely false too.
sentences.zh: 将基因视为命运的固执也肯定是错误的。

sentences.en: Medical predictability can rarely be based on DNA alone; the environment matters too.
sentences.zh: 医学可预测性很少能仅基于 DNA；环境也很重要。

sentences.en: Something as complex as intellect is likely to be affected by many factors beyond genes.
sentences.zh: 像智力这样复杂的东西可能会受到基因以外的许多因素的影响。

sentences.en: If hereditarians want to advance their cause it will require more balanced interpretation and not just acts of advocacy.
sentences.zh: 如果遗传主义者想要推进他们的事业，就需要更加平衡的解释，而不仅仅是倡导行为。

sentences.en: Genetic selection is a way of exerting influence over others, "the ultimate collective control of human destinies," as writer H. G. Wells put it.
sentences.zh: 基因选择是对他人施加影响的一种方式，正如作家 H. G. Wells 所说，“人类命运的最终集体控制”。

sentences.en: Knowledge becomes power and power requires a sense of responsibility.
sentences.zh: 知识变成力量，力量需要责任感。

sentences.en: In understanding cognitive ability, we must not elevate discrimination to a science; allowing people to climb the ladder of life only as far as their cells might suggest.
sentences.zh: 理解认知能力时，我们不能把歧视包装成科学，让人在人生阶梯上只能爬到其细胞似乎预示的高度。

sentences.en: This will need a more sceptical eye on the science.
sentences.zh: 这需要对科学持更加怀疑的态度。

sentences.en: As technology progresses, we all have a duty to make sure that we shape a future that we would want to find ourselves in.
sentences.zh: 随着技术的进步，我们都有责任确保我们塑造一个我们想要的未来。

articles.title: Making tourist taxes work
articles.subtitle: 旅游税与地方治理
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Nicola Sturgeon's speech last Tuesday setting out the Scottish government's legislative programme for the year ahead confirmed what was already pretty clear.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉·斯特金上周二的讲话阐述了苏格兰政府未来一年的立法计划，证实了已经相当明确的事情。

sentences.en: Scottish councils are set to be the first in the UK with the power to levy charges on visitors, with Edinburgh likely to lead the way.
sentences.zh: 苏格兰议会将成为英国第一个有权向游客征收费用的议会，爱丁堡可能会处于领先地位。

sentences.en: Tourist taxes are not new.
sentences.zh: 旅游税并不新鲜。
sentences.note: tourist tax 指对游客征收的税费。must be given the chance 是被动结构，强调地方应获得尝试政策的机会。

sentences.en: The Himalayan kingdom of Bhutan has a longstanding policy of charging visitors a daily fee.
sentences.zh: 喜马拉雅山不丹王国长期以来有向游客收取每日费用的政策。

sentences.en: France's tax on overnight stays was introduced to assist thermal spa towns to develop, and around half of French local authorities use it today.
sentences.zh: 法国引入过夜住宿税是为了帮助温泉小镇的发展，目前大约一半的法国地方当局正在使用该税。

sentences.en: But such levies are on the rise.
sentences.zh: 但此类税收正在增加。

sentences.en: Moves by Barcelona and Venice to deal with the phenomenon of "over-tourism" through the use of charges have recently gained prominence.
sentences.zh: 巴塞罗那和威尼斯通过收费来应对“过度旅游”现象的举措最近受到关注。

sentences.en: Japan and Greece are among the countries to have recently introduced tourist taxes.
sentences.zh: 日本和希腊是最近开征旅游税的国家之一。
sentences.note: tourist tax 指对游客征收的税费。must be given the chance 是被动结构，强调地方应获得尝试政策的机会。

sentences.en: That the UK lags behind is due to our weak, by international standards, local government, as well as the opposition to taxes and regulation of our aggressively pro-market ruling party.
sentences.zh: 英国落后的原因是，按照国际标准，我们的地方政府薄弱，以及我们积极亲市场的执政党反对税收和监管。

sentences.en: Some UK cities have lobbied without success for the power to levy a charge on visitors.
sentences.zh: 一些英国城市曾就向游客征收费用的权利进行游说，但没有成功。

sentences.en: Such levies are no universal remedy as the amounts raised would be tiny compared with what has been taken away by central government since 2010.
sentences.zh: 此类征税并不是万能的补救措施，因为与 2010 年以来中央政府征收的金额相比，筹集的金额微乎其微。

sentences.en: Still, it is to be hoped that the Scottish government's bold move will prompt others to act.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我们仍希望苏格兰政府的大胆举措能够促使其他国家采取行动。

sentences.en: There is 六级 2021 6 月 no reason why visitors to the UK, or domestic tourists on holiday in hotspots such as Cornwall, should be exempt from taxation-particularly when vital local services including waste collection, park maintenance and arts and culture spending are under unprecedented strain.
sentences.zh: 六级 2021 年 6 月 前往英国的游客或在康沃尔郡等热点地区度假的国内游客没有理由免税——特别是当包括废物收集、公园维护以及艺术和文化支出在内的重要当地服务面临前所未有的压力时。

sentences.en: On the contrary, compelling tourists to make a financial contribution to the places they visit beyond their personal consumption should be part of a wider cultural shift.
sentences.zh: 相反，迫使游客在个人消费之外为他们所参观的地方做出经济贡献应该是更广泛的文化转变的一部分。

sentences.en: Westerners with disposable incomes have often behaved as if they have a right to go wherever they choose with little regard for the consequences.
sentences.zh: 拥有可支配收入的西方人常常表现得好像他们有权去任何他们选择的地方，而很少考虑后果。

sentences.en: Just as the environmental harm caused by aviation and other transport must come under far greater scrutiny, the social cost of tourism must also be confronted.
sentences.zh: 正如航空和其他运输造成的环境危害必须受到更严格的审查一样，旅游业的社会成本也必须面对。

sentences.en: This includes the impact of short-term lets on housing costs and quality of life for residents.
sentences.zh: 这包括短期出租对居民住房成本和生活质量的影响。

sentences.en: Several European capitals, including Paris and Berlin, are leading a campaign for tougher regulation by the European Union.
sentences.zh: 包括巴黎和柏林在内的多个欧洲国家首都正在带头发起一场要求欧盟加强监管的运动。

sentences.en: It also includes the impact of overcrowding, litter and the kinds of behaviour associated with noisy parties.
sentences.zh: 它还包括过度拥挤、乱扔垃圾以及与喧闹派对相关的各种行为的影响。

sentences.en: There is no "one size fits all" solution to this problem.
sentences.zh: 这个问题没有“一刀切”的解决方案。

sentences.en: The existence of new revenue streams for some but not all councils is complicated, and businesses are often opposed, fearing higher costs will make them uncompetitive.
sentences.zh: 对于一些议会（但不是所有议会）而言，新收入来源的存在很复杂，企业常常表示反对，担心更高的成本会使它们失去竞争力。

sentences.en: But those places that want them must be given the chance to make tourist taxes work.
sentences.zh: 但是那些需要旅游税的地方必须有机会让旅游税发挥作用。
sentences.note: tourist tax 指对游客征收的税费。must be given the chance 是被动结构，强调地方应获得尝试政策的机会。

articles.title: Drawing as a tool for learning
articles.subtitle: 绘画是一种学习工具
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: We often think of drawing as something that takes inborn talent, but this kind of thinking stems from our misclassification of drawing as, primarily, an art form rather than a tool for learning.
sentences.zh: 我们常常认为绘画是一种需要天赋的东西，但这种想法源于我们错误地将绘画归类为一种艺术形式，而不是一种学习工具。
sentences.note: rather than 引出被错误分类时忽略的另一种功能；inborn 表示先天的，misclassification 表示错误归类。

sentences.en: Researchers, teachers, and artists are starting to see how drawing can positively impact a wide variety of skills and disciplines.
sentences.zh: 研究人员、教师和艺术家开始看到绘画如何对各种技能和学科产生积极影响。

sentences.en: Most of us have spent some time drawing before, but at some point, most of us stop drawing.
sentences.zh: 我们大多数人以前都花过一些时间画画，但在某些时候，我们大多数人停止画画。

sentences.en: There are people who don't, obviously, and thank god for that: a world without designers and artists would be a very shabby one indeed.
sentences.zh: 显然，有些人不这么认为，感谢上帝：一个没有设计师和艺术家的世界确实会是一个非常破旧的世界。

sentences.en: Some argue that so many adults have abandoned drawing because we've miscategorized it and given it a very narrow definition.
sentences.zh: 有人认为，许多成年人放弃了绘画，因为我们对它进行了错误的分类，并给了它一个非常狭窄的定义。

sentences.en: In his book, Stick Figures: Drawing as a Human Practice, Professor D. B. Dowd argues that we have misfiled the significance of drawing because we see it as a professional skill instead of a personal capacity.
sentences.zh: D. B. Dowd 教授在他的著作《简笔画：绘画作为人类实践》中指出，我们错误地描述了绘画的重要性，因为我们将其视为一种专业技能而不是个人能力。

sentences.en: We mistakenly think of "good" drawings as those which work as recreations of the real world, as realistic illusions.
sentences.zh: 我们错误地认为“好的”绘画是对现实世界的再现，是现实的幻想。

sentences.en: Rather, drawing should be recategorized as a symbolic tool.
sentences.zh: 相反，绘画应该被重新归类为一种符号工具。

sentences.en: Human beings have been drawing for 73,OOO years.
sentences.zh: 人类绘画已有 73,OOO 年了。

sentences.en: It's part of what it means to be human.
sentences.zh: 这是人类意义的一部分。

sentences.en: We don't have the strength of chimpanzees because we've given up animal strength to manipulate subtle instruments, like hammers, spears, and-later-pens and pencils.
sentences.zh: 我们没有黑猩猩的力量，因为我们已经放弃了动物的力量来操纵微妙的工具，比如锤子、矛，以及后来的钢笔和铅笔。

sentences.en: The human hand is an extremely dense network of nerve endings.
sentences.zh: 人手是一个极其密集的神经末梢网络。

sentences.en: In many ways, human beings are built to draw.
sentences.zh: 在很多方面，人类生来就是为了绘画。

sentences.en: Some researchers argue that doodling activates the brain's so-called default circuit- essentially, the areas of the brain responsible for maintaining a baseline level of activity in the absence of other stimuli.
sentences.zh: 一些研究人员认为，涂鸦会激活大脑所谓的默认回路，即在没有其他刺激的情况下负责维持基线活动水平的大脑区域。

sentences.en: Because of this, some believe that doodling during a boring lecture can help students pay attention.
sentences.zh: 正因为如此，一些人认为在无聊的讲座中涂鸦可以帮助学生集中注意力。

sentences.en: In one study, participants were asked to listen to a list of names while either doodling or sitting still.
sentences.zh: 在一项研究中，参与者被要求一边涂鸦或坐着不动，一边听一系列名字。

sentences.en: Those who doodled remembered 29 percent more of the names than those who did not.
sentences.zh: 那些涂鸦的人比那些不涂鸦的人记住的名字多 29%。

sentences.en: There's also evidence that drawing talent is based on how accurately someone perceives the world.
sentences.zh: 还有证据表明，绘画天赋取决于一个人感知世界的准确程度。

sentences.en: The human visual system tends to misjudge size, shape, color, and angles but artists perceive these qualities more accurately than non-artists.
sentences.zh: 人类视觉系统往往会误判大小、形状、颜色和角度，但艺术家比非艺术家更准确地感知这些品质。

sentences.en: Cultivating drawing talent can become an essential tool to improve people's observational skills in fields where the visual is important.
sentences.zh: 培养绘画天赋可以成为在视觉重要的领域提高人们观察能力的重要工具。

sentences.en: Rather than ·think of drawing as a talent that some creative people are gifted in, we should consider it as a tool for seeing and understanding the world better-one that just so happens to double as an art form.
sentences.zh: 我们不应将绘画视为某些有创造力的人所具有的天赋，而应将其视为更好地观察和理解世界的工具，而它恰好也是一种艺术形式。

sentences.en: Both absent-minded doodling and copying from life have been shown to positively affect your memory and visual perception, so complain loudly the next time your school board slashes the art department's budget.
sentences.zh: 研究已经表明，无意识地涂鸦和对着实物写生，都能对记忆力和视觉感知产生积极影响；所以下次学区委员会削减美术部门预算时，请大声表达反对。

articles.title: The limits of smarter traffic
articles.subtitle: 导航应用为何带来新拥堵
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: The car has reshaped our cities.
sentences.zh: 汽车重塑了我们的城市。

sentences.en: It seems to offer autonomy for everyone.
sentences.zh: 它似乎为每个人提供了自主权。

sentences.en: There is something almost delightful in the detachment from reality of advertisements showing mass-produced cars marketed as symbols of individuality and of freedom when most of their lives will be spent making short journeys on choked roads.
sentences.zh: 广告中将批量生产的汽车标榜为个性和自由的象征，而他们一生中的大部分时间都在拥挤的道路上进行短途旅行，广告中的这种脱离现实的感觉几乎是令人愉快的。

sentences.en: For all the fuss made about top speeds, cornering ability and acceleration, the most useful gadgets on a modern car are those which work when you're going very slowly: parking sensors, sound systems, and navigation apps which will show a way around upcoming traffic jams.
sentences.zh: 尽管人们对最高速度、转弯能力和加速度大惊小怪，但现代汽车上最有用的小工具是那些在你行驶速度非常慢时起作用的小工具：停车传感器、音响系统和导航应用程序，它们将在即将到来的交通拥堵时显示出一条路。

sentences.en: This seems to be one of the few areas where the benefit of sharing personal information comes straight back to the sharer: because these apps know where almost all the users are, and how fast they are moving almost all the time, they can spot traffic congestion very quickly and suggest ways round it.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是共享个人信息的好处直接返回给共享者的少数几个领域之一：因为这些应用程序知道几乎所有用户在哪里，以及他们几乎一直移动的速度有多快，所以它们可以非常快速地发现交通拥堵并提出解决方案。

sentences.en: The problem comes when everyone is using a navigation app which tells them to avoid everyone else using the same gadget.
sentences.zh: 当每个人都使用导航应用程序时，问题就出现了，该应用程序告诉他们避免其他人使用相同的小工具。

sentences.en: Traffic jams often appear where no one has enough information to avoid them.
sentences.zh: 交通堵塞经常出现，而没有人有足够的信息来避免它们。

sentences.en: When a lucky few have access to the knowledge, they will benefit greatly.
sentences.zh: 当少数幸运者能够获得这些知识时，他们将受益匪浅。

sentences.en: But when everyone has perfect information, traffic jams simply spread onto the side roads that seem to offer a way round them.
sentences.zh: 但是，当每个人都掌握了完美的信息时，交通拥堵就会蔓延到似乎可以绕开他们的小路上。

sentences.en: This new congestion teaches us two things.
sentences.zh: 这种新的拥堵告诉我们两件事。

sentences.en: The first is that the promises of technology will never be realised as fully as we hope; they will be limited by their unforeseen and unintended consequences.
sentences.zh: 首先，技术的承诺永远不会像我们希望的那样完全实现；它们将受到不可预见和非预期后果的限制。

sentences.en: Sitting in a more comfortable car in a different traffic jam is pleasant but hardly the liberation that once seemed to be promised.
sentences.zh: 在不同的交通堵塞中坐在更舒适的汽车里是令人愉快的，但几乎没有曾经承诺的解放。

sentences.en: The second is that self-organisation will not get us where we want to go.
sentences.zh: 第二个是自组织不会让我们到达我们想去的地方。
sentences.note: self-organisation 指自发组织。作者指出个人各自优化选择，不一定带来整体最优结果。

sentences.en: The efforts of millions of drivers to get ahead do not miraculously produce a situation in which everyone does better than before, but one in which almost everyone does rather worse.
sentences.zh: 数以百万计的司机为取得成功所做的努力并没有奇迹般地产生一种每个人都比以前做得更好的情况，而是一种几乎每个人都做得更糟的情况。

sentences.en: Central control and collective organisation can produce smoother and fairer outcomes, though even that much is never guaranteed.
sentences.zh: 中央控制和集体组织可以产生更顺利、更公平的结果，尽管甚至无法保证这一点。

sentences.en: Similar limits can be foreseen for the much greater advances promised by self-driving cars.
sentences.zh: 对于自动驾驶汽车所承诺的更大进步，可以预见类似的限制。

sentences.en: Last week, one operated by the taxi company Uber struck and killed a woman pushing her bicycle across a wide road in Arizona.
sentences.zh: 上周，出租车公司 Uber 运营的一辆出租车在亚利桑那州撞死了一名推着自行车穿过宽阔道路的妇女。

sentences.en: This was the first recorded death involving a car which was supposed to be fully autonomous.
sentences.zh: 这是第一起有记录的涉及全自动驾驶汽车的死亡事件。

sentences.en: Experts have said that it suggests a "catastrophic failure" of technology.
sentences.zh: 专家表示，这表明技术出现了“灾难性失败”。

sentences.en: Increasingly, even Silicon Valley has to acknowledge the costs of the intoxicating hurry that characterises its culture.
sentences.zh: 甚至硅谷也越来越不得不承认其文化所特有的令人陶醉的匆忙所付出的代价。

sentences.en: What traffic teaches us is that reckless and uncontrolled change is as likely to harm us as it is to benefit us, and that thoughtful regulation is necessary for a better future.
sentences.zh: 交通问题告诉我们，鲁莽、不受控制的变革既可能有益，也可能造成伤害；要创造更好的未来，必须进行审慎的监管。

articles.title: Creativity belongs in education
articles.subtitle: 让创造力进入每个人的教育
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: You can't see it, smell it, or hear it, and people disagree on how precisely to define it, or where exactly it comes from.
sentences.zh: 你看不到它、闻到它或听到它，而且人们对于如何精确地定义它或它到底来自哪里存在分歧。

sentences.en: It isn't a school subject or an academic discipline, but it can be learned.
sentences.zh: 它不是学校科目或学科，但可以学习。

sentences.en: It is a quality that is required of artists, but it is also present in the lives of scientists and entrepreneurs.
sentences.zh: 这是艺术家所需要的品质，但它也存在于科学家和企业家的生活中。

sentences.en: All of us benefit from it and we thrive mentally and spiritually when we are able to wield it.
sentences.zh: 我们所有人都从中受益，当我们能够运用它时，我们的精神和精神都会蓬勃发展。

sentences.en: It is a delicate thing, easily stamped out; in fact, it flourishes most fully when people are playful and childlike.
sentences.zh: 是个精致的东西，很容易被压坏；事实上，当人们顽皮、天真时，它才能最充分地发挥作用。

sentences.en: Meanwhile, it works best in conjunction with deep knowledge and expertise.
sentences.zh: 同时，它与深厚的知识和专业知识结合起来效果最好。

sentences.en: This mysterious-but teachable-quality is creativity, the subject of a recently-published report by Durham· Commission on Creativity and Education; The report concludes that · creativity -should not inhabit the school curriculum only as it relates to drama, music, art and other obviously creative subjects, but that creative thinking ought to run through all of school life, infusing the way humanities and natural sciences are learned.
sentences.zh: 这种神秘但可传授的品质就是创造力，这是达勒姆·创造力与教育委员会最近发布的一份报告的主题；报告的结论是：·创造力不应该仅仅存在于学校课程中，因为它涉及戏剧、音乐、艺术和其他明显具有创造性的科目，而创造性思维应该贯穿整个学校生活，融入人文和自然科学的学习方式。

sentences.en: The authors, who focus on education in England, offer a number of sensible recommendations, some of which are an attempt to alleviate the uninspiring and fact-based approach to education that has crept into policy in recent years.
sentences.zh: 专注于英国教育的作者提出了许多明智的建议，其中一些建议试图缓解近年来已渗透到政策中的平庸且基于事实的教育方法。

sentences.en: When children are regarded as vessels to be filled with facts, creativity does not prosper; nor does it when teachers' sole objective is coaching children towards exams.
sentences.zh: 当孩子被视为装满事实的容器时，创造力就不会繁荣；当教师的唯一目标是指导孩子参加考试时，情况也不会如此。

sentences.en: One suggestion from the commission is a network of teacher-led "creativity col labor at ives", along the lines of existing maths hubs. , with the aim of supporting teaching for creativity through the school curriculum.
sentences.zh: 该委员会的一项建议是，沿着现有数学中心的路线，建立一个由教师主导的“ives 创意协作网络”。 ，旨在通过学校课程支持创造力教学。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, it is arts subjects through which creativity can most obviously be fostered.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，最能明显培养创造力的还是艺术学科。

sentences.en: The value placed on them by the independent education sector is clear.
sentences.zh: 独立教育部门对他们的重视是显而易见的。

sentences.en: One only has to look at the remarkable arts facilities at Britain's top private schools to comprehend this.
sentences.zh: 只要看看英国顶级私立学校卓越的艺术设施就可以理解这一点。

sentences.en: But in the state sector the excessive focus on English, maths and science threatens to crush arts subjects; meanwhile, reduced school budgets mean diminishing extracurricular activities.
sentences.zh: 但在公立部门，过度关注英语、数学和科学可能会压垮艺术科目；与此同时，学校预算的减少意味着课外活动的减少。

sentences.en: There has been a 28.1% decline in students taking creative subjects at high schools since 2014, though happily, art and design have seen a recent increase.
sentences.zh: 自 2014 年以来，高中选修创意课程的学生人数下降了 28.1%，但令人高兴的是，艺术和设计课程最近有所增加。

sentences.en: This discrepancy between state and private education is a matter of social justice.
sentences.zh: 公立和私立教育之间的这种差异是社会正义问题。

sentences.en: It is simply wrong and unfair that most children have a fraction of the access to choirs, orchestras, art studios and drama that Among celebrities, it's trendy nowadays to use their own speech writers as politicians do.
sentences.zh: 大多数孩子只有一小部分机会参加合唱团、管弦乐队、艺术工作室和戏剧，这是完全错误和不公平的。在名人中，像政治家一样使用自己的演讲撰稿人是当今的流行趋势。

sentences.en: The so Among celebrities, it's trendy nowadays to use their own speech writers as politicians do.
sentences.zh: 所以在名人中，现在很流行像政治家一样使用自己的演讲撰稿人。

sentences.en: The so their more privileged peers enjoy.
sentences.zh: 他们的同龄人享有更多特权。

sentences.en: As lives are affected by any number of looming challenges-climate crisis, automation in the workplace-humans are going to need creative thinking more than ever.
sentences.zh: 由于生活受到许多迫在眉睫的挑战（气候危机、工作场所自动化）的影响，人类将比以往任何时候都更需要创造性思维。

sentences.en: For all of our sakes, creativity in education, and for all, must become a priority.
sentences.zh: 为了我们所有人的利益，教育中的创造力和所有人的创造力必须成为优先事项。
sentences.note: for all 强调面向所有人；must become a priority 表示必须成为优先事项。

articles.title: Imitation, mirroring and plagiarism
articles.subtitle: 模仿、镜像与抄袭的边界
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Emulating your conversation partner's actions is a common human behavior classified as "mirroring" and has been known and studied by psychologists for years.
sentences.zh: 模仿交谈对象的动作，是一种被称为“镜像行为”的常见人类行为，心理学家多年来一直了解并研究这一现象。
sentences.note: mirroring 在心理学中指无意识地模仿对方动作；plagiarism 指把他人的作品或想法冒充为自己的。

sentences.en: We all tend to subconsciously copy gestures of people we like.
sentences.zh: 我们都倾向于下意识地模仿我们喜欢的人的手势。

sentences.en: But why do we act like this?
sentences.zh: 但是我们为什么要这样做呢？

sentences.en: As a rule, mirroring means that conversationalists enjoy their communication and that there's a certain level of agreement between them.
sentences.zh: 一般来说，镜像意味着对话者享受他们的交流，并且他们之间存在一定程度的一致性。
sentences.note: mirroring 在心理学中指无意识地模仿对方动作；plagiarism 指把他人的作品或想法冒充为自己的。

sentences.en: The topic of discussion is equally interesting for both and they know their interests meet.
sentences.zh: 讨论的话题对双方来说同样有趣，并且他们知道他们的兴趣是一致的。

sentences.en: Repeating someone's behavior is typical of talented communicators, not always because the person is sympathetic, but because there is a goal to be achieved.
sentences.zh: 重复某人的行为是有才华的沟通者的典型特征，并不总是因为这个人富有同情心，而是因为有一个要实现的目标。

sentences.en: This way new idols have been brought to the stage: politicians, celebrities, and other big names.
sentences.zh: 这样新的偶像就被带到了舞台上：政客、名人和其他大牌人物。

sentences.en: Popular culture makes people want to look popular, and act and speak like popular people.
sentences.zh: 流行文化让人们想要看起来流行，并且像流行的人一样行事和说话。

sentences.en: Nowadays celebrities steal lyrics from each other and struggle with copyright violation accusations or •straightforwardly claim themselves to be the authors, even though all the work was done by other people. • called "ghostwriting" can take various forms: books, articles, autobiographies, and even social media posts.
sentences.zh: 如今，名人互相盗取歌词，并与侵犯版权的指控作斗争，或者直接声称自己是作者，尽管所有工作都是由其他人完成的。 • 所谓的“代笔”可以采取多种形式：书籍、文章、自传，甚至社交媒体帖子。

sentences.en: Who is a true copycat and who gets copycatted?
sentences.zh: 谁是真正的模仿者，谁被模仿了？

sentences.en: Sometimes, it is a hard nut to crack without an expert's help.
sentences.zh: 有时，如果没有专家的帮助，这是一件很难解决的问题。

sentences.en: But new authorship defending methods based on identifying individual writing patterns are already here.
sentences.zh: 但是基于识别个人写作模式的新作者保护方法已经出现。

sentences.en: Their aim is to protect intellectual property.
sentences.zh: 他们的目标是保护知识产权。

sentences.en: Using scientific methods, some of them can define authorship with 85% accuracy.
sentences.zh: 使用科学方法，其中一些可以以 85% 的准确度定义作者身份。

sentences.en: Writing is not an easy craft to master.
sentences.zh: 写作并不是一门容易掌握的手艺。

sentences.en: If you want to write like a professional without plagiarism , there are a few lessons to learn and the first one is: "Copy from one, it's plagiarism; copy from two, it's research."
sentences.zh: 如果你想像专业人士一样写作而不抄袭，有一些教训需要学习，第一个是：“抄袭一个，这是抄袭；抄袭两个，这是研究。”

sentences.en: The correct interpretation of this statement is not about copying, but rather about creating your own style.
sentences.zh: 这句话的正确解释不是抄袭，而是创造自己的风格。

sentences.en: When you study an author's writing style, don't stop on a single one, but explore numerous styles instead.
sentences.zh: 当你研究一个作者的写作风格时，不要停留在单一的一种风格上，而是要探索多种风格。

sentences.en: Examine types of sentences they use, pay attention to their metaphors, and focus on stories you feel you could write a pretty cool sequel to.
sentences.zh: 检查他们使用的句子类型，注意他们的隐喻，并专注于你认为你可以写一个非常酷的续集的故事。

sentences.en: Imitation is rather paradoxical.
sentences.zh: 模仿是相当矛盾的。

sentences.en: As an integral part of learning, it brings about positive changes, making people develop and grow.
sentences.zh: 作为学习的一个组成部分，它带来积极的变化，使人发展和成长。

sentences.en: However, it may do a lot of harm.
sentences.zh: 然而，它可能会造成很大的伤害。

sentences.en: Copying someone's thoughts, ideas or inventions is completely unacceptable.
sentences.zh: 复制某人的想法、想法或发明是完全不可接受的。

sentences.en: It infringes on intellectual property rights of others.
sentences.zh: 侵犯他人知识产权。

sentences.en: Still, many things we do are about copying others one way.or another.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，我们所做的许多事情都是以某种方式复制他人。

sentences.en: So if you want to compliment someone on the work they have done and imitate it, just make sure you do it the right way to avoid committing plagiarism.
sentences.zh: 因此，如果您想称赞某人所做的工作并进行模仿，请确保以正确的方式进行，以避免抄袭。

articles.title: Art in a culture of inattention
articles.subtitle: 在分心时代慢慢看艺术
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: What is the place of art in a culture of inattention?
sentences.zh: 在注意力涣散的文化中，艺术处于什么位置？
sentences.note: place 在这里指地位、作用。文章围绕专注观看与匆忙浏览的区别展开。

sentences.en: Recent visitors to the Louvre report that tourists can now spend only a minute in front of the Mona Lisa before being asked to move on.
sentences.zh: 最近参观卢浮宫的游客报告称，游客现在只能在《蒙娜丽莎》前停留一分钟，然后就会被要求离开。

sentences.en: Much of that time, for some of them, is spent taking photographs not even of the painting but of themselves with the painting in the background.
sentences.zh: 对于他们中的一些人来说，大部分时间都花在拍摄以这幅画为背景的自己的照片上，而不是为这幅画拍照。

sentences.en: One view is that we have democratised tourism and gallery-going so much that we have made it effectively impossible to appreciate what we’ve travelled to see.
sentences.zh: 一种观点是，我们已经使旅游业和画廊参观变得如此民主化，以至于我们实际上不可能欣赏我们所旅行的目的。

sentences.en: In this oversubscribed society, experience becomes a commodity like any other.
sentences.zh: 在这个超额订阅的社会中，经验就像其他商品一​​样成为一种商品。

sentences.en: There are queues to climb Mt.
sentences.zh: 爬山需要排队

sentences.en: Jolmo Lungma as well as to see famous paintings.
sentences.zh: 珠穆朗玛以及看名画。

sentences.en: Leisure, thus conceived, is hard labour, and returning to work becomes a well-earned break from the ordeal.
sentences.zh: 由此看来，休闲是一种艰苦的劳动，而重返工作岗位则成为摆脱磨难的一次应有的休息。

sentences.en: What gets lost in this industrialised haste is the quality of looking.
sentences.zh: 在这种工业化的匆忙中失去的是观看的质量。

sentences.en: Consider an extreme example, the late philosopher Richard Wollheim.
sentences.zh: 考虑一个极端的例子，已故哲学家理查德·沃尔海姆。

sentences.en: When he visited the Louvre he could spent as much as four hours sitting before a painting.
sentences.zh: 当他参观卢浮宫时，他可以在一幅画前坐上四个小时。

sentences.en: The first hour, he claimed, was necessary for misperceptions to be eliminated.
sentences.zh: 他声称，第一个小时对于消除误解是必要的。

sentences.en: It was only then that the picture would begin to disclose itself.
sentences.zh: 直到那时，图片才开始显露出来。

sentences.en: This seems unthinkable today, but it is still possible to organise.
sentences.zh: 这在今天看来是不可想象的，但仍然是可以组织的。

sentences.en: Even in the busiest museums there are many rooms and many pictures worth hours of contemplation which the crowds largely ignore.
sentences.zh: 即使在最繁忙的博物馆里，也有许多房间和许多图片值得人们花上几个小时沉思，但人们在很大程度上忽视了这些。

sentences.en: Sometimes the largest crowds are partly the products of bad management; the Mona Lisa is such a hurried experience today partly because the museum is being reorganised.
sentences.zh: 有时，最大的人群部分是管理不善的产物；今天，《蒙娜丽莎》的参观如此匆忙，部分原因是博物馆正在重组。

sentences.en: The Uffizi in Florence, another site of cultural pilgrimage, has cut its entry queues down to seven minutes by clever management.
sentences.zh: 另一处文化朝圣地佛罗伦萨乌菲兹美术馆通过巧妙的管理，将入馆排队时间缩短至七分钟。

sentences.en: And there are some forms of art, those designed to be spectacles as well as objects of contemplation, which can work perfectly well in the face of huge crowds.
sentences.zh: 有一些艺术形式，那些被设计成景观和沉思的对象，在面对巨大的人群时可以完美地发挥作用。

sentences.en: Olafur Elias son’s current Tate Modern show, for instance, might seem nothing more than an entertainment, overrun as it is with kids romping in fog rooms and spray mist installations.
sentences.zh: 例如，奥拉维尔·埃利亚斯 (Olafur Elias) 儿子目前在泰特现代美术馆 (Tate Modern) 举办的展览可能看起来只不过是一种娱乐，因为孩子们在雾室和喷雾装置中嬉戏。

sentences.en: But it’s more than that: where Elias son is at his most entertaining, he is at his most serious too, and his disorienting installations bring home the reality of the destructive effects we are having on the planet — not least what we are doing to the glaciers of Elias son’s beloved Iceland.
sentences.zh: 但事情还不止于此：埃利亚斯儿子最有趣的地方，也是最严肃的地方，他令人迷失方向的装置让我们认识到我们对地球造成的破坏性影响的现实——尤其是我们对埃利亚斯儿子深爱的冰岛冰川所做的事情。

sentences.en: Marcel Proust, another lover of the Louvre, wrote: “ It is only through art that we can escape from ourselves and know how another person sees the universe, whose landscapes would otherwise have remained as unknown as any on the moon.”
sentences.zh: 另一位卢浮宫爱好者马塞尔·普鲁斯特写道：“只有通过艺术，我们才能摆脱自我，了解另一个人如何看待宇宙，否则宇宙的风景将像月球上的任何风景一样不为人知。”

sentences.en: If any art remains worth seeing, it must lead us to such escapes.
sentences.zh: 如果有任何艺术仍然值得一看，它一定会引导我们走向这样的逃避。

sentences.en: But a minute in front of a painting in a hurried crowd won’t do that.
sentences.zh: 但在匆忙的人群中在一幅画前呆一分钟是不行的。

articles.title: Dietary guidelines and sustainability
articles.subtitle: 膳食指南为何回避环境
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.sourceFile: 2020.12六级真题第1套【可复制可搜索，打印首选】.pdf
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Every five years, the government tries to tell Americans what to put in their bellies.
sentences.zh: 每五年，政府都会尝试告诉美国人该吃什么。

sentences.en: Eat more vegetables.
sentences.zh: 多吃蔬菜。

sentences.en: Dial back the fats.
sentences.zh: 减少脂肪。

sentences.en: It's all based on the best available science for leading a healthy life.
sentences.zh: 这一切都基于实现健康生活的最佳可用科学。

sentences.en: But the best available science also has a lot to say about what those food choices do to the environment, and some researchers are annoyed that new dietary recommendations of the USDA (United States Department of Agriculture) released yesterday seem to utterly ignore that fact.
sentences.zh: 但是，关于这些食物选择对环境的影响，现有的最佳科学也有很多说法，一些研究人员对美国农业部 (USDA) 昨天发布的新饮食建议似乎完全忽视了这一事实感到恼火。

sentences.en: Broadly, the 2016 - 2020 dietary recommendations aim for balance: More vegetables, leaner meats and far less sugar.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，2016 - 2020 年饮食建议旨在实现平衡：多吃蔬菜、少吃瘦肉，少吃糖。

sentences.en: But Americans consume more calories per capita than almost any other country in the world.
sentences.zh: 但美国人人均消耗的卡路里比世界上几乎任何其他国家都多。

sentences.en: So the things Americans eat have a huge impact on climate change.
sentences.zh: 所以美国人吃的东西对气候变化有巨大的影响。

sentences.en: Soil tilling releases carbon dioxide, and delivery vehicles emit exhaust.
sentences.zh: 耕地释放二氧化碳，运输车辆排放尾气。

sentences.en: The government's dietary guidelines could have done a lot to lower that climate cost.
sentences.zh: 政府的饮食指南可以在很大程度上降低气候成本。

sentences.en: Not just because of their position of authority: The guidelines drive billions of dollars of food production through federal programs like school lunches and nutrition assistance for the needy.
sentences.zh: 不仅仅是因为他们的权威地位：这些指导方针通过学校午餐和为有需要的人提供营养援助等联邦计划推动了数十亿美元的粮食生产。

sentences.en: On its own, plant and animal agriculture contributes 9 percent of all the country's greenhouse gas emissions.
sentences.zh: 动植物农业本身就占全国温室气体排放量的 9%。

sentences.en: That's not counting the fuel burned in transportation, processing, refrigeration, and other waypoints between farm and belly.
sentences.zh: 这还不包括在农场和腹部之间的运输、加工、冷藏和其他路径点燃烧的燃料。

sentences.en: Red meats are among the biggest and most notorious emitters, but trucking a salad from California to Minnesota in January also carries a significant burden.
sentences.zh: 红肉是最大、最臭名昭著的排放源之一，但一月份用卡车将沙拉从加利福尼亚州运到明尼苏达州也带来了沉重的负担。

sentences.en: And greenhouse gas emissions aren't the whole story.
sentences.zh: 温室气体排放并不是全部。

sentences.en: Food production is the largest user of fresh water, largest contributor to the loss of biodiversity, and a major contributor to using up natural resources.
sentences.zh: 粮食生产是淡水的最大消耗者、生物多样性丧失的最大贡献者以及自然资源消耗的主要贡献者。

sentences.en: All of these points and more showed up in the Dietary Guidelines Advisory Committee's scientific report, released last February.
sentences.zh: 所有这些要点以及更多内容都出现在膳食指南咨询委员会去年二月发布的科学报告中。

sentences.en: Miriam Nelson chaired the subcommittee in charge of sustainability for the report, and is disappointed that eating less meat and buying local food aren't in the final product.
sentences.zh: Miriam Nelson 担任该报告负责可持续发展小组委员会的主席，她对最终产品中没有少吃肉和购买当地食品感到失望。

sentences.en: "Especially if you consider that eating less meat, especially red and processed, has health benefits," she says.
sentences.zh: “特别是如果你认为少吃肉，尤其是红肉和加工肉，对健康有益，”她说。

sentences.en: So what happened?
sentences.zh: 那么发生了什么？

sentences.en: The official response is that sustainability falls too far outside the guidelines' official scope, which is to provide "nutritional and dietary information."
sentences.zh: 官方回应是，可持续性远远超出了指南的官方范围，即提供“营养和饮食信息”。

sentences.en: Possibly the agencies in charge of drafting the decisions are too close to the industries they are supposed to regulate.
sentences.zh: 负责起草决定的机构可能与他们应该监管的行业过于接近。

sentences.en: On one hand, the USDA is compiling dietary advice.
sentences.zh: 一方面，美国农业部正在编制饮食建议。

sentences.en: On the other, their clients are US agriculture companies.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，他们的客户是美国农业公司。

sentences.en: The line about keeping the guidelines' scope to nutrition and diet doesn't ring quite right with researchers.
sentences.zh: 关于保持指南的营养和饮食范围的说法对研究人员来说不太合适。

sentences.en: David Walling a, for example, says, " In previous guidelines, they've always been concerned with things like food security-which is presumably the mission of the USDA.
sentences.zh: David Walling a 例如说，“在之前的指导方针中，他们一直关注食品安全等问题——这可能是美国农业部的使命。

sentences.en: You absolutely need to be worried about climate impacts and future sustainability if you want secure food in the future."
sentences.zh: 如果您希望未来获得安全的食品，您绝对需要担心气候影响和未来的可持续性。”
sentences.note: secure food 指确保未来粮食供应有保障，侧重粮食安全和供给，而非只指食物是否卫生。

articles.title: Animals, ethics and the future
articles.subtitle: 动物权利与饮食选择
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Vegetarians would prefer not to be compelled to eat meat.
sentences.zh: 素食者宁愿不被迫吃肉。
sentences.note: be compelled to do 表示被迫做某事。阅读时区分作者对制度的批评与个人饮食偏好。

sentences.en: Yet the reverse compulsion is hidden in the proposals for a new plant-based “planetary diet.”
sentences.zh: 然而，反向强迫隐藏在新的植物性“行星饮食”提案中。

sentences.en: Nowhere is this more visible than in India.
sentences.zh: 这一点在印度最为明显。

sentences.en: Earlier this year, the EAT-Lancet Commission released its global report on nutrition and called for a global shift to a more plant-based diet and for “substantially reducing consumption of animal source foods.”
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，EAT-柳叶刀委员会发布了全球营养报告，呼吁全球转向更多以植物为基础的饮食，并“大幅减少动物源食品的消费”。

sentences.en: In countries like India, that call could become a tool to aggravate an already tense political situation and stress already undernourished populations.
sentences.zh: 在印度等国家，这一呼吁可能成为加剧本已紧张的政治局势并给本已营养不良的人口带来压力的工具。

sentences.en: The EAT report presumes that “traditional diets” in countries like India include little red meat, which might be consumed only on special occasions or as minor ingredients in mixed dishes.
sentences.zh: EAT 报告推测，印度等国家的“传统饮食”中很少含有红肉，这些红肉可能仅在特殊场合食用或作为混合菜肴中的次要成分。

sentences.en: In India, however, there is a vast difference between what people would wish to consume and what they have to consume because of innumerable barriers around class, religion, culture, cost, geography, etc.
sentences.zh: 然而，在印度，由于阶级、宗教、文化、成本、地理等方面存在无数障碍，人们希望消费的东西和必须消费的东西之间存在巨大差异。

sentences.en: Policymakers in India have traditionally pushed for a cereal-heavy “vegetarian diet” on a meat-eating population as a way of providing the cheapest sources of food.
sentences.zh: 印度的政策制定者历来推动肉食人群采用以谷物为主的“素食饮食”，以此作为提供最便宜的食物来源的一种方式。

sentences.en: Currently, under an aggressive Hindu nationalist government, Muslims, Christians, disadvantaged classes and indigenous communities are being compelled to give up their traditional foods.
sentences.zh: 目前，在咄咄逼人的印度教民族主义政府的领导下，穆斯林、基督徒、弱势阶层和土著社区被迫放弃他们的传统食物。
sentences.note: be compelled to do 表示被迫做某事。阅读时区分作者对制度的批评与个人饮食偏好。

sentences.en: None of these concerns seem to have been appreciated by the EAT-Lancet Commission’s representative, Brent Loken, who said “India has got such a great example” in sourcing protein from plants.
sentences.zh: EAT-Lancet 委员会的代表布伦特·洛肯 (Brent Loken) 似乎没有意识到这些担忧，他表示“印度在从植物中采购蛋白质方面有一个很好的例子”。

sentences.en: But how much of a model for the world is India’s vegetarianism?
sentences.zh: 但是印度的素食主义在多大程度上可以为世界树立榜样呢？

sentences.en: In the Global Hunger Index 2019, the country ranks 102nd out of 117.
sentences.zh: 在2019年全球饥饿指数中，该国在117个国家中排名第102位。

sentences.en: Data from the National Family Health Survey indicate that only 10 percent of infants of 6 to 23 months are adequately fed.
sentences.zh: 全国家庭健康调查的数据表明，只有 10% 的 6 至 23 个月婴儿得到充分喂养。

sentences.en: Which is why calls for a plant-based diet modeled on India risk offering another whip with which to beat already vulnerable communities in developing countries.
sentences.zh: 这就是为什么呼吁效仿印度的植物性饮食可能会给发展中国家本已脆弱的社区带来另一条鞭子。

sentences.en: A diet directed at the affluent West fails to recognize that in low-income countries undernourished children are known to benefit from the consumption of milk and other animal source foods, improving cognitive functions, while reducing the prevalence of nutritional deficiencies as well as mortality.
sentences.zh: 针对富裕西方国家的饮食未能认识到，在低收入国家，营养不良的儿童可以从牛奶和其他动物源食品的消费中受益，改善认知功能，同时降低营养缺乏的发生率和死亡率。

sentences.en: EAT-Lancet claimed its intention was to “spark conversations” among all Indian stakeholders.
sentences.zh: EAT-Lancet 声称其目的是在所有印度利益相关者之间“引发对话”。

sentences.en: Yet vocal critics of the food processing industry and food fortification strategies have been left out of the debate.
sentences.zh: 然而，对食品加工行业和食品强化策略的直言不讳的批评却被排除在辩论之外。

sentences.en: But the most conspicuous omission may well be the absence of India’s farmers.
sentences.zh: 但最明显的遗漏很可能是印度农民的缺席。

sentences.en: The government, however, seems to have given the report a thumbs-up.
sentences.zh: 然而，政府似乎对这份报告竖起了大拇指。

sentences.en: Rather than addressing chronic hunger and malnutrition through an improved access to wholesome and nutrient-dense foods, the government is opening the door for company-dependent solutions, ignoring the environmental and economic cost, which will destroy local food systems.
sentences.zh: 政府没有通过改善健康和营养丰富的食品的获取来解决长期饥饿和营养不良问题，而是为依赖公司的解决方案敞开了大门，忽视了环境和经济成本，这将破坏当地的粮食系统。

sentences.en: It’s a model full of danger for future generations.
sentences.zh: 这是一个对后代充满危险的模式。

articles.title: Responsibility is not the same as fault
articles.subtitle: 把责任与过错分开
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Back in 1964, in his book Games People Play, psychiatrist Eric Berne described a pattern of conversation he called “ Why Don’t You——Yes But”，which remains one of the most irritating aspects of everyday social life.
sentences.zh: 早在 1964 年，精神病学家埃里克·伯恩就在《人间游戏》一书中描述了一种对话模式，称为“你为什么不……——是的，可是……”。时至今日，这仍是日常社交生活中最令人恼火的情形之一。

sentences.en: The person adopting the strategy is usually a chronic complainer.
sentences.zh: 采取该策略的人通常是一个长期抱怨者。

sentences.en: Something is terrible about their relationship, job, or other situation, and they moan about it ceaselessly, but find some excuse to dismiss any solution that’s proposed.
sentences.zh: 他们的关系、工作或其他情况有些糟糕，他们不断抱怨，但又找借口驳回提出的任何解决方案。

sentences.en: The reason, of course, is that on some level they don’t want a solution; they want to be validated in their position that the world is out to get them.
sentences.zh: 原因当然是在某种程度上他们不想要解决方案；他们希望自己的立场得到证实，即全世界都在追捕他们。

sentences.en: If they can “win” the game—dismissing every suggestion until their interlocutorgives up in annoyance—they get to feel pleasurably righteous in their resentments and excused from any obligation to change.
sentences.zh: 如果他们能够“赢得”这场游戏——忽略每一个建议，直到他们的对话者恼怒为止——他们就会在自己的怨恨中感到愉快的正义感，并免除任何改变的义务。

sentences.en: Part of the trouble here is the so-called responsibility/fault fallacy .
sentences.zh: 这里的部分麻烦是所谓的责任/过失谬误。

sentences.en: When you’re feeling hard done by—taken for granted by your partner, say, or obliged to work for a half-witted boss—it’s easy to become attached to the position that it’s not your job to address the matter, and that doing so would be an admission of fault.
sentences.zh: 当你感到被伴侣欺负时——比如，被你的伴侣视为理所当然，或者不得不为一个愚蠢的老板工作——你很容易就会执着于这样一种立场：解决这个问题不是你的工作，而且这样做就是承认错误。

sentences.en: But there’s a confusion here.
sentences.zh: 但是这里有一个混乱。

sentences.en: For example, if I were to discover a newborn at my front door, it wouldn’t be my fault, but it most certainly would be my responsibility.
sentences.zh: 例如，如果我在前门发现新生儿，那不是我的错，但这肯定是我的责任。

sentences.en: There would be choices to make, and no possibility of avoiding them, since trying to ignore the matter would be a choice.
sentences.zh: 将会做出选择，并且不可能避免它们，因为试图忽略这件事将是一种选择。

sentences.en: The point is that what goes for the baby on the doorstep is true in all cases: even if the other person is 100% in the wrong, there’s nothing to be gained, long-term, from using this as a justification to evade responsibility.
sentences.zh: 关键是，家门口的婴儿的情况在任何情况下都是正确的：即使对方百分百错了，从长远来看，以此为借口逃避责任也没有什么好处。

sentences.en: Should you find yourself on the receiving end of this kind of complaining, there’s an ingenious way to shut it down—which is to agree with it, ardently.
sentences.zh: 如果你发现自己成为这种抱怨的对象，有一个巧妙的方法可以阻止它——那就是热烈地同意它。

sentences.en: Psychotherapist Lori Gottlieb describes this as “ over-validation ”.
sentences.zh: 心理治疗师 Lori Gottlieb 将其描述为“过度验证”。

sentences.en: For one thing, you’ll be spared further moaning, since the other person’s motivation was to confirm her beliefs, and now you’re confirming them.
sentences.zh: 一方面，你不会再抱怨了，因为对方的动机是为了证实她的信念，而现在你正在证实它们。

sentences.en: But for another, as Gottlieb notes, people confronted with over-validation often hear their complaints afresh and start arguing back.
sentences.zh: 但另一方面，正如戈特利布指出的那样，面临过度验证的人们经常会重新听到他们的抱怨并开始反驳。

sentences.en: The notion that they’re utterly powerless suddenly seems unrealistic—not to mention rather annoying—so they’re prompted instead to generate ideas about how they might change things.
sentences.zh: 他们完全无能为力的想法突然变得不切实际——更不用说相当烦人了——所以他们被提示去产生关于如何改变事物的想法。

sentences.en: “And then, sometimes, something magical might happen,” Gottlieb writes.
sentences.zh: “然后，有时，可能会发生一些神奇的事情，”戈特利布写道。

sentences.en: The other person “might realise she’s not as trapped as you are saying she is, or as she feels.”
sentences.zh: 对方“可能会意识到她并不像您所说的那样，或者像她感觉的那样陷入困境。”

sentences.en: Which illustrates the irony of the responsibility/fault fallacy: evading responsibility feels comfortable, but turns out to be a prison; whereas assuming responsibility feels unpleasant, but ends up being freeing.
sentences.zh: 这恰好说明了混淆责任与过错所带来的讽刺：逃避责任让人感觉舒服，最终却如同身陷囹圄；承担责任让人感到不快，最终却能获得自由。
sentences.note: whereas 表示对比。作者区分 fault（过错归属）与 responsibility（处理问题的责任）。

articles.title: Social media and loneliness
articles.subtitle: 社交媒体与孤独感
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Why does social media trigger feelings of loneliness and inadequacy?
sentences.zh: 为什么社交媒体会引发孤独感和觉得自己不够好的感受？
sentences.note: inadequacy 指觉得自己不够好、不如人的感觉。文中的 like 指平台上的“点赞”。

sentences.en: Because instead of being real life, it is, for the most part, impression management, a way of marketing yourself, carefully choosing and filtering the pictures and words to put your best face forward.
sentences.zh: 因为它不是现实生活，在很大程度上是印象管理，一种营销自己的方式，仔细选择和过滤图片和文字，以展示你最好的一面。

sentences.en: Online “friends” made through social media do not follow the normal psychological progression of an interpersonal relationship.
sentences.zh: 通过社交媒体结识的网上“朋友”不遵循人际关系的正常心理发展。

sentences.en: You share neither physical time nor emotional conversations over the Internet.
sentences.zh: 你们既不共享物理时间，也不通过互联网共享情感对话。

sentences.en: You simply communicate photographs and catchy posts to a diverse group of people whom you have “friended” or “followed” based on an accidental interaction.
sentences.zh: 您只需将照片和吸引人的帖子传达给您基于意外互动而“加为好友”或“关注”的不同群体。

sentences.en: This is not to say that your social media friends can’t be real friends.
sentences.zh: 这并不是说你的社交媒体朋友不能成为真正的朋友。

sentences.en: They absolutely can, but the two are not synonymous.
sentences.zh: 他们绝对可以，但两者不是同义词。

sentences.en: Generally speaking, there are no unfiltered comments or casually taken photos on our social media pages.
sentences.zh: 一般来说，我们的社交媒体页面上不存在未经过滤的评论或随意拍摄的照片。

sentences.en: And, rightfully so, because it wouldn’t feel safe to be completely authentic and vulnerable with some of our “ friends ” whom we don’t actually know or with whom trust has yet to be built.
sentences.zh: 而且，这是理所当然的，因为与我们实际上不认识或尚未建立信任的一些“朋友”保持完全真实和脆弱的感觉并不安全。

sentences.en: Social media can certainly be an escape from the daily grind, but we must be cautioned against the negative effects, such as addiction, on a person’s overall psychological well-being.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体当然可以让我们摆脱日常琐事，但我们必须警惕其对一个人整体心理健康的负面影响，例如成瘾。

sentences.en: As humans, we yearn for social connection.
sentences.zh: 作为人类，我们渴望社会联系。

sentences.en: Scrolling through pages of pictures and comments, however, does not provide the same degree of fulfillment as face-to-face interactions do.
sentences.zh: 然而，滚动浏览图片和评论页面并不能提供与面对面互动相同程度的满足感。

sentences.en: Also, we tend to idealize others’ lives and compare our downfalls to their greatest accomplishments, ending in feelings of loneliness and inadequacy.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们倾向于将他人的生活理想化，并将我们的失败与他们最大的成就进行比较，最终导致孤独和无能的感觉。
sentences.note: inadequacy 指觉得自己不够好、不如人的感觉。文中的 like 指平台上的“点赞”。

sentences.en: Social media can lead people on the unhealthy quest for perfection.
sentences.zh: 社交媒体可能会引导人们不健康地追求完美。

sentences.en: Some people begin to attend certain events or travel to different places so that they can snap that “ perfect ” photo.
sentences.zh: 有些人开始参加某些活动或去不同的地方旅行，以便拍摄“完美”的照片。
