sentences.en: They begin to seek validation through the number of people who “ like ” their posts.
sentences.zh: 他们开始通过“喜欢”他们的帖子的人数来寻求验证。

sentences.en: In order for it to play a psychologically healthy role in your social life, social media should supplement an already healthy social network.
sentences.zh: 为了让它在你的社交生活中发挥心理健康的作用，社交媒体应该补充已经健康的社交网络。

sentences.en: Pictures and posts should be byproducts of life’s treasured moments and fun times, not the planned and calculated image that one is putting out into cyberspace in an attempt to fill insecurities or unmet needs.
sentences.zh: 图片和帖子应该是生活中珍贵时刻和欢乐时光的副产品，而不是人们为了填补不安全感或未满足的需求而将其发布到网络空间的有计划和计算的图像。

sentences.en: Ultimately, social media has increased our ability to connect with various types of people all over the globe.
sentences.zh: 最终，社交媒体增强了我们与全球各种类型的人联系的能力。

sentences.en: It has opened doors for businesses and allowed us to stay connected to people whom we may not otherwise get to follow.
sentences.zh: 它为企业打开了大门，让我们能够与原本无法关注的人保持联系。

sentences.en: However, social media should feel like a fun experience, not one that contributes to negative thoughts and feelings.
sentences.zh: 然而，社交媒体应该让人感觉是一种有趣的体验，而不是一种会产生负面想法和感受的体验。

sentences.en: If the latter is the case, increasing face-to-face time with trusted friends, and minimizing time scrolling online, will prove to be a reminder that your social network is much more rewarding than any “ like,” “ follow ” or “ share ” can be.
sentences.zh: 如果属于后一种情况，那么多花时间与信赖的朋友面对面相处，少花时间刷网络信息，就会提醒你：真实的社交关系带来的满足，远胜过任何一次“点赞”“关注”或“分享”。

articles.title: Animal traditions under threat
articles.subtitle: 保护动物，也保护动物文化
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Imagine that an alien species landed on Earth and, through their mere presence, those aliens caused our art to vanish, our music to homogenize, and our technological know-how to disappear.
sentences.zh: 想象一下，一个外星物种登陆地球，仅仅通过他们的存在，这些外星人就导致我们的艺术消失，我们的音乐同质化，我们的技术知识消失。

sentences.en: That is effectively what humans have been doing to our closest relatives — chimps .
sentences.zh: 这实际上就是人类对我们的近亲——黑猩猩所做的事情。

sentences.en: Back in 1999, a team of scientists led by Andrew Whiten showed that chimps from different parts of Africa behave very differently from one another.
sentences.zh: 早在 1999 年，由安德鲁·怀顿 (Andrew Whiten) 领导的一组科学家表明，来自非洲不同地区的黑猩猩的行为差异很大。

sentences.en: Some groups would get each other’s attention by rapping branches with their knuckles ，while others did it by loudly ripping leaves with their teeth.
sentences.zh: 有些群体会用指关节敲击树枝来引起对方的注意，而另一些群体则会用牙齿大声撕扯树叶来引起对方的注意。

sentences.en: The team identified 39 of these traditions that are practiced by some communities but not others — a pattern that, at the time, hadn’t been seen in any animal except humans.
sentences.zh: 研究小组发现了其中 39 种传统，这些传统被一些社区所践行，而另一些社区则没有——这种模式当时在除人类以外的任何动物中都没有发现过。

sentences.en: It was evidence, the team said, that chimps have their own cultures.
sentences.zh: 研究小组说，这是证据表明黑猩猩有自己的文化。

sentences.en: It took a long time to convince skeptics that such cultures exist, but now we have plenty of examples of animals learning local traditions from one another.
sentences.zh: 花了很长时间才让怀疑论者相信这种文化的存在，但现在我们有很多动物互相学习当地传统的例子。

sentences.en: But just when many scientists have come to accept the existence of animal cultures, many of those cultures might vanish.
sentences.zh: 但是，当许多科学家开始接受动物文化的存在时，其中许多文化可能会消失。

sentences.en: Ammie Kalan and her colleagues have shown, through years of intensive fieldwork, that the very presence of humans has eroded the diversity of chimp behavior.
sentences.zh: Ammie Kalan 和她的同事通过多年的深入实地调查表明，人类的存在已经侵蚀了黑猩猩行为的多样性。

sentences.en: Where we flourish, their cultures wither.
sentences.zh: 在我们繁荣的地方，他们的文化却在衰落。

sentences.en: It is a bitterly ironic thing to learn on the 20th anniversary of Whiten’s classic study. “ It’s amazing to think that just 60 years ago, we knew next to nothing of the behavior of our sister species in the wild,” Whiten says. “ But now, just as we are truly getting to know our primatecousins, the actions of humans are closing the window on all we have discovered.”
sentences.zh: 在怀顿经典研究20周年之际得知这是一件极其讽刺的事情。 “令人惊奇的是，就在 60 年前，我们对野生姐妹物种的行为几乎一无所知，”Whiten 说。 “但现在，正当我们真正了解我们的灵长类表亲时，人类的行为正在关闭我们所发现的一切的窗口。”

sentences.en: “ Sometimes in the rush to conserve the species, I think we forget about the individuals,” says Cat Hobaiter, a professor at the University of St. Andrews. “ Each population, each community, even each generation of chimps is unique.
sentences.zh: “有时，在急于保护物种的过程中，我认为我们忘记了个体，”圣安德鲁斯大学教授 Cat Hobaiter 说。 “每个种群、每个群体，甚至每一代黑猩猩都是独一无二的。

sentences.en: An event might only have a small impact on the total population of chimps, but it may wipe out an entire community — an entire culture.
sentences.zh: 一个事件可能只会对黑猩猩的总种群产生很小的影响，但它可能会消灭整个社区 - 整个文化。

sentences.en: No matter what we do to restore habitat or support population growth, we may never be able to restore that culture.”
sentences.zh: 无论我们采取什么措施来恢复栖息地或支持人口增长，我们可能永远无法恢复这种文化。”

sentences.en: No one knows whether the destruction of chimp culture is getting worse.
sentences.zh: 没有人知道黑猩猩文化的破坏是否正在恶化。

sentences.en: Few places have tracked chimp behavior over long periods, and those that have are also more likely to have protected their animals from human influence.
sentences.zh: 很少有地方能够长期追踪黑猩猩的行为，而那些长期追踪黑猩猩行为的地方也更有可能保护他们的动物免受人类的影响。

sentences.en: Obviously, conservationists need to think about saving species in a completely new way—by preserving animal traditions as well as bodies and genes. “ Instead of focusing only on the conservation of genetically based entities like species, we now need to also consider culturally based entities,” says Andrew Whiten.
sentences.zh: 显然，自然资源保护主义者需要考虑以全新的方式拯救物种——通过保护动物传统以及身体和基因。 “我们现在不仅需要关注物种等基于遗传的实体的保护，还需要考虑基于文化的实体，”安德鲁·怀特恩说。
sentences.note: by 引出实现方式。动物保护还需要考虑通过社会学习传承的行为，而不只关注个体数量和遗传多样性。

articles.title: Diet, industry and public health
articles.subtitle: 饮食健康与食品监管
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: It is not controversial to say that an unhealthy diet causes bad health.
sentences.zh: 不健康的饮食导致健康状况不佳这一说法并无争议。

sentences.en: Nor are the basic elements of healthy eating disputed.
sentences.zh: 健康饮食的基本要素也没有争议。

sentences.en: Obesity raises susceptibility to cancer, and Britain is the sixth most obese country on Earth.
sentences.zh: 肥胖会增加患癌症的风险，英国是地球上第六大肥胖国家。

sentences.en: That is a public health emergency.
sentences.zh: 这是突发公共卫生事件。

sentences.en: But naming the problem is the easy part.
sentences.zh: 但命名问题是比较容易的部分。

sentences.en: No one disputes the costs in quality of life and depleted health budgets of an obese population, but the quest for solutions gets diverted by ideological arguments around responsibility and choice.
sentences.zh: 没有人质疑肥胖人群的生活质量成本和耗尽的健康预算，但对解决方案的追求却因围绕责任和选择的意识形态争论而转移。

sentences.en: And the water is muddied by lobbying from the industries that profit from consumption of obesity-inducing products.
sentences.zh: 那些从消费诱发肥胖的产品中获利的行业的游说使水变得浑浊。

sentences.en: Historical precedent suggests that science and politics can overcome resistance from businesses that pollute and poison but it takes time, and success often starts small.
sentences.zh: 历史先例表明，科学和政治可以克服污染和毒害企业的阻力，但这需要时间，而且成功往往是从小事开始的。

sentences.en: So it is heartening to note that a programme in Leeds has achieved a reduction in childhood obesity, becoming the first UK city to reverse a fattening trend.
sentences.zh: 因此，令人振奋的是，利兹的一项计划已经实现了儿童肥胖率的减少，成为英国第一个扭转肥胖趋势的城市。

sentences.en: The best results were among younger children and in more deprived areas.
sentences.zh: 最好的结果是在年幼的儿童和较贫困的地区。

sentences.en: When 28% of English children aged two to 15 are obese, a national shift on the scale achieved by Leeds would lengthen hundreds of thousands of lives.
sentences.zh: 当 28% 的 2 至 15 岁英国儿童肥胖时，利兹大学实现的全国性转变将延长数十万人的生命。

sentences.en: A significant factor in the Leeds experience appears to be a scheme called HENRY, which helps parents reward behaviours that prevent obesity in children.
sentences.zh: 利兹经验中的一个重要因素似乎是一项名为“HENRY”的计划，该计划帮助父母奖励预防儿童肥胖的行为。

sentences.en: Many members of parliament are uncomfortable even with their own government's anti-obesity strategy, since it involves a “sugar tax” and abandon the sale of energy drinks to under-16s.
sentences.zh: 许多议会成员甚至对本国政府的反肥胖战略感到不安，因为它涉及“糖税”并放弃向 16 岁以下儿童销售能量饮料。

sentences.en: Bans and taxes can be blunt instruments, but their harshest critics can rarely suggest better methods.
sentences.zh: 禁令和税收可能是生硬的手段，但最严厉的批评者很少能提出更好的方法。

sentences.en: These critics just oppose regulation itself.
sentences.zh: 这些批评者只是反对监管本身。

sentences.en: The relationship between poor health and inequality is too pronounced for governments to be passive about large-scale intervention.
sentences.zh: 健康状况不佳与不平等之间的关系过于明显，政府不能对大规模干预采取消极态度。

sentences.en: People living in the most deprived areas are four times more prone to die from avoidable causes than counterparts in more affluent places.
sentences.zh: 生活在最贫困地区的人们死于可避免原因的可能性是生活在较富裕地区的人们的四倍。

sentences.en: As the structural nature of public health problems becomes harder to ignore, the complaint about over protective government loses potency.
sentences.zh: 随着公共卫生问题的结构性变得越来越难以忽视，对政府过度保护的抱怨失去了效力。

sentences.en: In fact, the polarised debate over public health interventions should have been abandoned long ago.
sentences.zh: 事实上，关于公共卫生干预措施的两极分化争论早就应该被放弃了。

sentences.en: Government action works when individuals are motivated to respond.
sentences.zh: 当个人有动力做出回应时，政府行动就会发挥作用。

sentences.en: Individuals need governments that expand access to good choices.
sentences.zh: 个人需要政府扩大获得良好选择的机会。

sentences.en: The HENRY programme was delivered in part through children's centres.
sentences.zh: HENRY 计划部分通过儿童中心实施。

sentences.en: Closing such centres and cutting council budgets doesn’t magically increase reserves of individual self-reliance.
sentences.zh: 关闭此类中心并削减议会预算并不会神奇地增加个人自力更生的储备。

sentences.en: The function of a well-designed state intervention is not to deprive people of liberty but to build social capacity and infrastructure that helps people take responsibility for their wellbeing.
sentences.zh: 精心设计的国家干预的功能不是剥夺人们的自由，而是建设社会能力和基础设施，帮助人们对自己的福祉负责。

sentences.en: The obesity crisis will not have a solution devised by left or right ideology—but experience indicates that the private sector needs the incentive of regulation before it starts taking public health emergencies seriously.
sentences.zh: 肥胖危机不会有左翼或右翼意识形态所设计的解决方案，但经验表明，私营部门在开始认真对待突发公共卫生事件之前需要监管的激励。
sentences.note: private sector 指私营部门；此处 regulation 是政府监管，incentive 指促使企业采取行动的外部动力。

articles.title: Protecting the Coral Sea
articles.subtitle: 珊瑚海保护区的争议
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Home to virgin reefs, rare sharks and vast numbers of exotic fish, the Coral Sea is a unique haven of biodiversity off the northeastern coast of Australia.
sentences.zh: 珊瑚海位于澳大利亚东北海岸外，拥有原始珊瑚礁、珍稀鲨鱼和大量奇异鱼类，是一处独特的生物多样性庇护所。
sentences.note: Home to... 作句首补充说明，意为“是……的栖息地”。exotic 在此指奇异、独特的鱼类，不能直接理解成外来入侵物种。

sentences.en: If a proposal by the Australian government goes ahead, the region will also become the world's largest marine protected area, with restrictions or bans on fishing, mining and marine farming.
sentences.zh: 如果澳大利亚政府的提议得以实施，该地区也将成为世界上最大的海洋保护区，限制或禁止捕鱼、采矿和海洋养殖。

sentences.en: The Coral Sea reserve would cover almost 990 000 square kilometres and stretch as far as 1 100 kilometres from the coast.
sentences.zh: 珊瑚海保护区将覆盖近 990 000 平方公里，距离海岸最远 1 100 公里。

sentences.en: Unveiled recently by environment minister Tony Burke, the proposal would be the last in a series of proposed marine reserves around Australia's coast.
sentences.zh: 环境部长托尼·伯克 (Tony Burke) 最近公布了该提案，该提案将是澳大利亚海岸周围一系列拟议海洋保护区中的最后一个。

sentences.en: But the scheme is attracting criticism from scientists and conservation groups, who argue that the government hasn't gone far enough in protecting the Coral Sea, or in other marine reserves in the coastal network.
sentences.zh: 但该计划引起了科学家和保护团体的批评，他们认为政府在保护珊瑚海或沿海网络的其他海洋保护区方面做得还不够。

sentences.en: Hugh Poss ingham, director of the Centre of Excellence for Environmental Decisions at the University of Queensland, points out that little more than half of the Coral Sea reserve is proposed as “no take” area, in which all fishing would be banned.
sentences.zh: 昆士兰大学环境决策卓越中心主任休·波斯·英厄姆 (Hugh Poss ingham) 指出，珊瑚海保护区的一半以上被提议划为“禁捕”区，禁止所有捕鱼活动。

sentences.en: The world's largest existing marine reserve, established last year by the British government in the Indian Ocean, spans 554 000 km² and is a no-take zone throughout.
sentences.zh: 英国政府去年在印度洋建立了世界上最大的现有海洋保护区，面积达 554 000 平方公里，全境均为禁渔区。

sentences.en: An alliance of campaigning conversation groups argues that more of the Coral Sea should receive this level of protection.
sentences.zh: 一个竞选对话团体联盟认为，更多的珊瑚海应该受到这种级别的保护。

sentences.en: “I would like to have seen more protection for coral reefs,” says Terry Hughes, director of the Centre of Excellence for Coral Reef Studies at James Cook University in Queensland.
sentences.zh: “我希望看到对珊瑚礁的更多保护，”昆士兰詹姆斯库克大学珊瑚礁研究卓越中心主任特里·休斯 (Terry Hughes) 说。

sentences.en: “More than 20 of them would be outside the no-take area and vulnerable to catch-and-release fishing”.
sentences.zh: “其中 20 多个将位于禁捕区之外，容易受到捕捞和放生的影响”。

sentences.en: As Nature went to press, the Australian government had not responded to specific criticisms of the plan.
sentences.zh: 截至《自然》杂志发稿时，澳大利亚政府尚未对该计划的具体批评做出回应。

sentences.en: But Robin Beaman, a marine geologist at James Cook University, says that the reserve does “broadly protect the range of habitats” in the sea.
sentences.zh: 但詹姆斯库克大学的海洋地质学家罗宾·比曼表示，该保护区确实“广泛保护了海洋中的一系列栖息地”。

sentences.en: “I can testify to the huge effort that government agencies and other organisations have put into trying to understand the ecological values of this vast area,” he says.
sentences.zh: “我可以证明政府机构和其他组织为了解这一广阔地区的生态价值付出了巨大努力，”他说。

sentences.en: Reserves proposed earlier this year for Australia's southwestern and northwestern coastal regions have also been criticised for failing to give habitats adequate protection.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候为澳大利亚西南和西北沿海地区提出的保护区也因未能给予栖息地足够的保护而受到批评。

sentences.en: In August, 173 marine scientists signed an open letter to the government saying they were “greatly concerned” that the proposals for the southwestern region had not been based on the “core science principles” of reserves—the protected regions were not, for instance, representative of all the habitats in the region, they said.
sentences.zh: 8月，173名海洋科学家签署了一封致政府的公开信，表示他们“非常担心”西南地区的提案并未基于保护区的“核心科学原则”——例如，保护区并不能代表该地区的所有栖息地。

sentences.en: Critics say that the southwestern reserve offers the greatest protection to the offshore areas where commercial opportunities are fewest and where there is little threat to the environment, a contention also levelled at the Coral Sea plan.
sentences.zh: 批评者说，西南部保护区重点保护的，是商业开发机会最少、环境所受威胁也最小的近海区域；同样的批评也指向了珊瑚海保护计划。

articles.title: Productivity and the need for sleep
articles.subtitle: 高产作家与睡眠需求
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Danielle Steel, the 71-year-old romance novelist is notoriously productive, having published 179 books at a rate of up to seven a year.
sentences.zh: 71 岁的爱情小说家丹妮尔·斯蒂尔以高产著称，已出版 179 本书，每年最多可出版七本。

sentences.en: But a passing reference in a recent profile by Glamour magazine to her 20-hour workdays prompted an outpouring of admiration.
sentences.zh: 但《魅力》杂志最近的一篇简介中提到她 20 小时的工作日，引发了人们的钦佩。

sentences.en: Steel has given that 20-hour figure when describing her “exhausting” process in the past: “I start the book and don't leave my desk until the first draft is finished.”
sentences.zh: Steel 在描述她过去的“疲惫”过程时给出了 20 小时的数字：“我开始写这本书，直到初稿完成才离开我的办公桌。”

sentences.en: She goes from bed, to desk, to bath, to bed, avoiding all contact aside from phone calls with her nine children.
sentences.zh: 她从床上起床，到书桌，到浴室，再到床上，除了与九个孩子打电话外，避免所有接触。

sentences.en: “I don't comb my hair for weeks,” she says.
sentences.zh: “我已经好几个星期没有梳理头发了，”她说。

sentences.en: Meals are brought to her desk, where she types until her fingers swell and her nails bleed.
sentences.zh: 饭菜被送到她的办公桌上，她在那里打字，直到手指肿胀、指甲流血。

sentences.en: The business news website Quartz held Steel up as an inspiration, writing that if only we all followed her “actually extremely liberating” example of industrious sleeplessness, we would be quick to see results.
sentences.zh: 商业新闻网站 Quartz 将 Steel 作为一种灵感，写道，只要我们都效仿她“实际上极其解放”的勤奋、不眠不休的榜样，我们很快就会看到结果。

sentences.en: Well, indeed.
sentences.zh: 嗯，确实如此。

sentences.en: With research results showing the cumulative effects of sleep loss and its impact on productivity, doubt has been voiced about the accuracy of Steel’s self-assessment.
sentences.zh: 研究结果显示睡眠不足的累积效应及其对生产力的影响，人们对 Steel 自我评估的准确性表示怀疑。

sentences.en: Her output maybe undeniable, but sceptics have suggested that she is guilty of erasing the role of ghost writers at worst, gross exaggeration at best.
sentences.zh: 她的作品也许是不可否认的，但怀疑论者认为，她有罪，往坏里说，她抹去了代笔作家的角色，往好里说，她是严重夸张了。

sentences.en: Steel says working 20 hours a day is “pretty brutal physically.”
sentences.zh: Steel 表示每天工作 20 小时“对身体来说非常残酷”。

sentences.en: But is it even possible?
sentences.zh: 但这可能吗？

sentences.en: “No,” says Maryanne Taylor of the Sleep Works.
sentences.zh: “不，”睡眠工作组织的玛丽安·泰勒说。

sentences.en: While you could work that long, the impact on productivity would make it hardly worthwhile.
sentences.zh: 虽然您可以工作那么长时间，但对生产力的影响将使其变得不值得。

sentences.en: If Steel was routinely sleeping for four hours a night, she would be drastically underestimating the negative impact, says Alison Gardiner, founder of the sleep improvement programme Sleep station.
sentences.zh: 睡眠改善计划睡眠站的创始人艾莉森·加德纳 (Alison Gardiner) 表示，如果斯蒂尔经常每晚睡四个小时，她就会大大低估负面影响。

sentences.en: “It’s akin to being drunk.”
sentences.zh: “就像喝醉了一样。”

sentences.en: It’s possible that Steel is exaggerating the demands of her schedule.
sentences.zh: Steel 可能夸大了她的日程安排要求。

sentences.en: Self-imposed sleeplessness has “become a bit of a status symbol”, says Taylor, a misguided measure to prove how powerful and productive you are.
sentences.zh: 泰勒说，自我强加的失眠已经“成为一种地位的象征”，这是一种误导性的衡量方式，用来证明你有多强大和多产。

sentences.en: Margaret Thatcher was also said to get by on four hours a night, while the 130-hour work weeks endured by tech heads has been held up as key to their success.
sentences.zh: 据说玛格丽特·撒切尔每晚只需要 4 个小时就能过日子，而技术主管们每周工作 130 个小时也被认为是他们成功的关键。

sentences.en: That is starting to change with increased awareness of the importance of sleep for mental health.
sentences.zh: 随着人们越来越认识到睡眠对心理健康的重要性，这种情况开始发生变化。

sentences.en: “People are starting to realise that sleep should not be something that you fit in between everything else,” says Taylor.
sentences.zh: “人们开始意识到睡眠不应该是介于其他一切之间的事情，”泰勒说。

sentences.en: But it is possible—if statistically extremely unlikely—that Steel could be born a “short sleeper” with an unusual body clock, says sleep expert Dr. Sophie Bostock.
sentences.zh: 但睡眠专家索菲·博斯托克 (Sophie Bostock) 博士表示，斯蒂尔可能天生就是一个“睡眠时间短”且生物钟不寻常的人，尽管从统计角度来看可能性极小。

sentences.en: “It’s probably present in fewer than 1% of the population.”
sentences.zh: “它可能只存在于不到 1% 的人口中。”

sentences.en: Even if Steel does happen to be among that tiny minority, says Bostock, it's “pretty irresponsible” to suggest that 20-hour days are simply a question of discipline for the rest of us.
sentences.zh: 博斯托克说，即使斯蒂尔确实属于那极少数人，暗示我们其他人只要足够自律就能每天工作 20 个小时，仍然“相当不负责任”。
sentences.note: Even if 引导让步从句。discipline 在这里指自律，不能把他人的极端作息当成人人只靠自律就能做到的事。

articles.title: The promise of organic agriculture
articles.subtitle: 有机农业的潜力与代价
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Organic agriculture is a relatively untapped resource for feeding the Earth's population, especially in the face of climate change and other global challenges.
sentences.zh: 有机农业是一种相对尚未开发的资源，可用于养活地球人口，特别是在面临气候变化和其他全球挑战的情况下。

sentences.en: That's the conclusion I reached in reviewing 40 years of science comparing the long-term prospects of organic and conventional farming.
sentences.zh: 这是我在回顾 40 年科学、比较有机农业和传统农业的长期前景时得出的结论。

sentences.en: The review study, “Organic Agriculture in the 21st Century,” is featured as the cover story for the February issue of the journal Nature Plants.
sentences.zh: 综述研究“21 世纪的有机农业”被作为《自然植物》杂志二月号的封面故事。

sentences.en: It is the first to compare organic and conventional agriculture across the main goals of sustainability identified by the National Academy of Sciences: productivity, economics, and environment.
sentences.zh: 它是第一个比较有机农业和传统农业的国家科学院确定的可持续发展主要目标：生产力、经济和环境。

sentences.en: Critics have long argued that organic agriculture is inefficient, requiring more land to yield the same amount of food.
sentences.zh: 批评者长期以来一直认为有机农业效率低下，需要更多的土地才能生产相同数量的食物。

sentences.en: It's true that organic farming produces lower yields, averaging 10 to 20 percent less than conventional.
sentences.zh: 确实，有机农业的产量较低，平均比传统农业低 10% 到 20%。

sentences.en: Advocates contend that the environmental advantages of organic agriculture far outweigh the lower yields, and that increasing research and breeding resources for organic systems would reduce the yield gap.
sentences.zh: 倡导者认为，有机农业的环境优势远远超过其较低的产量，增加有机系统的研究和育种资源将缩小产量差距。

sentences.en: Sometimes excluded from these arguments is the fact that we already produce enough food to more than feed the world's 7.4 billion people but do not provide adequate access to all individuals.
sentences.zh: 有时，这些论点被排除在外的是这样一个事实：我们已经生产出足够的粮食来养活世界上 74 亿人，但并没有为所有人提供足够的机会。

sentences.en: In some cases, organic yields can be higher than conventional.
sentences.zh: 在某些情况下，有机产量可能高于常规产量。

sentences.en: For example, in severe drought conditions, which are expected to increase with climate change in many areas, organic farms can produce as good, if not better, yields because of the higher water-holding capacity of organically farmed soils.
sentences.zh: 例如，在严重干旱的情况下（预计许多地区的干旱会随着气候变化而加剧），有机农场可以产生同样好的产量，甚至更好，因为有机耕作的土壤具有更高的持水能力。

sentences.en: What science does tell us is that mainstream conventional farming systems have provided growing supplies of food and other products but often at the expense of other sustainability goals.
sentences.zh: 科学告诉我们的是，主流传统农业系统提供了不断增长的食品和其他产品供应，但往往以牺牲其他可持续发展目标为代价。

sentences.en: Conventional agriculture may produce more food, but it often comes at a cost to the environment.
sentences.zh: 传统农业可能会生产更多粮食，但往往会以环境为代价。

sentences.en: Biodiversity loss, environmental degradation, and severe impacts on ecosystem services have not only accompanied conventional farming systems but have often extended well beyond their field boundaries.
sentences.zh: 生物多样性丧失、环境退化以及对生态系统服务的严重影响不仅伴随着传统农业系统，而且常常远远超出其田地边界。

sentences.en: With organic agriculture, environmental costs tend to be lower and the benefits greater.
sentences.zh: 有机农​​业的环境成本往往更低，效益更大。

sentences.en: Overall, organic farms tend to store more soil carbon, have better soil quality, and reduce soil erosion compared to their conventional counterparts.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，与传统农场相比，有机农场往往能储存更多的土壤碳，具有更好的土壤质量，并减少水土流失。

sentences.en: Organic agriculture also creates less soil and water pollution and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
sentences.zh: 有机农业还减少了土壤和水污染，并降低了温室气体排放。

sentences.en: And it’s more energy-efficient because it doesn't rely on synthetic fertilizers or pesticides.
sentences.zh: 而且它更节能，因为它不依赖合成肥料或农药。

sentences.en: Organic agriculture is also associated with greater biodiversity of plants, animals, insects and microorganisms as well as genetic diversity.
sentences.zh: 有机农业还与植物、动物、昆虫和微生物的生物多样性以及遗传多样性有关。

sentences.en: Biodiversity increases the services that nature provides and improves the ability of farming systems to adapt to changing conditions.
sentences.zh: 生物多样性增加了大自然提供的服务，并提高了农业系统适应不断变化的条件的能力。

sentences.en: Despite lower yields, organic agriculture is more profitable for farmers because consumers are willing to pay more.
sentences.zh: 尽管产量较低，但有机农业对农民来说更有利可图，因为消费者愿意支付更多费用。

sentences.en: Higher prices, called price premiums, can be justified as a way to compensate farmers for providing ecosystem services and avoiding environmental damage or external costs.
sentences.zh: 较高的价格（称为价格溢价）可以被认为是补偿农民提供生态系统服务并避免环境破坏或外部成本的一种方式。
sentences.note: price premium 指相对普通产品多付的溢价；external costs 指没有充分计入商品价格的外部成本。

articles.title: The positive stress movement
articles.subtitle: 适度压力与自我挑战
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: People often discuss the dangers of too much stress, but lately a very different view of stress is gaining popularity: this view of stress, held by members of the positive stress movement, argues that stress might actually be beneficial.
sentences.zh: 人们经常讨论压力太大的危险，但最近一种截然不同的压力观点正在流行：积极压力运动成员所持有的这种压力观点认为，压力实际上可能是有益的。

sentences.en: The positive stress movement is made up of people such as Zachary Rapp who are looking for an edge in a competitive world, and Rapp’s routine is a good example of followers of the movement.
sentences.zh: 积极压力运动由扎卡里·拉普 (Zachary Rapp) 等在竞争激烈的世界中寻找优势的人组成，拉普的日常活动就是该运动追随者的一个很好的例子。
sentences.note: an edge 指竞争优势；seek out 指主动寻找。文中 positive stress 是作者所介绍的一种观点，不等于普遍适用的健康建议。

sentences.en: He wakes up most mornings at dawn, goes for a run, sips black coffee while ripping through emails, and then steps into a freezing cold shower.
sentences.zh: 他大多数日子天一亮就起床，先跑步，一边喝黑咖啡一边快速处理邮件，然后冲一个冰冷的澡。

sentences.en: This is a routine designed to reduce the stress of running simultaneously three different health and biotechnology companies for 18 hours a day.
sentences.zh: 这是一项例行程序，旨在减轻每天 18 小时同时运营三个不同的健康和生物技术公司的压力。

sentences.en: Although Rapp’s practices may sound extreme, he is part of a growing movement, consisting largely of tech industry workers who claim that such radical tactics will help them live better and longer.
sentences.zh: 虽然拉普的做法听起来或许有些极端，但他属于一股不断壮大的潮流；参与者大多是科技行业从业者，他们声称这些激进的方法能让自己生活得更好、活得更久。

sentences.en: Inspired by influential figures in different fields, including entertainers, athletes, entrepreneurs and scientists, positive stress practitioners seek out some combination of extreme temperatures, restrictive diets, punishing exercise routines and general discomfort.
sentences.zh: 受到不同领域有影响力的人物（包括艺人、运动员、企业家和科学家）的启发，正向压力练习者寻求极端温度、限制性饮食、惩罚性锻炼和普遍不适的某种组合。

sentences.en: Rapp argues that positive stress keeps him balanced.
sentences.zh: 拉普认为积极的压力使他保持平衡。

sentences.en: In addition to running and freezing showers, Rapp uses ice baths, hot yoga, and unconventional eating practices such as eliminating dairy, sugar, alcohol and various other foods high in carbohydrates.
sentences.zh: 除了跑步和冷冻淋浴外，拉普还使用冰浴、热瑜伽和非常规饮食习惯，例如消除乳制品、糖、酒精和各种其他富含碳水化合物的食物。

sentences.en: He believes that these practices, which put stress on his body, actually make him feel less stress from work.
sentences.zh: 他认为，这些给他身体带来压力的做法，实际上让他感觉工作压力减轻了。

sentences.en: However, Rapp does not credit anyone in particular for his choices: he said he started using these methods in college, where he got into the habit of taking ice baths to recover from sports.
sentences.zh: 不过，拉普并未把自己的这些选择归功于某个特定人物：他说，大学时就开始采用这些方法，当时为了在运动后恢复身体，养成了冰浴的习惯。

sentences.en: He got back into it while trying to get his three companies off the ground.
sentences.zh: 当他试图让他的三个公司起步时，他又重新投入其中。

sentences.en: Rapp works long hours and sleeps only five to seven hours a night but he said he only gets sick once a year.
sentences.zh: 拉普工作时间很长，每晚只睡五到七个小时，但他说他每年只生病一次。

sentences.en: For him, the difference between day-to-day stress, like the kind we feel when moving apartments, and positive stress is that the latter involves pushing the body to extremes and forcing it to build up a tolerance.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，日常压力（例如我们搬家时感受到的压力）与积极压力之间的区别在于，后者涉及将身体推向极端并迫使其建立耐受性。

sentences.en: One thought leader in the positive stress world is Dutch extreme athlete Wim Hof, who earned the name “ice man” for his ability to withstand severe cold using deep breathing exercises.
sentences.zh: 积极压力世界中的一位思想领袖是荷兰极限运动员 Wim Hof，他因通过深呼吸练习抵御严寒的能力而赢得了“冰人”的称号。

sentences.en: Hofs ideas have become popular among tech industry elites and, thanks to Hof, cold showers are now a trend; indeed, some even call it a form of therapy.
sentences.zh: 霍夫斯的想法已经在科技行业精英中流行起来，得益于霍夫斯，冷水淋浴现在已经成为一种趋势；事实上，有些人甚至称其为一种治疗形式。

sentences.en: But it is important to note that not everyone agrees with these practitioners; indeed, some medical professionals argue that positive stress is not for everyone, and that it might even be dangerous for people who are unhealthy or older.
sentences.zh: 但需要注意，并非所有人都赞同这些实践者；事实上，一些医学专业人士认为，所谓积极压力并不适合每个人，对健康状况不佳或年纪较大的人甚至可能有危险。

articles.title: Hunting and the environment
articles.subtitle: 狩猎与生态保护
articles.source: 你提供的六级真题资料
articles.translationCredit: AI 辅助逐句参考译文；部分重点表达已校正，可在「编辑」中调整。标题为学习概括。

sentences.en: Is hunting good or bad for the environment?
sentences.zh: 狩猎对环境有利还是有害？

sentences.en: Like so many hot button issues, the answer to this question depends upon who you ask.
sentences.zh: 就像许多热点问题一样，这个问题的答案取决于你问的是谁。

sentences.en: On the one hand, some say, nothing could be more natural than hunting, and indeed just about every animal species—including humans—has been either predator or prey at some point in its evolution.
sentences.zh: 一方面，有人说，没有什么比狩猎更自然的了，事实上，几乎所有动物物种（包括人类）在其进化过程中的某个时刻要么是捕食者，要么是猎物。

sentences.en: And, ironic as it sounds, since humans have wiped out many animal predators, some see hunting as a natural way to reduce the herds of prey animals that now reproduce beyond the environment’s carrying capacity.
sentences.zh: 而且，听起来很讽刺，因为人类已经消灭了许多动物捕食者，一些人将狩猎视为减少猎物群的自然方式，而这些猎物现在的繁殖超出了环境的承受能力。

sentences.en: On the other hand, many environmental and animal advocates see hunting as savage, arguing that it is morally wrong to kill animals, regardless of practical considerations.
sentences.zh: 另一方面，许多环境和动物倡导者将狩猎视为野蛮行为，认为不顾实际考虑而杀害动物在道德上是错误的。

sentences.en: According to Glenn Kirk of the California-based The Animals’ Voice, hunting “causes immense suffering to individual wild animals...” and is “ irrationally cruel because unlike natural predation , hunters kill for pleasure...”
sentences.zh: 据加州动物之声的格伦·柯克 (Glenn Kirk) 称，狩猎“给野生动物个体带来巨大痛苦……”，并且“是非理性的残忍，因为与自然捕食不同，猎人为了快乐而杀人……”

sentences.en: He adds that, despite hunters’ claims that hunting keeps wildlife populations in balance, hunters’ license fees are used to “manipulate a few game species into overpopulation at the expense of a much larger number of non-game species, resulting in the loss of biological diversity, genetic integrity and ecological balance.”
sentences.zh: 他补充说，尽管猎人声称狩猎可以保持野生动物种群的平衡，但猎人的许可费却被用来“以牺牲大量非狩猎物种为代价，操纵少数狩猎物种使其数量过剩，从而导致生物多样性、遗传完整性和生态平衡的丧失。”

sentences.en: Beyond moral issues, others contend that hunting is not practical.
sentences.zh: 除了道德问题之外，其他人还认为狩猎不切实际。

sentences.en: According to the Humane Society of the United States, the vast majority of hunted species—such as waterfowl, rabbits, upland birds and mourning doves—“provide minimal nutrition and do not require population control.”
sentences.zh: 根据美国人道协会的说法，绝大多数被猎杀的物种（例如水禽、兔子、高地鸟类和哀鸽）“提供最低限度的营养，不需要控制种群数量。”

sentences.en: Author Gary E. Varner suggests in his book, In Nature’s Interests, that some types of hunting may be morally justifiable while others may not be.
sentences.zh: 作者加里·E·瓦尔纳 (Gary E. Varner) 在他的著作《为了自然的利益》中指出，某些类型的狩猎在道德上可能是合理的，而另一些则可能不是。

sentences.en: Hunting “designed to secure the aggregate welfare of the target species, the integrity of its ecosystem, or both”—what Varner terms “therapeutic hunting”—is defensible, while subsistence and sport hunting—both of which only benefit human beings—is not.
sentences.zh: 狩猎“旨在确保目标物种的总体福利、生态系统的完整性或两者兼而有之”——瓦尔纳称之为“治疗性狩猎”——是有道理的，而自给性和运动性狩猎——两者都只对人类有利——则不然。

sentences.en: Regardless of one’s individual stance, fewer Americans hunt today than in recent history.
sentences.zh: 无论个人立场如何，今天打猎的美国人比近代历史上少。

sentences.en: Data gathered by the U. S. Fish & Wildlife Service in 2006 show that only five percent of Americans—some 12.5 million individuals—consider themselves hunters today, down from nine percent in 2001 and 15 percent in 1996.
sentences.zh: 美国鱼类和野生动物管理局 2006 年收集的数据显示，如今只有 5% 的美国人（约 1250 万人）认为自己是猎人，低于 2001 年的 9% 和 1996 年的 15%。

sentences.en: Public support for hunting, however, is on the rise.
sentences.zh: 然而，公众对狩猎的支持正在上升。

sentences.en: A 2007 survey by Responsive Management Inc. found that eighty percent of respondents agreed that “hunting has a legitimate place in modern society,” and the percentage of Americans indicating disapproval of hunting declined from 22 percent in 1995 to 16 percent in 2007.
sentences.zh: Responsive Management Inc. 2007 年的一项调查发现，80% 的受访者同意“狩猎在现代社会中具有合法地位”，表示不赞成狩猎的美国人比例从 1995 年的 22% 下降到 2007 年的 16%。

sentences.en: Perhaps matching the trend among the public, green leaders are increasingly advocating cooperation between hunters and environmental groups: After all, both deplore urban sprawl and habitat destruction.
sentences.zh: 或许是顺应公众态度的变化，环保界领袖越来越提倡猎人与环保团体合作：毕竟，双方都反对城市无序扩张和栖息地遭到破坏。
sentences.note: After all 引出双方能够合作的理由；deplore 表示强烈反对、痛惜，语气比一般的 regret 强。
